Title: Managing Director - Real Estate
Location: Jebel Ali, DU, United Arab Emirates
Description:
**HAMDAN AL MANSOORI GROUP**  
*“Where ambition meets opportunity.”*

**WE ARE HIRING: MANAGING DIRECTOR – REAL ESTATE**  
**Dubai, UAE | Full-time | In person**

**Have you established and led a real estate company across leasing, property management, and brokerage?**

Hamdan Al Mansoori Group is seeking an accomplished executive to establish, lead, and grow a fully operational real estate business in Dubai.

We are looking for a business builder with proven experience turning a business vision into a functioning company: defining its services, building its team, establishing operating systems, securing clients and property portfolios, and delivering sustainable financial results.

Reporting to Group Management, you will hold overall responsibility for the company’s strategy, commercial development, operations, people, service delivery, and profitability.

**YOUR MANDATE**

Build an integrated real estate business with three core revenue streams:

* **Leasing:** Residential and commercial leasing, landlord representation, tenant acquisition, and renewals.
* **Property Management:** Securing and managing property management mandates, developing recurring fee income, and delivering consistent service to landlords and tenants.
* **Brokerage:** Secondary-market and off-plan sales, supported by productive agents, strong developer relationships, and effective transaction management.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Company Establishment & Business Leadership**

* Develop and execute the company’s business plan, organisational structure, operating model, budgets, and financial targets.
* Define service offerings, target markets, pricing, revenue streams, and growth priorities.
* Lead business establishment and operational readiness, coordinating licensing and regulatory requirements with the relevant specialists.
* Establish policies, procedures, delegated authorities, reporting systems, and internal controls.
* Build the required business functions, coordinating with Group Finance, HR, IT, and other shared services.

**Leasing & Property Management**

* Secure landlord relationships, leasing instructions, and property management contracts.
* Develop a commercially viable portfolio with clear targets for managed units, occupancy, renewals, management fees, and collections.
* Establish processes for property onboarding, leasing administration, tenant relations, renewals, inspections, and landlord reporting.
* Oversee maintenance coordination, service providers, operating costs, and service quality.
* Work with Finance to establish accurate property accounting, collection controls, and clear reporting of client funds.
* Strengthen landlord retention and expand the portfolio through service performance, referrals, and direct business development.

**Business Development & Brokerage**

* Personally originate business through established relationships, direct outreach, referrals, and strategic partnerships.
* Build relationships with property owners, investors, developers, and corporate clients.
* Develop the brokerage’s sales capability, listings portfolio, and transaction pipeline.
* Oversee negotiations, transaction execution, commission collection, and client relationship management.
* Define marketing and property portal requirements through clear business cases, approved budgets, and measurable commercial returns.

**Team Building & Operational Management**

* Recruit and develop the required leasing, property management, brokerage, and administrative teams within approved budgets.
* Establish job responsibilities, targets, KPIs, training programmes, and performance review processes.
* Train managers and employees in client acquisition, property services, negotiation, operational procedures, and service standards.
* Implement effective CRM, portfolio management, listing, documentation, and reporting systems.
* Lead daily operations, resolve escalated issues, and maintain accountability across departments.

**Financial Performance & Governance**

* Take full responsibility for the company’s profit and loss, cash flow planning, revenue forecasts, and cost control.
* Monitor recurring income, transaction revenue, collections, staffing costs, and operating margins.
* Establish management dashboards covering commercial performance, portfolio growth, service delivery, and financial results.
* Ensure compliance with applicable regulations, contractual obligations, and Group policies.
* Present performance updates, corrective actions, investment requirements, and growth proposals to Group Management.

Title: Site Safety Manager - Industrial & Nuclear Projects

**Home District/Group:** Ganotec District

**Department:** Safety

**Market:** Nuclear

**Position Overview**
---------------------

Ganotec is seeking an experienced **Site Safety Manager** to provide leadership and oversight of health and safety activities on major industrial and nuclear construction projects in Ontario.

The Site Safety Manager will work closely with project leadership, field operations, clients and subcontractors to establish a strong safety culture and ensure work is planned and executed safely. This individual will lead site safety programs, coach project teams, identify and mitigate operational risks, and ensure compliance with company, client and regulatory requirements.

This is a senior field leadership opportunity for an experienced construction safety professional who thrives in complex, high-risk project environments.

**District Overview**
---------------------

Ganotec is a full service, heavy industrial contractor serving the industrial sector across Canada. Ganotec typically self performs all major disciplines including, civil, structural steel erection, heavy mechanical equipment installation, process piping and electrical / instrumentation and controls. We conduct our business through a variety of commercial contract styles including full turnkey, EPC, design build, T&M and conventional discipline packages. We have always been a strong proponent of “partnering”, working in collaboration with owners, major equipment suppliers and engineers at the early stages of the project development phase to allow for a more cost-effective execution strategy for the project. Ganotec continues to position itself towards the future, constantly seeking growth opportunities yet never losing sight of what has made the company so successful.

**Location**
------------

The position will be based on our project in Darlington, ON.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* **Collaborate to the site health and safety program**, including site-specific safety plans, inspections, audits, hazard assessments, leading indicators, training, orientations and required safety documentation.
* **Partner with project and field leadership** to integrate safety into construction planning and execution, with particular attention to high-risk activities such as lifting and rigging, heavy equipment, working at heights, confined spaces, excavations and energized work.
* **Lead and mentor the site safety team**, while coaching supervisors, craft employees and subcontractors on safe work practices and proactively addressing unsafe conditions or behaviours.
* **Lead incident investigations and corrective actions**, identify trends and opportunities for improvement, and ensure lessons learned are effectively communicated and implemented across the project.
* **Ensure compliance and maintain strong stakeholder relationships** by working closely with project management, clients and subcontractors to meet Ontario regulatory requirements, client expectations and Ganotec safety standards

**Qualifications**
------------------

* **5-10+ years of progressive health and safety experience preferred**, ideally supporting large construction, nuclear, power generation or heavy industrial projects.
* Proven experience leading safety programs and safety professionals on large, complex construction projects.

Title: Safety, Health & Environment Executive
Description:
The **Safety, Health & Environment (SHE) Executive** is responsible for supporting the development, implementation and monitoring of safety, health and environmental programmes within Trocadero’s FEC and indoor theme park operations. The role protects guests, employees and contractors through proactive inspections, risk controls, training, emergency preparedness, authority licensing coordination and accurate reporting. The scope includes rides, attractions, arcade and VR areas, school groups, events, F&B, retail, storage, back of house and associated outdoor or water based attractions.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES & ACCOUNTABILITIES:

* **Safety Oversight & Inspections:** Conduct and document daily walkthroughs and weekly and monthly inspections of rides, attractions, guest areas, exits, storage and back of house. Record hazards, assign corrective actions with owners and deadlines, and verify closure. Immediately escalate critical risks and recurring defects.
* **Regulatory Compliance & Authority Licensing:** Participate in all applicable authority licensing, renewals, inspections, amendments and approvals for the park. Coordinate with GRO, department owners, mall management and FM on QCDD and Civil Defence approvals, MOCI licensing requirements and relevant municipality, public health, food safety and environmental requirements. Confirm applicability for each activity with the responsible owner and authority.
* **Licensing Register & Inspection Readiness:** Maintain a consolidated register of licences, permits, certificates, conditions, owners, expiry dates and submission status. Issue internal renewal alerts normally 90, 60 and 30 days before expiry, or earlier where needed. Coordinate documents, approved drawings, fire system maintenance records, ride inspection evidence and closure of authority observations. Attend inspections and escalate approval delays or expiry risks to the General Manager.
* **Risk Assessments & Change Control:** Maintain the SHE risk register and review assessments and SOPs with department owners after incidents or changes. Participate in SHE reviews for new rides, refurbishments, layouts, events and operating changes; coordinate required approvals before implementation. Apply applicable Qatar requirements, authority conditions, manufacturer instructions and adopted industry standards.
* **Ride & Attraction Safety:** Verify completion of required opening checks and documented release by Operations and Maintenance. Audit guest restrictions, loading, restraints, two part dispatch checks, supervision and emergency access. Escalate unusual vibration, repeated faults and unsafe conditions. SHE checks do not replace technical inspections, repairs or certification by competent authorized personnel.
* **Guest Safety & School Groups:** Review crowd flow, queuing, capacity, group supervision, loading and activity restrictions with Operations and Sales. Ensure faster throughput does not bypass safety checks. Monitor child safeguarding, lost child procedures, accessibility and incident response. Assess birthday parties, camps and special events before operation. Support all needs in managing these groups with Operations and Sales Department.
* **Incident Investigation:** Ensure immediate care, area isolation and escalation for serious incidents. Record injuries, near misses, unsafe conditions and environmental incidents; preserve evidence and coordinate root cause investigations. Assign and verify corrective actions and effectiveness. Coordinate required external notifications through authorized management within applicable deadlines; protect medical and personal information.
* **Training & Competence:** Develop and maintain the SHE induction, refresher and toolbox talk programme and training matrix. Coordinate emergency response, first aid, fire warden, chemical handling and PPE training. Verify operator authorization and practical competence records with Operations and Maintenance; retain attendance, assessments and certificate expiry records.
* **Emergency Preparedness:** Maintain plans for fire, medical incidents, ride evacuation and rescue, power failure, severe leaks, spills and security threats. Align evacuation routes, assembly points and communication with mall plans. Coordinate drills and ride rescue exercises with competent personnel to the approved schedule; document findings and improvements. Monitor first aid supplies, trained responders and emergency communication readiness.
* **Fire & Life Safety:** Inspect fire exits, escape routes, firefighting equipment, emergency lighting and alarm access. Follow up servicing and defects with Maintenance, mall FM and approved contractors. Coordinate controls for fire system impairments and works affecting evacuation; retain testing, servicing and inspection evidence.
* **Contractor Safety & Permit to Work:** Review contractor competencies, risk assessments and method statements. Monitor permits for hot work, work at height, electrical isolation and other high risk work. Check lockout and tagout, barriers, tools, public segregation and safe handback with Maintenance and mall FM. Stop unsafe work or attraction use where there is imminent danger; secure the area and notify the General Manager immediately.
* **Occupational Health & Hygiene:** Monitor housekeeping, slip and trip risks, sanitation, welfare, ergonomics, manual handling, noise and ventilation concerns. Coordinate food hygiene and pest control checks with responsible teams. Review water treatment and quality records for relevant attractions with competent owners and escalate unsafe conditions.
* **Environmental Stewardship:** Maintain chemical inventories, safety data sheets, labels, safe storage and spill controls. Monitor waste segregation and disposal records and track water, energy and waste performance. Recommend practical reductions in waste and resource consumption and investigate environmental incidents.
* **Housekeeping & Security Supervision:** Oversee outsourced housekeeping and security teams against agreed duties, SHE requirements and service standards. Monitor inspections, staffing concerns, shift handovers, incident response and emergency readiness. Escalate service failures through the contract owner; coordinate safety related CCTV evidence through authorized channels.
* **Daily & Weekly Reporting:** Prepare the daily SHE inspection and incident summary by the end of the shift or operating day, covering hazards, injuries, near misses, defects, contractor activities and outstanding actions. Escalate urgent risks immediately. Provide a weekly update on overdue actions, licensing alerts, training due and priority risks at the management review.
* **Monthly Reporting:** Submit a consolidated SHE report to the General Manager by the fifth working day of the following month, unless otherwise agreed. Include incident trends, root causes, inspections, audits, corrective action ageing, licensing and certificate status, training, drills, contractor performance, environmental data, resource needs and decisions required.
* **Half Yearly Reporting:** Prepare a six month SHE review within ten working days after each six month reporting period. Compare performance against targets and the preceding period; assess recurring incidents, major risks, compliance gaps and emergency readiness. Provide a prioritized improvement plan with owners, deadlines and resource requirements.
* **Annual Reporting & Planning:** Prepare the annual SHE performance and compliance review within fifteen working days after year end. Evaluate objectives, incidents, audits, licensing, training, drills and environmental performance. Prepare the following year’s SHE plan, inspection calendar, training programme and proposed budget before the budget approval deadline.
* **Other Reports & Document Control:** Prepare investigation reports, authority submissions, inspection responses, insurer reports and management requested analysis as required. Authority and incident deadlines take precedence over internal reporting dates. Verify figures against evidence and maintain controlled registers, SOPs, inspection records and correspondence, with secure access and appropriate retention.
* **Leadership & Collaboration:** Support SHE meetings, internal audits, external inspections and insurer reviews. Maintain an action tracker and report progress against agreed targets for inspections, training, licensing readiness, reporting and verified action closure. Encourage near miss reporting and coordinate corrective actions across departments. Perform other reasonable SHE duties assigned by the General Manager within competence and authorization.
* **Authority & Accountability:** GRO and authorized signatories retain formal application and signature authority; approved professionals retain specialist design and certification duties. Department heads implement controls in their areas. Participate in reopening reviews after unsafe conditions are resolved; reopening requires applicable technical and management authorizations.

**JOB SPECIFICATION:**

Qualifications & Experience:

* Diploma in occupational health and safety, Environmental Science, or equivalent within a related field.
* Experience: Minimum 2 years of relevant SHE experience, preferably within a theme park, FEC, hospitality or public facing leisure operation. Qatar authority inspection and licensing coordination experience is preferred.
* Professional certification such as NEBOSH International General Certificate or equivalent is preferred. First Aid/CPR, fire safety and incident investigation training are desirable; ISO 45001 or ISO 14001 auditing knowledge is an advantage.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office, particularly Word and Excel, and SHE reporting systems, with strong record control and evidence based reporting skills.
* Ability to undertake site inspections and emergency coordination safely. Work at height or specialist rescue only when trained, authorized and medically fit. Availability for operational shifts, weekends and emergency response as required.
* Strong communication, training, investigation, problem solving and coordination skills; able to work effectively with a multicultural workforce, authorities and contractors

Work Location: In person

Title: Director - Health, Safety and Worker Welfare Operations (RD 4)
Description:
Lead the development and implementation of health, safety, environmental and worker welfare governance across City Operations, translating enterprise requirements into operational standards, contractual requirements and assurance activities for City Operations-managed assets and services. Oversee compliance, audits, incident learning and corrective action, support the City Command Unit during incidents, and ensure operational readiness and safe transition of assets into live operations.

**Health, Safety and Worker Welfare Governance**

* Lead the development and implementation of City Operations health, safety and worker welfare governance, translating Strategic Delivery Unit (SDU) policies, standards and guidelines and applicable legal requirements into operational procedures.
* Establish City Operations minimum requirements and contractual schedules for health, safety and worker welfare, ensuring service providers and contractors understand the standards against which their performance will be assured.
* Maintain and improve the health, safety and worker welfare framework as the city asset base, services and workforce expand.
* Define induction, training and competency requirements for City Operations employees and relevant service providers.

**Operational Compliance and Assurance**

* Direct the risk-based assurance programme across City Operations-managed assets, public realm and operational services, covering compliance reviews, inspections, audits and follow-up activities.
* Monitor contractor, operator and service-provider compliance, directing corrective action through the relevant contract and service owners.
* Track performance through incident data, risk registers, permit-to-work compliance, regulatory reporting, leading indicators and corrective-action status.
* Report material risks, non-conformances, trends and overdue actions to leadership, escalating issues affecting people, public safety, compliance or Qiddiya’s reputation.
* Stop unsafe work within the City Operations remit where required and coordinate formal corrective action through the accountable contract holder.

**Worker Welfare Operations**

* Lead oversight of worker welfare conditions for employees and contracted workforces within the City Operations remit, recognising the public-facing nature of operational workers.
* Establish and monitor welfare requirements covering working conditions, welfare facilities, access to support and applicable Saudi labour and welfare requirements.
* Coordinate with workplace, accommodation, contractor and service-provider teams to address welfare risks and escalate unresolved issues.
* Build internal worker welfare capability through recruitment, development and knowledge transfer.

**Environmental Compliance**

* Oversee environmental compliance across City Operations-managed assets, public spaces and service arrangements, focusing on prevention of harm and compliance with approved environmental management plans.
* Establish requirements for pollution prevention and control, including oil and chemical storage, waste handling, noise and nuisance.
* Monitor contractors and service providers against environmental requirements, ensuring incidents, non-conformances and corrective actions are tracked to closure.
* Coordinate environmental reporting and relevant Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) inputs while maintaining the distinction between environmental compliance and broader

sustainability ownership.

**Incident Management and Operational Resilience**

* Provide health, safety, environmental and worker welfare subject-matter expertise to the City Command Unit during incidents, crises and emergency exercises.
* Support the Gold, Silver and Bronze response structure by advising on technical risks, immediate controls, regulatory requirements and recovery actions.
* Develop, maintain and test relevant crisis playbooks in alignment with City Command Unit and Operational Resilience requirements.
* Lead or oversee post-incident and near-miss investigations within the remit, ensuring root causes, lessons learned and preventive actions are embedded.

**Asset Readiness and Handover**

* Define health, safety, environmental and worker welfare requirements for new assets and services entering City Operations, engaging with delivery teams from design through handover.
* Lead readiness reviews from the agreed pre-handover period, validating operational requirements, documentation, controls and service arrangements before go-live.
* Provide functional sign-off and readiness input for handover and takeover processes, escalating unresolved risks through stage-gate and governance forums.
* Work with City Assets Management and delivery teams to transfer defects, risks, warranties, procedures and assurance findings into live operations.

**Stakeholder and Regulatory Coordination**

* Act as the City Operations focal point for health, safety, environmental and worker welfare matters with SDU, City Assets Management, delivery teams, operational functions and central QIC stakeholders.
* Coordinate with contract holders and service providers to embed requirements into scopes of work, mobilization plans, procedures and performance reviews.
* Support engagement with relevant regulators, authorities and emergency-response stakeholders, ensuring submissions, observations and actions are coordinated and closed out.
* Maintain constructive relationships while preserving the professional judgement required to challenge unsafe or non-compliant practices.

**Capability, Reporting and Continuous Improvement**

* Lead development of the Health, Safety and Worker Welfare team in line with the phased asset handover plan.
* Establish dashboards and management information combining lagging and leading indicators to identify emerging risks and guide improvement.
* Review assurance findings, incident trends and operational feedback to improve standards, contracts, procedures and service-provider performance.
* Promote a proactive culture while ensuring accountability remains with the teams and providers delivering the work.

 **Requirements**

**Required:** Bachelor’s degree in Health and Safety, Occupational Health and Safety, Environmental Health, Environmental Management, Engineering, or a related field.

**Preferred:** Master’s degree in Health and Safety, Environmental Management, Engineering, Public Health, Business Administration, or a related field.

Professional certifications or memberships with recognized health and safety, environmental, worker welfare, emergency management or related professional institutes are preferred; Chartered or equivalent professional standing is preferred.

A minimum of 10-12 years of experience in health and safety, occupational health and safety, environmental compliance, worker welfare, operational assurance or related fields is required, including relevant experience in a leadership role.

Demonstrated experience leading health, safety and worker welfare governance and assurance across complex operational, infrastructure, development or asset environments, including establishing standards and contractual requirements; overseeing contractor compliance; leading audits, inspections, investigations and corrective actions; supporting asset readiness and handover; advising on incident and crisis response; and coordinating with delivery teams, asset owners, regulators and public authorities. Experience across the asset lifecycle and in the Middle East is preferred.

Title: Senior Sales Operations Analyst
Description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
  
  
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
  
  
Canonical is hiring exceptional Sales Operations leaders and experienced analysts to grow and manage our global direct, alliance, channel partner and online sales. Our Sales Operations teams analyze and drive interventions to maximize net customer retention, and lead robust, repeatable processes to plan, manage and deliver revenue.
  
  
You will partner with Canonical’s executive team across sales, business development, customer success, marketing, product management, commercial systems, delivery, finance and legal and provide a focal point to drive improvements. This position requires leadership, initiative and an analytical approach, a keen eye for detail and the ability to drive continuous improvements in processes, systems, governance and data quality. People that thrive in these roles are proactive problem solvers who are passionate about the opportunity to partner with sales leadership, our role in the technology industry bringing open source to a wider audience of innovators and enterprises, and the opportunity to design and drive programs in support of Canonical's continued success.
  
  
**Location:**
*These roles will be based remotely in the EMEA, Americas regions.*
The role entails
  
  

* Delivering precise, scalable revenue operations for business through direct, indirect or online channels
* Leading and developing a team of revenue operations analysts in developing policies, driving processes and providing daily operational support and enablement to sales teams and partners
* Driving Sales Engagement, Training/Enablement/Data Enrichment, Customer Relationship Management, Configure Price Quote, Analytics and Commissions
* Instrumenting, measuring and improving policies and processes across teams covering the entire revenue operations spectrum
* Delivering metrics and reporting to monitor and improve revenue operations effectiveness, including new leads, pipeline, velocity, sales productivity and renewals.
* Using data to drive insight, manage territories and channels, improve productivity, and agree and implement actionable change with executive management through regular sales and business reviews.
* Overseeing our sales technology and processes, driving automation and process improvements and partnering with our commercial systems engineering team to continuously improve business systems and integration
* Leading the introduction of new products, pricing, packaging and bundling through systems that are easy for sales and partners to navigate and quote
* Driving data quality, through order processing, new hire training, process documentation, reporting and data cleansing
* Leading and enhancing our commercial review process for evaluating and steering sales and alliance opportunities
* Owning the commission plan and leading the process for setting goals, evaluating and paying against that plan

What we are looking for in you
  
  

* Experience operating in a leadership Revenue Operations role, driving effectiveness of direct, channel and alliance partnerships
* Data-driven and analytical approach with a high attention to detail
* Track record of providing insight through robust CRM and other Revenue Operations technology platforms, data, analytics, compensation systems and processes to deliver excellent revenue operations
* An energetic, thoughtful, systematic approach, a problem solver with skill in measuring, identifying and delivering systems and processes that ensure repeatable, scalable outcomes
* Comfort with commercial pressure, and the ability to put revenue teams under appropriate performance pressure
* Organisational skills and the ability to interact and work with stakeholders within all levels of the organisation
* Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
* Undergraduate degree in a related field, preferably in Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics or Economics, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
* Strong communication, interpersonal, negotiation and influencing skills
* Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
* Ability to travel internationally up to four times a year for company events up to two weeks long

Nice-to-have skills
  
  

* Experience gained within a similar, technology subscription-based business
* Deep understanding of working in a global, multicultural organization including driving a team based remotely in multiple time zones
* Experience in mentoring and coaching team members on technical and soft skills, directly contributing to their professional development and performance improvement.

What Canonical offers
  
  
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  
  

* Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
* Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
* Annual compensation review
* Recognition rewards
* Annual holiday leave
* Maternity and paternity leave
* Employee Assistance Programme
* Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
* Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

**About Canonical**
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
  
  
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
  
  
*We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.*

Title: Inside Sales Manager
Description:

Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. **Purpose:**  
We are currently recruiting for a Inside Sales Manager. Our team includes world class experts and dynamic go-getters. This is a full-time position based in Calgary, Edmonton, Toronto, Markham, Oakville or Sarnia.

The primary responsibility of the Inside Sales Manager is to drive disciplined application of our Sales Process collaborating with all stakeholders (including all levels of Inside Sales, Outside Sales, operations, management, and marketing). By driving this process, the ISM is expected to:

* Develop and advance customer relationships prior to opportunity identification (Opening Game).
* Work with the capture team to strategically position us for specific opportunities (Middle Game).
* Develop high-quality, opportunity-specific response documents/presentations/interviews with competitive and compelling sales messages to satisfy customer business goals (End Game).

The ISM takes responsibility for deliverables and activities for opportunities of all sizes in all phases of the sales process, as well as facilitates the completion of deliverables and activities owned by others through proper alignment/communication and/or escalation as required. The ISM collaborates with Sales, Marketing, and Operations to develop distinctive value propositions that enhance our customers’ competitive position. The ISM drives the organization to maintain accurate and updated account management and opportunity information on CSP.

**Responsibilities:**

**Strategic, Marketing, and Opening Game**

* Liaise with Outside Sales and the Leadership Team to capture and develop the strategy.
* Organizes and participates in response-related meetings (internal and/or customer), as appropriate.
* Coordinates response reviews and approvals.
* Manage the successful development of compliant, competitive, and compelling Proposals, RFIs, Pre-qualifications, and EOIs through effective collaboration across teams that include internal staff, other business lines and or outside partners/suppliers.

Manage the knowledge database locally and globally as required to support the continuous and effective performance of the team.

* Ensure that all sales documents comply with our brand and customer confidentiality requirements.
* Ensure sales process close-out procedures comply with corporate assurance requirements.

Title: Sr. Manager Warehouse and Distribution
Description:
OVERVIEW

The Senior Manager, Warehouse & Logistics leads the safe, accurate and efficient movement of products through Perfect Sports Canada Inc.’s Aurora distribution facility. This hands-on role is accountable for inventory integrity, EDI order fulfillment, logistics coordination, warehouse systems and continuous improvement. Working closely with the Warehouse Manager, Sales, Finance, manufacturing partners and Quality, the Senior Manager translates business priorities into practical operating plans, supports daily execution and resolves issues on the warehouse floor.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead receiving, storage, replenishment, picking, packing and shipping across the 50,000 sq. ft. distribution facility, including its eight dock doors; participate directly when workload or operational issues require support.

* Coordinate daily priorities with the Warehouse Manager to align people, equipment and space with order volumes, inbound deliveries and customer commitments. Provide clear handovers and timely escalation of constraints.

* Manage inbound deliveries from manufacturing partners and outbound Canadian, international and intercompany U.S. shipments; coordinate carriers, third-party logistics providers and delivery appointments.

* Monitor EDI orders through the Minotaur ERP system from receipt to dispatch. Resolve inventory, allocation and transaction exceptions with the appropriate teams and confirm orders progress within required timelines.

* Ensure fulfillment meets customer routing guides, pallet and carton specifications, labels, shipping notices and documentation requirements; investigate chargebacks and recurring service failures.

* Maintain accurate inventory quantities, locations, lot numbers and expiry dates in the ERP system; lead cycle counts, physical counts, variance investigations and approved inventory adjustments.

* Apply first-expiry-first-out or first-in-first-out controls as appropriate. Monitor aging, short-dated, damaged and slow-moving stock and recommend timely action to management.

* Coordinate replenishment and product availability with Sales, Finance and manufacturing partners. Flag shortages and excess stock early and support demand and capacity planning.

* Ensure receiving checks identify quantity discrepancies, damage and documentation gaps; record exceptions before carrier departure where practical and coordinate resolution.

* Coordinate freight bookings, bills of lading, packing lists, export and customs documentation with carriers, brokers and internal teams; verify accuracy and resolve shipment delays or claims.

* Work with Quality and the designated Quality Assurance Person to execute applicable GMP, CFIA and Health Canada procedures. Maintain lot traceability, segregation, storage conditions, sanitation and allergen controls where applicable.

* Maintain effective controls for quarantined, returned, recalled and rejected products. Support traceability exercises, audits and corrective actions; obtain Quality authorization before releasing held stock.

* Ensure product transfers, write-offs and disposal follow documented approvals. Verify the approved product list, quantities and disposition before arranging transport or destruction and retain supporting records.

* Enforce safe practices for racking, docks, pedestrian traffic, loading, cargo securement and material handling equipment. Coordinate inspections, maintenance and corrective action with responsible parties.

* Verify operator training and authorization before equipment use; operate equipment only when trained and authorized. Address unsafe conditions promptly and report incidents and near misses.

* Coordinate company delivery van inspections, maintenance records, safe loading and driver procedures with designated staff, escalating defects or compliance concerns before use.

* Coach and develop warehouse staff in collaboration with the Warehouse Manager and HR. **Reinforce respectful communication,** clear expectations, training completion and consistent accountability.

* Plan staffing and equipment needs against workload and budget. Obtain required management approval before temporary labour bookings, overtime commitments, freight exceptions or other spending; coordinate approved arrangements with the Warehouse Manager.

* Develop and maintain practical SOPs and operational reporting. Track service, inventory, productivity, safety and cost performance; investigate root causes and implement measurable improvements.

* Work collaboratively with Sales, Customer Service, Finance, Quality and manufacturing partners to resolve operational issues, communicate risks and close assigned actions on time.

Title: IT Technician
Description:
Job Purpose

The IT Technician will provide technical support and ensure the smooth operation, maintenance, and troubleshooting of IT systems and equipment. The role involves supporting staff and users by maintaining IT infrastructure, resolving technical issues, and ensuring the effective use of technology across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

**1. IT Infrastructure & System Maintenance**

* Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot computers, laptops, printers, projectors, and other IT equipment.
* Assist in maintaining networks, servers, Wi-Fi connectivity, and other IT infrastructure.
* Monitor the performance of IT systems and report technical issues requiring further attention.
* Ensure all IT equipment and software are properly maintained and updated.
* Support the installation and configuration of operating systems and software applications.

**2. Technical Support & Troubleshooting**

* Provide timely technical support to employees and users.
* Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, network, and connectivity issues.
* Respond to IT support requests and ensure issues are resolved within appropriate timelines.
* Assist users with email configuration, Microsoft Office applications, printers, and other business-related software.
* Maintain records of technical issues, solutions, and support requests.

**3. Network & System Administration**

* Assist in monitoring and maintaining LAN, WAN, and wireless network infrastructure.
* Troubleshoot network connectivity and internet access issues.
* Support user account creation, access management, and password resets.
* Assist with server maintenance, system updates, and software installations.
* Monitor network performance and report potential security or operational concerns.

**4. IT Security & Data Protection**

* Ensure computers and other IT devices are protected with appropriate antivirus and security software.
* Assist in implementing IT security policies and procedures.
* Support regular data backups and recovery procedures.
* Ensure compliance with IT policies and data protection requirements.
* Report suspicious activities, security incidents, and potential vulnerabilities to the IT Manager.

**5. Technology & User Support**

* Provide technical assistance for business applications, digital platforms, and communication systems.
* Troubleshoot audio-visual equipment, projectors, interactive screens, and other devices.
* Assist in setting up IT equipment for meetings, presentations, and corporate events.
* Guide users in the effective use of IT systems and applications.

**6. IT Asset & Inventory Management**

* Maintain an updated inventory of computers, laptops, printers, and other IT equipment.

Title: Chef de service - Données et Intelligence artificielle - Responsable technique - Intégration des systèmes et solutions
Description:
**Appartenir à Air Canada, c’est appartenir à un symbole canadien, Air Canada récemment élue meilleur transporteur aérien en Amérique du Nord. Faites décoller votre carrière en vous joignant à notre équipe novatrice et diversifiée à l’avant-garde du transport aérien de passagers.**
La personne qui occupe le poste de chef de service – Données et Intelligence artificielle dirige l’intégration technique, le déploiement et les capacités de préparation à la production requises pour opérationnaliser des produits, des modèles et des agents d’IA, ainsi que des pipelines de données de soutien dans l’ensemble des environnements d’entreprise d’Air Canada. Elle veille à ce que les solutions d’IA passent d’une architecture et d’une conception technique approuvées à des phases de développement, de tests et de production de manière sécurisée, contrôlée, reproductible et de plus en plus automatisée. Elle dirige les intégrateurs de systèmes d’IA et les spécialistes – Déploiement, établit des modèles d’intégration et de déploiement réutilisables, et travaille avec les équipes de l’ingénierie de l’IA, de l’ingénierie des données, l’ingénierie des plateformes, de l’Architecture, de la Cybersécurité, des opérations infonuagiques et des Opérations de données pour obtenir des résultats de production durables. La personne qui occupe ce poste doit trouver un équilibre entre la rapidité d’ingénierie et la gouvernance d’entreprise, la stabilité opérationnelle, la traçabilité et les contrôles fondés sur les risques.
  
  
**Le poste peut-être basé à Montréal ou Toronto.**
**Responsabilités**

* Diriger l’intégration des systèmes d’IA et gérer les spécialistes responsables de la transition des solutions d’IA de conceptions approuvées vers les environnements de l’entreprise.
* S’assurer que les produits, les modèles, les agents et les API d’IA et les pipelines de données de soutien sont correctement intégrés aux plateformes d’entreprise et aux systèmes en amont et en aval.
* Superviser le déploiement et la configuration des charges de travail liées à l’IA dans l’ensemble des environnements de développement, de mise à l’essai et de production.
* Piloter l’infrastructure en tant que code, les pipelines d’intégration et de déploiement, les modèles relatifs aux opérations d’apprentissage automatique (MLOps) et aux opérations liées aux grands modèles de langage (LLMOps), notamment la promotion des applications et des modèles et la gestion des versions, des replis et de l’environnement.
* Mettre en place des modèles d’intégration, des composants de déploiement, des gabarits et des processus d’automatisation réutilisables afin de réduire les tâches d’ingénierie propres à la solution et d’accélérer l’adoption.
* Collaborer avec les chefs des Produits – Intelligence artificielle, les scientifiques des données, les ingénieurs – Intelligence artificielle, les architectes de solutions, les architectes informatiques de l’entreprise, la Cybersécurité, les opérations infonuagiques, l’ingénierie des plateformes et les Opérations de données pour traduire les conceptions en versions prêtes pour la production.
* Définir et appliquer des critères de préparation à la production, notamment en ce qui concerne la surveillance, la journalisation, les alertes, les guides d’exploitation, la documentation de soutien, les responsabilités opérationnelles et les procédures de récupération.
* S’assurer que les intégrations et les déploiements répondent aux exigences en matière d’architecture, de cybersécurité, d’infrastructure, de gouvernance des données, de protection des renseignements personnels et d’exploitation.
* Mettre en œuvre des contrôles fondés sur les risques et comprenant les points d’approbation humaine appropriés pour les solutions concernant des données sensibles, des modèles d’IA, des agents autonomes ou des décisions d’affaires importantes.
* Diriger la validation technique, la préparation de la mise en service, la vérification après le déploiement et la transition ordonnée vers un soutien opérationnel stable.
* Définir et assurer le suivi des mesures de la réussite des déploiements, de la qualité des intégrations, de l’automatisation, de la fiabilité, des remaniements et de la préparation opérationnelle.
* Déterminer les problèmes récurrents en matière d’intégration et de déploiement et améliorer les pratiques d’ingénierie, les normes et les outils réutilisables en amont.
* Gérer la demande, les priorités, la capacité, les dépendances et les engagements en matière de prestation pour la fonction d’intégration des systèmes d’intelligence artificielle.
* Diriger, encadrer et perfectionner une équipe technique à haut rendement, établir des responsabilités claires et soutenir l’avancement professionnel.
* Assurer le leadership lors de mises en œuvre complexes ou à haut risque et agir à titre de personne-ressource pour les recours hiérarchiques en ce qui concerne les problèmes d’intégration et de déploiement.
* Gérer les relations avec les partenaires technologiques et les fournisseurs externes qui complètent les capacités de prestation internes.
* Maintenir ses connaissances à jour sur les pratiques d’ingénierie liées à l’IA, à l’infonuagique, à l’intégration, au déploiement et à la production, et évaluer leur applicabilité à Air Canada.

**Qualifications**

* Diplôme universitaire en informatique, en ingénierie, en technologie de l’information ou dans un domaine connexe, ou expérience de travail équivalente.
* Au moins sept ans d’expérience en technologies à différents échelons, dont au moins trois ans à un poste de direction d’équipes techniques au sein d’un environnement d’entreprise vaste et complexe.
* Expérience avérée de l’intégration des systèmes, de l’ingénierie infonuagique, de l’ingénierie des plateformes, du développement et de l’exploitation, de la distribution de logiciels ou des activités de production.
* Excellente compréhension des pipelines d’intégration et de déploiement, du contrôle des sources à l’aide de Git, des stratégies d’embranchement, des tests automatisés, de l’infrastructure en tant que code, des pipelines de déploiement et du déploiement dans différents environnements.
* Connaissance pratique des écosystèmes de données et d’IA modernes, notamment Azure, Snowflake, Databricks, Azure DevOps ou GitHub, des plateformes d’orchestration et des outils de déploiement de l’IA et de l’apprentissage automatique.
* Compréhension des concepts relatifs aux opérations d’apprentissage automatique (MLOps) et aux opérations liées aux grands modèles de langage (LLMOps), au déploiement des modèles et des applications, à la gestion des versions, à l’observabilité et à la gestion du cycle de vie de la production.
* Expérience de l’intégration d’API, des pipelines de données, de services infonuagiques, des contrôles de l’identité et des accès, des applications d’entreprise et des composants dirigés par les événements.
* Excellente connaissance des pratiques de l’entreprise en ce qui a trait à l’architecture informatique, à la cybersécurité, aux changements, aux versions et à la gestion des services TI.
* Capacité avérée à établir un équilibre entre la gouvernance, les risques liés à la production et les contrôles, et la rapidité d’exécution et l’automatisation.
* Aptitudes avérées pour le leadership humain, la gestion des parties prenantes, la communication, la prise de décision et la résolution de problèmes.
* Faire preuve de ponctualité et fiabilité avérées pour favoriser la réussite globale de l’équipe dans un milieu trépidant.
* Expérience à un poste critique sur le plan opérationnel dans le secteur de l’aviation ou du transport, ou dans un autre secteur hautement réglementé, un atout.

**Conditions D’emploi**
Les candidats doivent être admissibles à travailler dans le pays concerné au moment où une offre d’emploi est présentée et sont responsables de l’obtention des permis de travail, visas ou autres autorisations nécessaires. La preuve de l’admissibilité doit être fournie avant la date de début.
  
  
**Exigences Linguistiques**

**Diversité et inclusion**
Air Canada est résolument engagée en faveur de la diversité et de l’inclusion et vise à créer un milieu de travail sain, accessible et gratifiant qui met en valeur la contribution unique de nos employés au succès de notre entreprise.
  
  
En tant qu'employeur qui garantit l'égalité d'accès à l'emploi, nous encourageons les candidatures les plus diverses afin de pouvoir nous doter d’un effectif varié et représentatif de nos clients et des communautés où nous vivons et offrons nos services.

Title: Garden Supervisor
Description:
**Job Summary:**

**WORK LOCATION - PRIVATE ISLAND**

The purpose of this job is to plan, organize and provide supervision for the daily operations and activities in assigned projects and oversee the daily organization, utilization and reporting process for manpower, materials, machinery and equipment on site. You will direct and coordinate activities for foremen and workers engaged in landscape, turf and irrigation maintenance according to contract specifications. You will be responsible for the maintenance of all assigned sites, renovation projects, working with and training staff, developing and managing budgets related to maintenance and construction. You will also manage the utilization and maintenance of equipment, machinery, consumables for site operations.

**Key Duties and Responsibilities:**

**Client & Portfolio Management:**

* Act as the primary point of contact for all operational matters relating to the assigned portfolio.
* Ensure all client concerns and inquiries are acknowledged and responded to within 24 hours.
* Investigate client complaints, recommend corrective actions, and ensure timely resolution.
* Maintain effective client relationships and ensure service delivery meets contractual obligations.

**Landscape Maintenance & Site Operations:**

* Conduct regular site inspections to monitor landscape conditions, maintenance activities, and service quality.
* Prepare, review, and update landscape maintenance schedules in accordance with contractual requirements.
* Ensure all maintenance activities comply with agreed specifications, quality standards, and performance expectations.
* Monitor site performance and implement corrective measures to achieve zero KPI deductions.
* Ensure pest and disease control activities comply with applicable regulations and manufacturers' instructions.

**Irrigation Systems Management:**

* Supervise the operation, maintenance, and performance of irrigation systems across assigned portfolios.
* Ensure seasonal programming of irrigation controllers aligns with technical specifications and landscape requirements.
* Oversee the installation, repair, and maintenance of irrigation lines, sprinklers, spray heads, drip lines, controllers, and solenoid valves.
* Monitor water requirements, soil moisture levels, and irrigation efficiency to ensure effective water management.
* Conduct periodic technical training for irrigation teams on water management and irrigation system operations.
* Ensure backflow testing, valve and timer inspections, and irrigation system performance checks are completed and documented.
* Coordinate planned and emergency water shutdowns during irrigation and storm drainage construction, maintenance, and repair activities.

**Sports Turf & Technical Operations:**

* Monitor turf maintenance activities to ensure compliance with applicable technical and contractual specifications.
* Coordinate internal investigations into technical or operational issues affecting turf, landscaping, and irrigation systems.
* Identify operational deficiencies and recommend appropriate corrective and preventive measures.

**Construction & Enhancement Works:**

* Lead and coordinate landscape construction, enhancement, and related improvement projects within the assigned portfolio.
* Ensure all works are executed according to approved schedules, specifications, and quality requirements.
* Coordinate manpower, materials, equipment, and site activities to ensure timely project completion.

**Manpower Supervision & Team Development:**

* Supervise, train, motivate, and monitor operational teams to achieve productivity and service quality targets.
* Allocate responsibilities, establish work schedules, and implement effective working methods.
* Maintain regular one-to-one communication with employees to review performance, address concerns, and provide operational guidance.
* Provide hands-on technical and operational support to site teams whenever required.

**Machinery, Equipment & Resource Management:**

* Assess manpower, machinery, equipment, materials, and supply requirements for assigned operations.
* Coordinate periodic material requisitions, routine purchases, and emergency procurement requirements.
* Ensure all machinery and equipment remain in safe and efficient operating condition.
* Monitor machinery performance and ensure optimum equipment utilisation and operator productivity.
* Implement and monitor preventive maintenance schedules to minimise equipment breakdowns and idle time.
* Report equipment defects, repair requirements, and replacement needs promptly.

**Reporting, Compliance & Administration:**

* Complete / coordinate and provide content for daily operational reports, inspection records, and project documentation in accordance with contractual requirements.
* Maintain accurate records of maintenance activities, irrigation inspections, machinery utilization, and corrective actions.
* Ensure site activities comply with applicable safety requirements, operational procedures, and contractual specifications.
* Perform any additional responsibilities assigned by the Landscape Manager.

Title: Principal, International CX, Amazon Customer Service
Description:
**Description**
Come build the future of international customer experience with us. Every year, millions of customers across Amazon's global stores — from Dubai to São Paulo, Warsaw to Bangalore — experience moments where Amazon falls short. CXI's vision is to ensure every one of them — regardless of where they shop, what language they speak, or whether they ever contact us — gets an experience worthy of Amazon's promise. We do this by holding the most direct and comprehensive view of what's going wrong for customers, and driving the product, policy, and partnership changes that fix it at the root.
  
  
We are looking for a customer-obsessed senior product leader to join us as a Principal within the Customer Experience Improvement org (CXI) within Customer Service. Description:
**# Senior Barista – Atom Specialty Coffee, Dubai**

\*\***Company:**\*\* Atom Brew Cafeteria FZE

\*\***Department:**\*\* Café Operations

\*\***Reports to:**\*\* Café Manager

\*\***Location:**\*\* Dubai, UAE

\*\***Employment type:**\*\* Full-time, shift-based

**## About the Role**

The Senior Barista is the most experienced coffee professional on the bar and the Café Manager's right hand on shift. You will deliver consistently excellent coffee and service in line with Atom's recipes and standards, lead and coach the barista team during service, and support the smooth daily running of the café, including opening and closing, stock, equipment care and food safety compliance. When the Café Manager is away, you will act as shift lead.

**## Key Responsibilities**

**### Coffee Quality and Beverage Preparation**

- Prepare espresso-based, filter, cold and signature beverages to Atom's recipes, presentation and timing standards.

- Dial in espresso and brew recipes at the start of each shift and whenever conditions change; record grind, dose, yield and time.

- Carry out daily sensory checks (taste and calibration) and correct quality issues before drinks reach guests.

- Maintain consistent milk texturing and latte art standards across the team.

- Contribute ideas for seasonal and signature drinks and support menu tastings and launches.

**### Team Leadership and Training**

- Lead the bar during service: allocate stations, manage the drink queue and keep ticket times within standard.

- Train, coach and assess baristas and new joiners on recipes, workflow, equipment and service standards, including support during onboarding.

- Act as shift lead when the Café Manager is absent, escalating issues promptly and handing over clearly at shift change.

- Give the Café Manager regular feedback on team performance, training needs and rota requirements.

- Model Atom's Code of Conduct, punctuality, grooming and uniform standards.

**### Guest Experience**

- Greet and engage guests warmly, share product knowledge and recommend beverages confidently.

- Handle guest feedback and complaints professionally, resolving them on the spot where possible and informing the Café Manager.

- Know menu allergens and dietary information and never guess; check before advising guests.

**### Operations, Stock and Equipment**

- Complete opening and closing procedures and checklists, including bar set-up, cash-up support and handover notes.

- Monitor coffee, milk, syrups and consumables; carry out stock counts, receive deliveries, rotate stock (FIFO) and flag shortages and wastage.

- Clean and maintain espresso machines, grinders and brewers daily (backflushing, burr checks, descaling schedule) and report faults immediately.

- Operate the POS accurately and follow cash handling procedures; discounts, voids and complimentary items only with manager approval.

**### Food Safety, Hygiene and Health & Safety**

- Follow Dubai Municipality food safety requirements and the café's HACCP procedures at all times.

- Keep temperature logs for fridges and chillers, and ensure all items are correctly labelled, dated and stored.

- Maintain a clean-as-you-go bar and ensure the team follows hand-washing, hygiene and safe-working practices.

- Report any accident, near miss, pest sighting or food safety concern to the Café Manager at once.

**## Requirements**

**### Experience and Education**

- Minimum 3 years' barista experience in a specialty coffee or high-volume café, including at least 1 year in a senior, lead or trainer role.

- High school diploma or equivalent; a hospitality qualification is an advantage.

- UAE or GCC café experience preferred.

**### Technical Skills**

- Expert espresso extraction and dial-in skills, with a solid understanding of grind, dose, yield, ratio and brew time.

- Advanced milk texturing and consistent latte art (heart, tulip and rosetta as a minimum).

- Confident with manual brew methods (V60, Chemex, AeroPress, batch brew) and cold brew preparation.

- Good sensory skills: able to identify and correct under- and over-extraction and describe flavour clearly.

- Working knowledge of coffee origins, processing methods and roast profiles.

- Basic equipment maintenance and troubleshooting for espresso machines and grinders.

- Comfortable using POS systems, digital checklists and HR or rota systems.

**### Leadership and Personal Attributes**

- Proven ability to train, motivate and lead a small team during busy service.

- Calm, organised and decisive under pressure, with strong attention to detail.

- Warm, guest-focused personality with excellent communication skills.

- Fluent spoken and written English; Arabic or other languages are an advantage.

- Reliable, punctual and committed to high standards of grooming and hygiene.

- Flexible to work early mornings, evenings, weekends and public holidays according to the rota.

**## Working Conditions**

- Shift-based, hands-on role on the café floor.

- Extended periods of standing, lifting stock of up to 15 kg, and working with hot liquids and equipment.

- Official Atom uniform to be worn and kept clean throughout working hours.

**## Package**

Competitive, commensurate with experience.

**## How to Apply**

Email your CV to \*\*operations@atomshot.ae\*\* with the subject line \*\***"Atom – Senior Barista"**\*\*.

Title: Consultant principal, stratégie et négociations
Description:
**Req Id:**
431929
  
  
Tout part d’une connexion. Elle nous pousse à innover, à explorer et à rester proches de ce qui compte le plus pour nous. Chez Bell, nous bâtissons un avenir plus connecté grâce à des réseaux de calibre mondial, à des solutions propulsées par l’IA et à des expériences numériques qui améliorent la façon dont les gens vivent, travaillent et se divertissent chaque jour.
  
  
Nous croyons à l’autonomisation de chacun. C’est pourquoi nous dotons nos équipes d’une technologie de pointe, d’outils d’IA et d’un environnement collaboratif qui soutient la créativité et la croissance. Voulez-vous faire partie d’une équipe diversifiée où votre travail a un réel impact? Si vous êtes inspiré par l’innovation qui fait progresser la façon dont les gens se connectent et transforme ce qui est possible, vous avez votre place au sein de l’#ÉquipeBell.
  
  
Au sein de l’équipe Bell Marchés Affaires, vous jouerez un rôle essentiel en matière d’innovation pour notre clientèle d’entreprises. Vous livrerez des solutions évoluées dans des domaines comme l’Internet des objets, la mobilité et la 5G, l’infonuagique, la cybersécurité, les services vocaux, la collaboration et les centres de contact, ainsi que l’Internet et les réseaux privés.
  
  
Vos compétences et votre expertise aideront Bell à se démarquer alors que nous restons le premier fournisseur de connexions numériques et de services de prochaine génération pour les entreprises et les gouvernements.
  
  
**À propos du poste**
À titre de Gestionnaire principal, négociations stratégiques, vous agirez comme conseiller(ère) stratégique auprès de l’équipe de direction d’IA tissé, en contribuant à l’avancement des priorités commerciales, opérationnelles et de croissance les plus importantes de l’entreprise. En combinant une approche structurée de résolution de problèmes, d’excellentes compétences en communication auprès des dirigeants et un leadership transversal, vous soutiendrez les décisions clés liées aux occasions clients et locataires, à la priorisation des sites, à la planification de la capacité, aux présentations destinées à la haute direction, aux relations gouvernementales et à la performance de l’entreprise.
  
  
Une responsabilité essentielle du rôle consistera à aider la direction à déterminer quels locataires et clients doivent être attribués à quels sites, en équilibrant la demande des clients, la disponibilité de l’alimentation électrique, les exigences en matière de connectivité, le niveau de préparation des sites, les considérations économiques, les échéanciers, la valeur stratégique et les risques d’exécution.
  
  
**Principales responsabilités**

* Gérer et améliorer continuellement le pipeline des occasions clients et locataires d’IA tissé, en assurant le suivi de l’avancement commercial, des dépendances clés, des risques et des prochaines étapes.
* Élaborer des recommandations et des cadres décisionnels afin d’aider la direction à prioriser les clients, les locataires, les sites, les investissements et les occasions stratégiques.
* Agir à titre de partenaire de réflexion de confiance auprès des dirigeants en appliquant des méthodes structurées de résolution de problèmes et des analyses fondées sur les données pour relever des défis d’affaires complexes.
* Diriger des analyses stratégiques à fort impact, des analyses de rentabilité, des exercices de planification par scénarios et le soutien à la prise de décision exécutive concernant les priorités les plus critiques de l’entreprise.
* Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes des ventes, des partenariats, des finances, des affaires juridiques, de l’immobilier, du réseau, des opérations ainsi qu’avec les dirigeants afin de favoriser l’alignement et d’accélérer l’exécution.
* Identifier les goulots d’étranglement, les risques et les enjeux interfonctionnels, recommander de façon proactive des solutions et en assurer la résolution.
* Diriger l’élaboration de documents d’information pour le chef de la direction, de présentations au conseil d’administration, de présentations gouvernementales, de présentations destinées aux dirigeants et de communications aux parties prenantes.
* Traduire des informations complexes en recommandations concises et orientées vers la prise de décision, en mettant en évidence les principales occasions, les risques, les compromis et les actions à entreprendre.
* Soutenir les échanges avec les hauts dirigeants de Bell, les intervenants gouvernementaux, les clients, les partenaires, les investisseurs et les leaders de l’écosystème.
* Faire preuve d’une discipline exceptionnelle en gestion de projet dans le cadre d’initiatives rapides et ambiguës, en veillant à ce que les priorités demeurent sur la bonne voie et que les livrables critiques soient exécutés efficacement.
* Mettre en place une gouvernance claire, une responsabilisation accrue et des mécanismes de fonctionnement qui améliorent la visibilité, la prise de décision et l’exécution à l’échelle de l’organisation.
* Accroître la vitesse d’exécution en réduisant l’ambiguïté, en favorisant l’alignement et en veillant à ce que les priorités critiques progressent efficacement.

**Qualifications Essentielles**

* De 4 à 8 ans d’expérience en conseil en gestion, en stratégie, en opérations, en infrastructures, en technologie, en télécommunications ou dans d’autres environnements à haute performance.
* Succès démontré dans le soutien à des cadres supérieurs au sein de contextes dynamiques, ambigus et à fort enjeu.
* Excellentes compétences en exécution et en gestion de projet, avec un historique démontré de réalisation d’initiatives complexes.
* Solides aptitudes en résolution de problèmes, notamment pour structurer l’ambiguïté, identifier les causes profondes et concevoir des solutions pragmatiques, évolutives et légères en processus.
* Expérience dans la direction de programmes interfonctionnels, la production de rapports destinés aux dirigeants, la gestion de pipelines critiques pour l’entreprise, de tableaux de bord et de priorités stratégiques.
* Capacité à synthétiser des situations complexes en constats, recommandations et actions clairs.
* Curiosité, grande capacité d’apprentissage et intérêt marqué pour les outils d’intelligence artificielle favorisant la productivité et la prise de décision.
* Le bilinguisme français-anglais est considéré comme un atout.

**Qualifications Souhaitées**

* Expérience de soutien auprès d’équipes de direction, de comités exécutifs, de conseils d’administration, d’instances gouvernementales ou de programmes interfonctionnels d’envergure.
* Expérience dans la gestion de pipelines liés aux clients, aux activités commerciales, aux ventes, aux partenariats, aux investissements, aux locataires ou aux occasions d’affaires.
* Une exposition aux domaines des infrastructures, de l’intelligence artificielle, des télécommunications, de l’énergie, de l’immobilier, des politiques publiques, des technologies d’entreprise, des réseaux, de la connectivité ou des partenariats commerciaux constitue un atout, sans être obligatoire.
* Expérience dans la préparation de présentations destinées aux dirigeants, de documents d’information pour le chef de la direction, de documents à l’intention des gouvernements, de tableaux de bord ou de mises à jour stratégiques.
* Intérêt démontré pour l’intelligence artificielle, les infrastructures numériques, la compétitivité nationale ou le développement d’entreprises à grande échelle.

Title: Clerk - Health
Description:
Clerk - Health

JobID: 14850

  
* + Position Type:  
    Classified/Secretarial/Clerical/Health

    11/10/2026
  + Location:  
    CLOVER CREEK ELEM

  **THIS POSITION IS FOR 7 HOURS PER DAY AT 176 DAYS PER YEAR AND 3.5 HOURS PER DAY AT 12 DAYS PER YEAR.**  
  **PAY FOR POSITION: PSE Salary Schedule Level 5- $ 25.40**  
    
  **Description:**  
  If you are a current employee please apply through the "Internal" link found at the top of this page (this does not include substitutes).  
    
  This position's responsibilities are to provide a wide variety of support to the school nurse by maintaining student health records, assessing the health needs of students; first aid; health screenings; dispensing of oral medication; catheterization; EpiPen injection for emergencies; nebulizer treatments; and gastrostomy tube feedings. Other responsibilities include maintaining computer records and lists, securing required health records from parents, maintaining health room supplies and providing a variety of clerical support to the school office.  
    
  ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS  
  Depending upon the individual assignment, the Clerk - Health may perform all or a combination of the following:  
    
  1. Maintains student health records; creates new records; updates health information; ensures that health records are maintained in confidential manner.  
    
  2. Attends to student health needs; assesses injuries or illness to determine appropriate action; provides basic first aid; refers students to health care professionals as needed. Determines need for nurse's advice; calls nurse for assistance as necessary; provides school nurse with list of referrals; may call for emergency assistance. Informs school nurse and principal of severe injury, illness, unexcused absence, or unusual incident. As needed, checks students for head lice; contacts parents as appropriate.  
    
  3. Administers medication to students as directed by physician, according to district policy procedures and under supervision of a nurse. Maintains appropriate records.  
    
  4. Gathers, assesses and records immunization information; gathers health data for a variety of state reports, such as for scoliosis and immunization. Contacts parents or schools as needed to secure health records and immunization compliance in accordance with district procedures and time lines. Maintains documentation of parental contacts. Prepares forms for reporting purposes.  
    
  5. Compiles health records, cards and lists; provides reports as requested. Maintains health room log. Completes accident reports and distributes them appropriately. Compiles, updates, and distributes health concerns information.  
    
  6. Records health screening results for each student. Is responsible for organizing health screenings.  
    
  7. May maintain student attendance records; track attendance, tardies and suspension data; verify and process student absence excuses; may maintain and report lunch count; informs administrator, school nurse, and/or parents of student absences.  
    
  8. Maintains inventory of health room supplies; prepares supply orders; receives, verifies and stocks supplies.  
    
  9. Monitors student behavior in the health room; corrects behavior as necessary; monitors individual health room use to prevent abuses. May train and supervise student assistants.  
    
  10. Reports situations such as pregnancy, substance abuse or physical abuse to appropriate school staff for follow-up. Maintains confidentiality of student personal problems.  
    
  11. Attends scheduled health clerk meetings/in-service.  
    
  OTHER FUNCTIONS  
    
  12. May, in conjunction with school nurse, provide information to parents about health issues.  
    
  13. Provides a variety of clerical support to the school office such as answering telephones, filing, performing computer input and typing. Provides a variety of backup and peak load assistance and coverage in the school office.  
    
  14. May process student enrollments and withdrawals; sends for and receives student records; maintains student records; may process teacher grade reports; may provide a variety of clerical support to school counselors, including scheduling appointments and meetings, compiling data for reports, typing scholarship recommendations, college applications and other student information.  
    
  15. May serve on various district committees and/or departmental work teams. Models appropriate and cooperative behavior, including protecting confidential information, consistent with district ethical guidelines.  
    
  16. Performs related duties consistent with the scope and intent of the position.  
    
  REPORTING RELATIONSHIPS  
  Reports to assigned building administrator; receives lead guidance from school nurse for delivery of health services.  
    
  MENTAL DEMANDS  
  Experiences frequent interruptions; required to deal with a wide range of student behaviors and academic abilities, which may include distraught or difficult students; may be required to deal with distraught or difficult parents. Frequently required to deal with situations that could put them in position of liability. Works under the direction of itinerant school nurse.  
    
  PHYSICAL DEMANDS  
  Record keeping requires substantial visual concentration; exposed to visual display terminals; potentially exposed to ordinary infectious diseases carried by students; occasionally required to attend to students' personal hygiene; required to take precautions to avoid exposure to student bodily fluids, disinfectants and medications. May be required to move ill or injured students.  
    
  MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS  
    
  Education and Experience  
  Education, training, skills, and experience necessary to carry out the assignment, including experience maintaining accurate records. Health care experience or training strongly preferred.  
    
  Allowable Substitutions  
  Not applicable.  
    
  Required Knowledge, Skills and Abilities  
  Demonstrated record keeping skills. Ability to communicate effectively, orally and in writing. Familiarity with medical terminology and basic medical procedures. Keyboarding skill. Ability to deal with students in a warm and confident manner. Ability to work effectively as a team member and collaborate in providing services to students. Problem-solving and decision-making skills. Ability to organize activities and work independently. Ability to follow and give instructions. Ability to learn and apply a variety of health techniques and procedures. Ability to be fair and consistent when working with students. Ability to screen and treat minor student illnesses and injuries. Ability to evaluate the need for and secure medical attention by trained personnel. Ability to administer medication as directed. Ability to handle crises effectively. Ability to maintain strict confidentiality. Ability to supervise and correct student behavior. Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with staff, students and parents.  
    
  Licenses/Special Requirements  
  Requires fingerprinting and background check to determine that there have been no convictions involving physical molestation, abuse, injury or neglect of a minor. Must complete training in and adhere to district infection control plan. Requires first aid and CPR certification. Hepatitis B Immunization is offered.

  Secretarial/Clerical
