Title: Principal (IT/Digital) | BCG Platinion
Description:
**Locations**
: Doha | Saudi Arabia
  
  
Who We Are
  
  
The Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.
  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures-and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
  
  
**About BCG Platinion**
BCG Platinion's presence spans across the globe, with offices in Asia, Europe, and South and North America. We achieve digital excellence for clients with sustained solutions to the most complex and time-sensitive challenge. We guide clients into the future to push the status quo, overcome tech limitations, and enable our clients to go further in their digital journeys than what has ever been possible in the past. At BCG Platinion, we deliver business value through the innovative use of technology at a rapid pace. We roll up our sleeves to transform business, revolutionize approaches, satisfy customers, and change the game through Architecture, Cybersecurity, Digital Transformation, Enterprise Application and Risk functions. We balance vision with a pragmatic path to change transforming strategies into leading-edge tech platforms, at scale.
  
  
**Practice Area**
BCG Platinion launched in Germany in 2000 to add deep technical expertise to the Boston Consulting Group’s existing capabilities. Today, our presence spans across the globe, with offices in Asia, Europe, and South and North America. Our New York-based North American team began in 2014 and in 2017 acquired MAYA Design, a Pittsburgh-based digital design and innovation lab, to grow our capabilities around technology and design.
  
  
We support our clients’ total digital transformation through technology, design, cybersecurity, and risk management & financial engineering capabilities. And together with BCG, BCG Platinion’s interdisciplinary team of technical experts enable customized technical solutions and accelerate delivery value through new business platforms, application consolidations, and major system implementations.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
As a Principal IT/Digital in the Energy Practice, you will work closely with our client's leadership teams to understand their key challenges, define IT strategies, win buy-in for your recommendations and lead fellow BCG case team members to transform client potential into performance with high-impact assignments. You will deploy customized IT strategies, digital platforms and architecture in order to leverage the digital potential of our customers in order to deliver long lasting value. You will evaluate and coach our clients' technology teams, manage quality and risk while maintaining client expectations and escalations. Besides the functional guidance of the project team you will also be operationally responsible for the execution and management of the solution. Together with our clients you will develop convincing IT strategies, concepts and solutions that have a lasting impact on the organization, operating model, digital, and/or data landscape.
  
  
You will manage diverse teams of consulting talent. Your role will be to help those teams flourish by provoking thought, team mentoring, knowledge sharing, giving frequent feedback and creating opportunities for team members to learn and grow. You will also personally develop and grow by being exposed to new and complex challenges daily.
  
  
Clients will also seek your advice as a thought leader on business issues that extend beyond the immediate scope of you project work. Finally as a Principal you will contribute to the Practice Area development and help to strengthen the BCG Platinion brand as a AI and digital leader.
  
  
**YOU’RE GOOD AT**

* Driving results in complex environments
* Solving business and technology problems
* Building strong client relationships
* Leading and developing teams
* Communicating complex topics clearly
* Collaborating across teams

What You'll Bring
  
  

* 8–12+ years in IT consulting or digital transformation
* Experience in Energy sector (e.g., Oil & Gas, Petrochemicals)
* Track record in IT transformation delivery
* Expertise in IT/ Digital architecture, cloud, data & AI topics
* Strong leadership and stakeholder management
* Excellent academic degree
* Excellent English communication skills, Arabic is a plus.

Who You'll Work With
  
  
You will work in a collaborative environment with continuous development opportunities, growing toward Director-level roles while deepening expertise in Energy and IT/ digital transformation.
  
  
Additional info
  
  
**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY**
Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer
  
  
Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

Title: Systems Administrator
Description:
**Systems Administrator**
=========================

**Job Summary**
---------------

**Title** - Systems Administrator

**Department** - Client Support Services

**Type** - Full-time, permanent, salaried

**Reports to** - CTO

**Location** - Downtown Toronto office, with occasional client site work

As a Systems Administrator at Business Cloud, you are responsible for the security, availability, and recoverability of the systems our clients depend on across a portfolio of Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace environments. You remediate security findings, keep servers and network infrastructure patched and supported, verify that backups can be restored, and maintain consistent configuration across cloud tenants, identity, and endpoint management platforms.

Much of this work is proactive and does not start with a ticket. You find configuration drift, unresolved findings, and maintenance gaps through routine review, and you close them through direct work, automation, or coordination with other teams. Support handles frontline user issues; you own system-level problems and outages.

Your work falls into three areas:

* **Reactive**: Responding to security alerts and system-level escalations
* **Maintenance**: Carrying out recurring maintenance such as patching, backup verification, and monitoring review
* **Improvement**: Delivering small non-billable changes, cleanup, and automation that make environments easier to manage

Most work is performed remotely from our downtown Toronto office, with occasional on-site work for servers and network equipment. The role is client-facing. Some maintenance windows fall outside standard business hours.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Security and Incident Response**: Triage and remediate security findings and alerts from managed detection and response, Microsoft Defender, and endpoint security tools. Lead technical containment, eradication, and recovery during security incidents, preserving evidence and documenting findings and follow-up actions.
* **Backup and Business Continuity**: Administer backup and continuity platforms, verify coverage and job health, and resolve problems. Perform and document testing, confirm restore readiness before major changes, and escalate continuity risks that cannot be resolved technically.
* **Server Administration and Lifecycle**: Administer physical and virtual servers, including domain controllers, Hyper-V and VMware, directory synchronization, and remote and break-glass access. Coordinate patching and maintenance, validate service health, and plan upgrades.
* **Network, DNS, and Certificates**: Administer firewalls, switches, wireless, and VPN infrastructure across different environments, including firmware and alert response. Manage DNS zones, mail authentication records, and certificate renewals.
* **Cloud Platforms and Identity**: Administer client cloud environments, primarily Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace, along with Azure and related services, keeping tenant configuration, identity, and access policies consistent and secure. Manage privileged and emergency access through a documented, controlled process.
* **Endpoint Management Platforms**: Administer endpoint management platforms such as Intune and our RMM to keep managed devices patched, compliant, and protected.
* **Health and Documentation**: Monitor for configuration drift and correct it. Conduct proactive environment reviews and cleanup efforts. Own small non-billable changes. Maintain current documentation of systems, configurations, and their relevant procedures.
* **Reporting and Automation**: Maintain and leverage reporting to automate repetitive checks and administrative tasks.
* Other duties as required.

**How do we define success for your role?**
-------------------------------------------

* Security findings and alerts are triaged promptly and tracked to resolution, with an owner and status for anything left open.
* Patching runs on a predictable schedule, and servers or devices that are behind or nearing end of support are known and documented, not discovered during an incident.
* Backups are monitored, failures are resolved quickly, and restore tests are performed and recorded on a regular schedule.
* Monitoring alerts have an owner and are acted on, and certificates and domains are renewed before they expire.
* Client environments move steadily toward our standards, with drift found through routine review and exceptions documented.
* Documentation is current enough that a colleague can pick up your work.
* Recurring manual checks are progressively replaced with reporting and automation.
* You contribute to an inclusive, engaging work environment and continue developing your expertise.

**Your Experience and Education**
---------------------------------

* 3+ years of systems administration experience, preferably supporting multiple clients or sites.
* Hands-on experience with Windows Server, Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, and Hyper-V or VMware.
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft 365 and Entra ID, or equivalent depth in Google Workspace.
* Experience with endpoint management through Intune or a remote monitoring and management (RMM) platform.
* Working knowledge of networking, including firewalls, VLANs, VPN, and wireless.
* Understanding of security fundamentals, including access control, patching, and responding to security alerts.
* Experience administering backup systems and troubleshooting backup failures.
* Working knowledge of PowerShell or a similar scripting language.
* Strong troubleshooting, documentation, and written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues to clients.
* Availability for occasional after-hours maintenance.
* Post-secondary education in a related field, or equivalent experience.

**Preferred Experience**
------------------------

* Experience at an MSP.
* Experience administering both Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace.
* Experience with managed detection and response tools or incident response.
* Experience with cloud-managed network platforms such as Meraki or UniFi.
* Experience managing macOS and mobile devices.
* Experience performing restore tests or disaster recovery exercises.
* Experience building reporting or automation to replace manual checks.
* Familiarity with platforms such as Zendesk and Hudu, and with client-managed products such as password managers, VoIP, and phishing awareness tools.
* Relevant certifications, such as Microsoft 365 or Azure Administrator, Google Workspace Administrator, or networking certifications.
* A valid driver's licence and access to a vehicle.

**Why Business Cloud?**
-----------------------

Business Cloud is a rapidly growing managed technology service provider focused on delivering cloud-first business technology solutions to small and medium-sized organizations across Canada. As a proud partner of Google Cloud and Microsoft, we take full ownership of our clients' technology environments to ensure reliability, security, and efficiency.

Our core values reflect our commitment to growth and service:

* Growth and Development
* Ownership and Leadership
* Respect, Empathy, and Customer First
* Prevention and Proactivity

Our team's backgrounds and experiences vary, but effective communication, continual learning, and a passion for customer service are the common components of our success. If you believe you are the ideal candidate for this position, please apply and tell us why Business Cloud is the right fit for you.

**How can I stand out in my application?**
------------------------------------------

Please consider attaching a tailored cover letter. We view this as an opportunity to tell us why you are the right fit for the position and our organization.

Title: Telecom OSS Architect / Designer
Description:
At Capgemini Engineering, the world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the world’s most innovative companies unleash their potential. From autonomous cars to life-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R&D and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days are the same.
  
  
Your Role
  
  
As a
**Telecom OSS Architect / Designer**
, you will be a senior technical authority within our Connectivity & Network Engineering practice, leading the architecture and design of complex OSS solutions for major telecoms clients in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. You will bridge the gap between business requirements and technical delivery, working closely with client stakeholders, engineering teams, and vendor partners to define and implement best-in-class OSS ecosystems.
  
  
In this role you will play a key role in:
  
  

* Leading end-to-end OSS architecture and design across Network Inventory Management, Performance Management, and Fault/Event Management domains — defining solution blueprints, integration frameworks, and technical roadmaps aligned to client business objectives and industry best practices such as TM Forum frameworks (eTOM, TAM, SID).
* Driving the design and implementation of Network Inventory solutions, including physical, logical, and service inventory modelling, ensuring accurate and real-time representation of network assets across multi-vendor, multi-technology environments (2G/3G/4G/5G, Fixed, IP/MPLS).
* Architecting Performance and Fault Management solutions, overseeing the design of KPI frameworks, threshold management, alarm correlation, and root cause analysis capabilities — enabling proactive network operations and minimising service impact for telecoms operators.
* Engaging directly with senior client stakeholders to gather and translate complex business and operational requirements into detailed technical specifications, solution architectures, and HLD/LLD documentation, acting as a trusted advisor throughout the solution lifecycle.
* Leading and governing OSS integration design, defining interfaces and APIs between OSS platforms and adjacent systems including BSS, NMS, EMS, and emerging cloud-native network management platforms — ensuring seamless data flows and operational continuity across the network operations ecosystem.
* Providing technical leadership and mentoring to a team of OSS engineers and designers, conducting design reviews, driving quality assurance of technical deliverables, and ensuring architectural consistency and compliance with agreed standards across project workstreams.
* Supporting pre-sales and solutioning activities, contributing to RFP/RFI responses, technical proposals, and solution demonstrations — bringing deep domain expertise to help shape and win new opportunities across the KSA and wider Middle East telecoms market.

Your Profile
  
  
We are looking for a highly experienced and driven Telecom OSS Architect who combines deep technical expertise with strong leadership capability and a collaborative approach.
  
  
Technical Skills & Experience:
  
  

* 12+ years of experience in the telecommunications industry, with a strong focus on OSS architecture, design, and delivery — including proven expertise in at least two of the following domains: Network Inventory Management, Performance Management, and Fault/Event Management systems, ideally in large-scale, multi-vendor operator environments.
* Deep hands-on knowledge of OSS platforms and tools, such as IBM Tivoli Netcool, Nokia NetAct, Ericsson ENM/ENIQ, Huawei iMAC/U2000, Comarch OSS, or similar — combined with strong understanding of OSS/BSS integration patterns, mediation layers, and data modelling techniques for telecoms network domains.
* Strong grounding in TM Forum standards and frameworks (eTOM, TAM, SID/ODA) and familiarity with relevant industry standards including 3GPP, ETSI, IETF, and TMN — with the ability to apply these frameworks pragmatically in real-world solution design and architecture.
* Solid experience with integration technologies and APIs including REST/SOAP web services, TMF Open APIs, OSS/J, XML/JSON data formats, and middleware platforms — with the ability to architect robust, scalable, and secure integration solutions between OSS components and broader network management ecosystems.
* Proficiency in producing high-quality architecture and design artefacts, including Solution Architecture Documents, HLDs, LLDs, interface control documents, data flow diagrams, and operational runbooks — with experience presenting these at both technical and executive levels.

**What You'll Love About Working Here**
**Dedicated Innovation Labs**
– We help the world's largest innovators engineer the products and services of tomorrow by leveraging our experts and labs, dedicated to topics such as 5G, 6G, AI, Autonomous Vehicles and Quantum. As a Telecom OSS Architect at Capgemini Engineering, you will be at the heart of this innovation — shaping the next generation of network operations for some of the world's leading operators.
  
  
**Career Acceleration Programs**
– From associate to leaders and beyond, get support in your career at every stage with award-winning programs such as our leadership development program, Connected Manager, to accelerate your growth and develop your expertise. With 12+ years of experience, you'll have access to programmes designed specifically to take senior engineers to the next level.
  
  
**Worldwide Leader of Engineering Services**
– Capgemini Engineering combines its broad industry knowledge and cutting-edge technologies in digital and software to support the convergence of the physical and digital worlds. We help our clients unleash their R&D potential to develop the smart products and services of tomorrow — and you will play a central role in that mission in the KSA market.
  
  
**Engineering Horizons**
– A global conference crafted exclusively for Capgemini Engineering colleagues, where excellence takes centre stage. Immerse yourself in opportunities to showcase your talents and connect with the brightest minds in engineering across the planet — building your professional network and visibility on a truly global stage.
  
  
Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. It is a responsible and diverse group of 340,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong over 55-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. It delivers end-to-end services and solutions leveraging strengths from strategy and design to engineering, all fueled by its market leading capabilities in AI, generative AI, cloud and data, combined with its deep industry expertise and partner ecosystem.

Title: Principal, Security, Cyber & Resilience Consulting
Description:
This is a senior, high-profile opportunity for an accomplished consulting leader to build and grow an integrated security, cyber and resilience consulting practice in the Middle East. The role combines the commercial ownership, client impact and intellectual challenge of a leading professional services environment with the opportunity to shape strategy, develop new propositions, mobilise multidisciplinary teams and lead complex assignments from boardroom advice through implementation.

Working in close partnership with relevant Consulting leaders, local leadership and specialists across Control Risks, the successful candidate will originate, win and lead engagements across physical security, cyber and digital risk, crisis management, business continuity and organisational resilience. A key part of the role will be connecting these disciplines, recognising where physical, digital and operational risks converge and bringing together the right expertise to address clients' most significant risk and resilience challenges.

The role does not require equal technical depth across every discipline. The successful candidate is expected to bring recognised expertise in at least one core area, together with sufficient breadth across the wider portfolio to engage credibly with senior clients, identify and shape opportunities, lead integrated engagements and know when specialist expertise is required.

**Requirements**
**What You'll Do:**

Practice Management & Project

* Recommend a clear direction for the Middle East security, cyber and resilience consulting practice, identifying priority markets, propositions and client needs and creating the conditions for consultants and specialists across disciplines to contribute their best work.
* Advise senior clients on complex physical security, cyber and digital risk, crisis management, business continuity and organisational resilience challenges, translating technical and operational risks into practical recommendations for executive decisionmakers.
* Shape and implement our business strategy with the key EMEA Consulting Partners, translating shared priorities into a focused market, capability and delivery plan. Ensure that cyber and digital risk form a meaningful part of the practice's growth agenda alongside established security, crisis and resilience capabilities.
* Lead complex, multidisciplinary risk and resilience engagements, bringing together the right combination of physical security, cyber and digital risk, crisis management, business continuity, intelligence and industry expertise. Act as the senior client adviser and engagement leader, providing direction and challenge while enabling specialist workstream leaders to own technical delivery and contribute to key decisions.
* Accountability to Advisory & Risk Consulting leadership as required for leading the delivery of the full range of engagements across ME from bid to close out, ensuring profitability and quality standards are met.
* Demonstrate strong consulting and technical judgement in the management and delivery of complex client engagements, providing effective challenge to specialist teams and ensuring that technical findings are translated into clear business implications and actionable recommendations.
* Act as senior sponsor or engagement leader for significant cyber and digital risk assignments, working with specialist teams to shape the approach, challenge findings and ensure recommendations address the client's wider operational, resilience and business priorities.

Business Development and Account Management

* Grow priority accounts with account managers, local leadership and subject-matter experts, developing trusted relationships with senior business, security, risk and technology decisionmakers and converting client challenges into integrated consulting opportunities.
* Own a qualified sales pipeline from prospecting and qualification through scoping, proposal development, negotiation and close, with accountability for profitable conversion across the security, cyber and resilience portfolio.
* Develop the regional market for cyber and digital risk consulting, particularly where technology risk intersects with operational resilience, crisis preparedness, third-party risk, physical security and executive decision-making.
* Identify opportunities to extend established physical security, crisis and resilience relationships into cyber and digital risk work, and equally use cyber-led relationships to introduce clients to broader security and resilience capabilities.
* Building and expanding on an existing strong personal network of relationships with potential work providers and the key influencers within target corporates.
* Continuously seeking to build Control Risks' presence in the marketplace.
* Increasing visibility and credibility for the practice through driving repeat engagements with existing clients, new engagements with prospective clients or referrals from other Control Risks service lines.
* Displaying an ability to take experience from engagements and consider whether the approach or issues are replicable with other clients. Building a plan to target those clients.

Brand and Reputation

* Be a visible external representative of Control Risks' physical security, cyber and resilience consulting capabilities across the Middle East, strengthening the firm's credibility with clients, partners and market influencers
* Position Control Risks as a trusted adviser to organisations managing increasingly interconnected physical, digital and operational risks, from strategic risk assessment and preparedness through transformation, crisis response and recovery.
* Build trusted relationships with decisionmakers and senior colleagues across the regional and global business, inviting challenge, sharing insight and creating opportunities to pursue and deliver work together.

Practice Development

* Ensure regional service delivery standards are implemented and maintained.
* Attract, develop and retain a high-performing consulting team, combining clear expectations with coaching, constructive challenge and visible support for colleagues' growth.
* As part of the EMEA leadership team, contribute to the development of the regional and global strategy and plans.
* Coach, mentor and provide real-time feedback to team members, strengthening technical capability, consulting skills and commercial judgement.
* Work with regional and global specialists to strengthen the Middle East proposition, ensuring that the practice can access appropriate technical capability, methodologies and specialist delivery capacity as client demand develops.

**Who You Are:**

* At least 10 years' experience in a Big Four, leading management consultancy, specialist risk consultancy or other top-tier professional-services environment, with a strong track record in cyber and digital risk, physical security, crisis and resilience, or closely related risk transformation work.
* Recognised depth and credibility in at least one of these disciplines, together with demonstrable experience working across adjacent areas and leading multidisciplinary client engagements.
* Deep understanding of the ME operating environment.
* Demonstrated success in leading consultative sales conversations, shaping ambiguous client needs into compelling scopes and mobilising colleagues to convert opportunities into profitable work.
* An established market network and external profile that support credible senior-level engagement and business development, with the ability to develop relationships beyond their primary area of technical expertise.
* Strong understanding of how physical security, resilience, crisis preparedness, business continuity, third-party risk intersects with cyber and digital risk and with and executive decision-making.
* The role does not require technical practitioner-level expertise across every physical security, crisis, cyber and resilience discipline. Candidates should bring depth in at least one of these areas, combined with sufficient breadth and consulting judgement to shape integrated client solutions, provide senior oversight, challenge technical outputs and mobilise specialist expertise effectively.
* Knowledge of leading practice in resilience, risk and security strategy, crisis preparedness, business continuity and decision-making under pressure. Knowledge of data-driven approaches and the impact of AI on resilience.
* Experience advising boards, executive committees and senior executives, combining rigorous analysis with practical, commercially relevant recommendations and drawing on specialist input where it improves the outcome.
* Experience operating in regulated or critical infrastructure environments or advising clients on complex technology and operational resilience challenges.
* Ability to structure, visualise and communicate strategic thinking clearly and persuasively.
* Business-level proficiency in English.

PREFERRED:

* Master's degree.
* Fluent Arabic speaking and writing.

**Role Description:**

The Water Services Worker 08 CDL performs predetermined tasks to support the operation and maintenance of the water supply system. Major activities include, but not limited to, assisting in the repair and installation of mains, service lines, taps, valve, and hydrant replacement/repair and investigations under the direct guidance of a higher graded worker or Foreman.

**Essential Duties & Responsibilities:**

Performs various manual tasks, as directed by a Foreman, or higher graded worker, to support the general maintenance, repair, and replacement activities of the water distribution system.  

Assists in the performance of preventative maintenance and emergency repair and replacement of mains, service lines, taps, valves, and hydrants.

Participates in the performance of repair and maintenance activities.

Uses plats and maps to assist in locating water mains.  

Participates in the installation of copper service fines from the tap to the property line.  

Provides assistance in adjusting frames, covers, meter housing, curb boxes or other appurtenances to grade.  

Participates in the replacement and maintenance of valves, curb cocks and water service pipes that are damaged or obstructed; and in the replacement of meter 2/4 and connection leaks.  

Operates the Authority's fixtures to facilitate pressure tests, flushing, disinfection tests, main and service activations, charging and draining of mains, cross-connection inspections, flow tests and other system related activities.  

Cleans and restores worksites after jobs are completed to ensure that the work are left in a neat, safe, and acceptable condition.  

Directs traffic control and arranges safety barriers and safety signals.  

Complies with applicable safety rules and regulations including the construction and assembly of shoring devices in excavations and utilization of standard and job-specific safety equipment.  

Operates power and mechanical toots and equipment, such as air compressors, jackhammers, leak detection devices, valve operators, etc.  

Operates a variety of vehicles and equipment including dump trucks (with trailers), crew cabs, pick-up trucks and vans.

Title: Principal, AI Data Centres
Description:
**THE ROLE: FROM PARTNERSHIP TO CAPACITY IN SERVICE**
Reporting to the Chief Executive Officer, you lead Echelon’s infrastructure partnerships and the business built on them: the partners Echelon builds with, the customer programmes it delivers with them, the capability it develops alongside them and the investment cases behind new capacity. You decide where Echelon advises and where it builds with its partners, and you make each of those positions pay, working with the CRO’s account teams, Finance and Legal. You build the team from its first hires and lead it, and you set the model by which Echelon and its partners work together.
  
  

* Anchor the partnerships: Long-term relationships with the operators and suppliers whose designs and standards Echelon builds on, run with a shared plan, clear commitments and governance that holds both sides to them.
* Win at programme scale: Large capacity programmes won with our partners and structured across their whole life rather than one site at a time, on terms that reward Echelon for the value it adds.
* Widen the pipeline: The next customers that need capacity, from AI providers and hyperscalers to national programmes and large enterprises, and the next partners that extend what Echelon can deliver.
* Build the team and the model: The team you hire and lead, and the operating model around it: what Echelon does itself, what its partners do and what it buys, the cost and the governance, and the moment capability should come in-house.
* Hold the standard: Quality gates, operating procedures and liability lines, agreed with our partners, that bring every site Echelon touches up to the benchmark of the best operators.
* Grow the capability: An Echelon team that learns alongside its partners and grows from engineering and build management into network, security and facility operations.
* Build the investment case: The business cases behind new capacity, from demand, power and the chip-generation ramp to capital structure, offtake and returns, built to hold up in front of customers, partners and investors.

**WHERE WE ALIGN**
AI AND TECHNOLOGY FIRST
  
  

* Infrastructure record: You have built or led data centre, cloud or power programmes, for an operator, a developer, a hyperscaler or the firms that advise them. What you have delivered counts for more than the years.
* Partnership leadership: You have led partnerships between companies of different size and culture, and kept both sides committed from signature to delivery.
* Commercial and financial depth: You structure deals and read a project model: capital and operating cost, revenue share, offtake and returns hold no mystery for you.
* AI infrastructure depth: You understand what AI workloads change: power density, liquid cooling, the pace of chip generations, and their effect on design, cost and schedule.
* Team builder: You have hired and led teams of specialists, built a capability from its first hire and its first project, and set standards that hold as it scales.

STRONG ADVANTAGE
  
  

* Hyperscale and AI campuses: Exposure to campuses of 100 MW and above, from site and power to handover and operations.
* Licensed operating models: Experience of licensed or franchised models, where one company’s design and operating standard is delivered by another.
* Capital partners: Exposure to infrastructure investors, project finance or joint ventures.
* Arabic: Professional fluency in Arabic.

**OUR VALUES**

* Customer first: You measure your work by customer outcomes, and prioritise accordingly.
* Ownership mentality: You own outcomes end to end. When something breaks or stalls, you treat it as yours to fix.
* Clear communicator: You explain complex systems simply, to operators and executives alike, and make the value of your work visible.
* Comfortable with ambiguity: You make progress with incomplete information, partial data and unfamiliar environments, and you enjoy solving problems where there is no structure yet.

Title: Senior AI/ML Engineer – Generative AI & Agentic AI
Description:

Ekshvaku Tech Innovations (ETI) is a technology solutions and consulting company operating across the UAE and India, specializing in Artificial Intelligence, enterprise software development, healthcare technology, insurance technology, and digital transformation.

We develop intelligent, scalable, and production-ready technology solutions for businesses across multiple industries, with a growing focus on healthcare AI, enterprise automation, and Agentic AI.

We are expanding our AI engineering capabilities and seeking a highly skilled Senior AI/ML Engineer who can independently design, develop, and deploy sophisticated AI-powered applications.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a hands-on, technically strong Senior AI/ML Engineer with demonstrated experience building production-grade Generative AI, Large Language Model (LLM), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and Agentic AI solutions.

The ideal candidate should possess strong software engineering fundamentals, applied machine learning expertise, and the ability to translate complex business requirements into reliable AI systems.

This is not a research-only or prompt-engineering position.

**We are looking for an engineer who can take complete technical ownership of AI solutions, from architecture and development to deployment, optimization, monitoring, and continuous improvement.**

The selected candidate will work closely with our technical leadership and engineering teams on AI initiatives across healthcare, insurance, and enterprise technology.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Generative AI & LLM Development**

* Design, develop, and deploy applications powered by Large Language Models.
* Build solutions using commercial and open-source models, including GPT, Claude, Gemini, Llama, and similar technologies.
* Implement advanced prompting strategies, structured outputs, function calling, and tool integration.
* Develop and optimize LLM-powered APIs and backend services.

**2. Agentic AI & Intelligent Automation**

* Develop evaluation frameworks for retrieval relevance, groundedness, and response quality.

**4. Applied Machine Learning**

Title: Advisor, Analytical Chemistry
Description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
  
  
**Organization Overview:**  
At Lilly, we serve an extraordinary purpose — we make a difference for people around the globe by discovering, developing, and delivering medicines that help them live longer, healthier, more active lives. The Radiopharmaceuticals (RLT) Chemistry, Manufacturing & Controls (CM&C) group is at the forefront of advancing therapeutic radiopharmaceuticals from clinical development through commercial launch.
  
  
**Position Overview:**  
The Advisor, Analytical Chemist is a critical technical role within the RLT CM&C Technical Operations function. Reporting to the Senior Director, Technical Operations, this position leads the technical transfer, development, optimization, and validation of analytical methods to support phase 1b to phase 3 radiopharmaceutical programs. The Advisor serves as the primary analytical chemistry subject matter expert (SME), driving scientifically sound, phase-appropriate method strategies that meet GMP, ICH, USP, and regulatory expectations.
  
  
This role operates at the intersection of analytical science, regulatory compliance, and cross-functional program delivery — collaborating closely with QC, CMC Regulatory, manufacturing, and external CDMO partners to ensure analytical readiness for late-phase development milestones and regulatory submissions.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**  
Analytical Method Development & Optimization
  
  

* Lead the design, development, and optimization of analytical methods for radiopharmaceutical API and drug products, including small molecules, peptides, and radiolabeled compounds.
* Develop and optimize chromatographic methods (HPLC, UPLC, TLC, GC) and spectroscopic methods (gamma spectroscopy, mass spectrometry, UV/Vis, NMR) as appropriate for late-phase programs.
* Apply phase-appropriate development strategies aligned with ICH Q14, ICH Q2(R2), and applicable USP/EP compendial requirements for late clinical phase through commercial programs.
* Identify and implement analytical technology improvements and method modernization initiatives to support continuous improvement and commercial readiness.
* Troubleshoot complex analytical method performance issues and implement robust, validated solutions.

Analytical Method Validation & Transfer
  
  

* Author method validation protocols and reports in full compliance with ICH Q2(R2), USP , and applicable regulatory guidance for late-phase and commercial programs.
* Lead analytical method qualification and validation activities at internal sites and external CDMOs/partners.
* Perform or oversee technology transfer of validated methods to QC release and stability testing laboratories.
* Prepare and review method transfer protocols, comparability studies, and qualification/validation reports.
* Ensure validation data packages are complete, defensible, and ready for regulatory submission.

Regulatory & Documentation
  
  

* Author analytical sections of CMC regulatory submissions (INDs, CTAs, NDA/BLA, MAA), including method descriptions, validation summaries, and specification justifications.
* Develop and justify release and stability specifications for starting materials, intermediates, and drug products in collaboration with CMC Regulatory and QA.
* Prepare responses to regulatory agency inquiries related to analytical methods and specifications.
* Author and review standard test methods, SOPs, change controls, and technical reports in accordance with GMP and Good Documentation Practices.
* Support internal and external GMP audits, providing technical analytical expertise as required.

GMP Quality & Compliance
  
  

* Ensure all analytical activities are conducted in compliance with cGMP, cGLP, applicable FDA, EMA, Health Canada, ICH, USP, PDA, and Lilly quality standards.
* Review and approve experimental data from internal labs and external CDMOs/vendors; interpret results and document conclusions accurately.
* Lead or support investigations of out-of-specification (OOS) results, analytical deviations, and aberrant data using robust root cause analysis methodology.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & External Partnerships
  
  

* Serve as the analytical chemistry SME for late-phase RLT programs, providing technical direction to cross-functional CMC teams.
* Build and maintain productive working relationships with internal, external CDMOs, analytical service providers, and regulatory partners.
* Collaborate with QC, CMC Regulatory, Manufacturing Sciences, and Supply Chain to ensure seamless analytical readiness for clinical and commercial supply.
* Represent analytical capabilities in project team meetings, technical reviews, and governance forums.

**Basic Requirements:**  

* Earned Bachelor's degree in chemistry, analytical chemistry, or organic chemistry
* 10+ years of relevant experience in analytical development, analytical validation, and/or analytical testing in a GMP setting.
* Demonstrated expertise in the development and full ICH Q2(R2)-compliant validation of chromatographic (HPLC, UPLC, GC, TLC) and spectroscopic (MS, UV/Vis, gamma) analytical methods.
* Functional knowledge of GMP regulations and applicable FDA, EMA, ICH, USP, and PDA guidelines relevant to analytical testing.
* Proven ability to operate effectively in a cross-functional environment with strong project management and organizational skills.
* Proficiency in analytical data systems and laboratory informatics (e.g., Empower, Chromeleon, MassLynx).
* Strong oral and written communication skills, with demonstrated ability to present technical data to diverse audiences including senior leadership and regulatory agencies.
* Must be a Canadian citizen to be selected for this position.

**Additional Preferences:**  

* Master's degree in chemistry field with 5+ years of relevant experience, OR PhD in chemistry field with 2+ years of relevant experience
* Experience working hands-on within the biotech or pharmaceutical industry
* Experience with radiopharmaceutical analytical testing, including HPLC with radiometric detection, TLC (radiometric), and gamma spectroscopy for PET (F-18) and/or theranostic radioisotopes (Lu-177, Ac-225).
* Hands-on experience authoring CMC regulatory submissions and method validation packages for late-phase (Phase 3) or commercial programs.
* Experience with CDMO/external partner analytical qualification and method transfer in a GMP context.
* Familiarity with regulatory expectations for late-phase radiopharmaceutical analytical control strategies (ICH Q14, Q8/Q9/Q10 pharmaceutical quality system principles).

**Other Information:**  

* Standard PPE and radiological safety protocols apply in RLT manufacturing and laboratory areas.
* Estimated travel: 5-15% domestically and internationally (CDMOs, partner sites, conferences). A valid passport and eligibility to travel within North America and Europe are required.
* Monday through Friday, standard business hours; periodic off-hours responsiveness may be required in support of GMP manufacturing or regulatory timelines.

Title: FPGA Designer
Description:
Fidus is a global high-tech design firm headquartered in Ottawa, with additional design centres in Kitchener-Waterloo and San Jose. We specialize in leading-edge electronic product development, with hardware, embedded software, FPGA/ASIC, and signal integrity teams working together to design and deliver next-generation products for clients in emerging technology markets.

**Position Overview/Mandate:**

The FPGA Designer plays a key role in designing and delivering complex FPGA-based systems for Fidus clients. You will work directly with customers and internal Fidus teams to define architectures, implement RTL, integrate IP, run simulations, close timing, and support lab bring-up and debug.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working with new FPGA families and tools, is comfortable moving between different application domains (video, communications, storage, signal processing), and takes pride in producing high-quality, well-documented designs.

**Make an Impact with US:**

At Fidus, you'll work on high-speed, high-complexity electronic systems, often using emerging technologies before they reach the broader market. You'll collaborate across FPGA/DSP, hardware, embedded software, verification, SI/PI, PCB layout, and mechanical/thermal design as part of cross-functional teams delivering real products for our clients.

In practice, that means contributing to projects across Communications, Aerospace & Defence, Life Sciences & Medical Devices, Space & Satellite, Industrial Automation, Automotive, and Semiconductor engagements. You won't be limited to a single product or industry—your work will follow the technology, not just one roadmap.

**What You’ll Be Doing:**

* Work with our clients and other Fidus Employees to develop complex FPGA and/or CPLD based systems, including architecture, custom development, integrated IP, simulations, and timing analysis and closure.
* Design FPGA based systems using Xilinx and Intel based devices and tools
* Participate in design reviews (hardware-software interface, input-outputs etc.) to ensure Fidus quality standards and customer requirements are being adhered to
* Perform lab testing, debug of prototypes and supporting hardware/software engineer, as needed
* Perform customer prototype demonstrations and author test plans, design description and user documentation
* Provide technical insight to customers during the pre-sales and implementation phase of projects
* Provide technical support to the Business Manager and Sales team by providing detailed estimates on project scope, schedule, and deliverables and to present the technical aspects of Fidus proposals to the client

**Who You are:**

* Minimum 5 years of experience designing using RTL/Verilog/VHDL on FPGAs.
* Experience with video systems and specification standards, video algorithms, and high-speed memory and bus interfaces, communications protocols, and DSP or processor instantiations.
* Created designs using Xilinx or Altera FPGA families and have a solid understanding of tool flow
* Experience with Verilog, SystemVerilog, VHDL, Xilinx Vivado, Altera Quartus, and/or ModelSim
* RTL design and verification including test benches, functional simulations, and timing closure
* Exhibit strong communication skills, are fluent in English, have great customer interaction presence, and quickly learn new technologies and processes
* Proven techniques and habits that lead to high quality design
* Embraces AI as part of a modern engineering toolkit
* Degree as a B.A.Sc., B.Eng. or equivalent
* As AMD Embedded Premier Partner, you will be certified to highest level of FPGA qualification – this will be your first “to-do” item upon joining us.

**Location and travel:** Position is based in Canada. Travel may be required domestically and internationally to support customer engagements and project delivery.

This position may require access to export-controlled information. Candidates will be required to complete background checks and security screening under Canada's Controlled Goods Program (CGP) and may also be required to obtain a security clearance under the Contract Security Program (CSP) administered by Public Services and Procurement Canada (PSPC, formerly PWGSC).

This role is an evergreen position.

Annual base salary ranges from $125,000 to $160,000. The final offer within this range takes into account the variations in knowledge, skills, experience, and market conditions, and with consideration to internal equity.

Our competitive compensation package also includes a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision plans, matching GRSP contributions, annual profit-sharing bonus, along with other supplementary benefits.

We also recognize that candidates show interest throughout different career stages and welcome all applications. When there is a great fit, the level of the role may be shifted as applicable.

**About Fidus & Why Work Here**

Since 2001, Fidus has completed over 4,000 projects for more than 400 customers across industries including Telecom/Datacom, Aerospace & Defence, Consumer, Semiconductors, Industrial/Automotive Controls, and Medical. As a Premier Adaptive Computing Partner for AMD North America, we combine deep technical expertise with industry-leading tools to solve complex design challenges.

Fidus designs high-speed, high-complexity electronic systems using emerging technologies, often well before they reach the broader market. Our teams work across FPGA/DSP, hardware, embedded software, verification, SI/PI, PCB layout, and mechanical/thermal design to deliver real products for our customers.

At Fidus, collaboration is at the core of how we work. We value openness, trust, and shared ownership, and we create an environment where people are encouraged to contribute ideas, learn from one another, and have a meaningful impact through the work they do.

If all of this excites you, has your attention, and you can’t wait to join our amazing team and work environment, then we want to hear from you!

Curious what it's actually like to work here? Take a look at our page.

Automated tools (including AI) support our initial screening of applicants against our job posting to identify candidates whose qualifications, experience, and skills align most closely with the position requirements. All further candidate assessments and final selection are conducted by our human recruitment team. AI does not make any final hiring decisions.*

Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. Fidus is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.*

The **Women’s 24-Hour Drop-In** is a low barrier, trans-inclusive and welcoming space for women to come and meet service

Title: Sous Chef
Description:
Position: Sous Chef  
Department: Food Production  
Reports To: Executive Chef / Head Chef  
Location: Plaza Inn Hotel Doha, Qatar  
Hotel Category: 4-Star Hotel

1. Job Purpose

The Sous Chef is responsible for assisting the Executive Chef in managing the overall kitchen operations, ensuring high standards of food quality, presentation, hygiene, consistency, and service delivery. The role involves supervising kitchen staff, coordinating daily food production, monitoring food costs, maintaining food safety standards, and ensuring smooth kitchen operations across all hotel outlets and banquet functions.

The Sous Chef must lead by example, maintain discipline within the kitchen team, and ensure that all food is prepared according to the hotel's standards and guest expectations.

2. Key Responsibilities and Duties

A. Kitchen Operations & Food Production

* Assist the Executive Chef in managing and supervising daily kitchen operations.
* Ensure the timely preparation and delivery of food for all hotel outlets, room service, buffet operations, and banquet functions.
* Monitor food preparation, cooking methods, portion sizes, taste, texture, and presentation.
* Ensure all dishes are prepared according to approved recipes and hotel standards.
* Maintain consistency in food quality and presentation across all shifts.
* Coordinate with the Executive Chef regarding daily menus, special promotions, buffet arrangements, and special events.
* Ensure proper mise en place is completed before every meal period and service.
* Monitor food preparation timelines to avoid delays during peak service hours.
* Ensure proper utilization of kitchen equipment, utensils, and ingredients.
* Participate in menu development, recipe standardization, and new dish trials.

B. Staff Supervision & Team Management

* Supervise and coordinate the activities of Chef de Partie, Demi Chef de Partie, Commis Chefs, and kitchen helpers.
* Assign daily duties and responsibilities according to operational requirements.
* Prepare and coordinate kitchen duty schedules in consultation with the Executive Chef.
* Ensure adequate manpower is available during breakfast, lunch, dinner, and banquet operations.
* Conduct daily kitchen briefings and communicate operational instructions to the team.
* Monitor staff punctuality, attendance, grooming, personal hygiene, and discipline.
* Train and develop junior kitchen staff through on-the-job coaching.
* Identify training requirements and recommend suitable development programs.
* Maintain effective communication and teamwork within the kitchen department.
* Report staff performance issues, misconduct, and operational concerns to the Executive Chef.

C. Food Safety, Hygiene & Sanitation

* Ensure strict compliance with Qatar food safety regulations and hotel hygiene standards.
* Monitor personal hygiene and grooming standards of all kitchen employees.
* Ensure proper food storage, labeling, dating, and stock rotation using FIFO principles.

Title: Electrical Engineer
Description:
HanmiGlobal Saudi is seeking an experienced Electrical Engineer with demonstrable infrastructure experience to join its client-side Program Management and Construction Management (PMCM) team on a major government land development and infrastructure program in Riyadh. The position is assigned to one development package and provides electrical engineering coverage throughout design review, construction supervision, testing, commissioning and handover.

The Lead Developer and its designers and contractors remain responsible for design, construction and contractual delivery. The PMCM Electrical Engineer reviews and monitors their work, coordinates technical interfaces, records compliance and provides recommendations to the Package Project Manager and Construction Manager, with technical support from the Core Team Senior Electrical Engineer and Senior Telecom Engineer.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Review electrical design submissions at applicable master-planning, concept, detailed-design and issued-for-construction stages, including design criteria, load assessments, calculations, drawings, specifications, equipment schedules and interface documents.
* Review electrical infrastructure including medium- and low-voltage distribution, substations and transformers where within package scope, feeder and cable networks, duct banks, chambers, earthing and bonding, protection, metering, distribution boards, street and public-realm lighting, and associated control systems.
* Review telecommunications infrastructure including duct and conduit routes, manholes and handholes, fibre-optic and other communications cabling, access networks, equipment interfaces, testing requirements and provision for service-provider connections, as applicable to the approved scope.
* Assess design coordination between electrical and telecom systems and roads, drainage, water, irrigation, landscaping, civil structures, existing utilities and public-realm works; identify clashes, constructability constraints and missing interfaces.
* Review Lead Developer technical submittals, shop drawings, material and equipment submissions, method statements, inspection and test plans, RFIs, technical queries and proposed deviations; issue documented technical comments and recommendations through approved workflows.
* Monitor installation and construction of electrical and telecom infrastructure; verify conformity with approved drawings, specifications, quality plans, applicable codes and authority requirements through site inspections and supervision of designated inspectors.
* Coordinate the Electrical Inspector(s) assigned to the package and work with the Construction Manager and other inspectors to prioritize inspections, track deficiencies, verify corrective actions and maintain effective coverage of both disciplines.
* Review and follow up work and material inspection requests, nonconformance reports, punch lists and inspection records, ensuring that unresolved issues are escalated through PMCM quality procedures.
* Coordinate interfaces and required submissions, permits, no-objection certificates, connections, diversions and witnessing with relevant authorities and service providers, including SEC and telecommunications operators, through the Package Interface Specialist.
* Review and witness, as applicable, electrical testing and commissioning (including insulation resistance, continuity, earthing, functional and protection testing) and telecom testing (including duct proving and fibre-optic testing), in accordance with approved procedures and authority requirements.
* Monitor design and construction progress against approved schedules and look-ahead plans; identify critical long-lead equipment, utility connections, technical risks and constraints; contribute to mitigation and recovery recommendations.
* Review as-built records, test results, authority clearances, operation and maintenance documentation, warranties, spare parts, training records and other close-out deliverables; recommend readiness for handover within the PMCM approval process.
* Coordinate routinely with the Core Team Senior Electrical Engineer and Senior Telecom Engineer on complex technical issues, standards, design assurance, cross-package interfaces and matters requiring escalation; prepare technical inputs to package progress reports and meetings.

**Requirements**
----------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering from a recognized university.
* More than 12 years of relevant professional experience is required for recruitment screening.
* Proven experience in electrical power infrastructure design review AND construction supervision on major infrastructure or land development projects.
* Demonstrated knowledge of electrical distribution networks, substations and transformers where applicable, underground cables, street lighting, earthing, protection, testing and commissioning.
* Demonstrated knowledge of telecom ducts, chambers, fibre-optic networks, network interfaces, service-provider coordination and telecom installation/testing practices.
* Experience in a PMC/PMCM, owner’s engineer or engineering supervision consultant role, including design submittal review, site inspections and multidisciplinary coordination.
* Working knowledge of relevant Saudi regulations and utility/service-provider requirements, applicable IEC and other project-adopted standards, and construction quality and HSE procedures.
* Ability to review engineering calculations, CAD drawings, technical specifications, inspection/test plans and handover documentation; familiarity with Aconex or similar document-control systems.
* Registration with the Saudi Council of Engineers (SCE), as required for the appointment.
* Strong written and spoken English, technical reporting, stakeholder coordination and issue-resolution skills; Arabic is an advantage.

Title: Field CISO
Description:
**Onwards Together!**
---------------------

Illumio is the leader in ransomware and breach containment, redefining how organizations contain cyberattacks and enable operational resilience. Powered by the Illumio AI Security Graph, our breach containment platform identifies and contains threats across hybrid multi-cloud environments – stopping the spread of attacks before they become disasters.  
  
Recognized as a Leader in the Forrester Wave for Microsegmentation, Illumio enables Zero Trust, strengthening cyber resilience for the infrastructure, systems, and organizations that keep the world running.

**Our Team's Vision:**
----------------------

Illumio is the breach containment company. Built on Zero Trust principles, the Illumio platform combines real-time visibility with segmentation and AI-powered detection and response, helping organizations stop the spread of breaches and ransomware across hybrid, multi-cloud, and on-premises environments before they become disasters. Illumio Segmentation contains attackers by stopping lateral movement across the enterprise, and Illumio Insights delivers AI-driven visibility and detection across hybrid cloud environments.

Illumio was named a Leader in The Forrester Wave: Microsegmentation Solutions, Q3 2026, earning the highest scores in current offering and strategy of any vendor evaluated, and is recognized as a Customers’ Choice in Gartner Peer Insights for Network Security – Microsegmentation. Global enterprises across financial services, healthcare, energy and utilities, government, manufacturing, retail, and telecommunications trust Illumio to reduce cyber risk and build resilience.

**Our Values**
==============

Our values reflect how we work together in practice — not just what we aspire to. They show up in everyday decisions, how we collaborate across teams, and how we treat each other while building and delivering our work. If these values resonate with you, you’ll likely feel at home here.

* **Bring Your Best:** We hold ourselves to a standard of excellence for our customers and each other, regardless of circumstance.
* **Build Trust:** We act with integrity, transparency, and follow-through, earning trust in every interaction.
* **Seek Truth:** We pursue facts over assumptions, stay curious, and remain open to being wrong.
* **Onwards Together:** We move forward as one team, supporting each other through challenges and wins alike.
* **Leverage Differences:** We treat diverse perspectives and backgrounds as a source of strength and better decisions.

**Role Overview**
-----------------

The Field CISO, Zero Trust Segmentation is a newly created, specialized role within the Global Solutions Engineering team, chartered to deepen Illumio’s credibility and category leadership within the CISO community. This role is intentionally sourced from the CISO community: we are looking for a security executive — a current or former CISO, Deputy CISO, or senior security leader — who brings a proven balance of business acumen, technical depth, and operational experience running a security program, rather than a traditional pre-sales background. This is a hybrid role by design: half executive advisor and evangelist, half hands-on architect.

As Field CISO, this person is Illumio’s most credible external voice on Zero Trust Segmentation and breach containment — engaging CISOs and CTOs at strategic accounts as a peer, shaping the category narrative with industry analysts (Gartner, Forrester, and other leading firms), and representing the company at industry events. This person also personally owns the technical backbone of pre-sales for the category: the Use Case Map, demo environments, POC/POV frameworks, and reference architectures that the rest of the global SE team (AMS, EMEA, APAC) builds on.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Strategic Field Leadership & Evangelism**

* Serve as Illumio’s foremost executive voice on Zero Trust Segmentation and breach containment, in the field and in public — conferences, webinars, analyst briefings, and published content.
* Build and maintain analyst relationships (Gartner, Forrester, and other leading firms) to shape how the category is defined and evaluated in the market.
* Engage CISO- and CTO-level stakeholders directly on the most strategic opportunities, drawing on firsthand operating experience to act as a peer and trusted advisor alongside regional SE leads and AEs.
* Partner with Sales and GTM leadership to shape go-to-market and revenue acceleration strategy.
* Partner with Product Marketing and Product Management to shape positioning, messaging, and roadmap priorities, informed directly by field and firsthand operator signal.

**Technical Architecture & Enablement Ownership**

* Own and continuously evolve the Use Case Map, Demo Runbook, and reference architectures used across the global SE organization.
* Personally design and build flagship demo environments and POC/POV frameworks, including integration patterns and success-criteria templates.
* Partner directly with product engineering to translate roadmap into sellable, demoable capability, and drive pre-sales enablement to sell-ready status and beyond.
* Maintain deep, current hands-on fluency with the Illumio platform — including segmentation, hybrid cloud detection and response, and broader Zero Trust architecture concepts.

**Enterprise Pre-Sales & POC Execution**

* Lead or co-lead the most strategic and complex opportunities globally, engaging directly alongside AMS, EMEA, and APAC SE teams.
* Architect and execute high-stakes POCs/POVs, including technical prerequisites, integration scoping, success-criteria definition, and executive readout.
* Act as the final technical and executive escalation point for deals across regions, ensuring a consistent, credible narrative in front of customers.

**Team Enablement & Capability Building**

* Design and deliver training curriculum and certification paths for the global SE team.
* Build battlecards, FAQs, and RFP response libraries, keeping the team current against an evolving competitive landscape.
* Mentor SE Leads and SEs on segmentation and breach containment concepts, positioning, and objection handling — bringing an operator’s perspective on how real security teams evaluate and adopt these solutions.

**Product & Market Feedback Loop**

* Serve as a structured, credible voice of the field back to Product Management on roadmap priorities, feature gaps, and competitive intelligence.
* Track and analyze the competitive landscape across microsegmentation, Zero Trust, and cloud detection and response, including new entrants and adjacent incumbents extending into the space.

**Required Qualifications**

* Prior experience as a CISO, Deputy CISO, or senior security executive (VP/Director of Information Security) is required — this role is intentionally sourced from the CISO community to bring firsthand business, technical, and operational credibility to the field.
* 10+ years of experience leading enterprise security programs, with direct, hands-on exposure to network segmentation, Zero Trust architecture, incident response and breach containment, or cloud security.
* Demonstrated ability to speak credibly to both engineering and executive/board audiences translating technical risk into business terms and back again.
* Demonstrated track record as an external-facing voice: conference speaking, analyst engagement, published thought leadership, or peer-community leadership (e.g., CISO forums, ISACs).
* Proven hands-on architecture and build capability — this is not a strategy-only role; the person must be able to personally build and demo complex technical environments.
* Demonstrated experience engaging CISO- and CTO-level stakeholders, ideally as a former peer, on strategic, multi-stakeholder decisions.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, able to move fluidly between deep technical detail and executive narrative.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, or equivalent experience.
* Willingness and ability to travel 30–50% for customer, analyst, and industry engagements.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Prior title of CISO, Deputy CISO, Field CISO, or VP/Director of Information Security at an enterprise or mid-market organization.
* Direct operational experience running a segmentation, Zero Trust, or breach containment program.
* Experience with microsegmentation, CNAPP, cloud security posture management, or hybrid cloud detection and response tooling.
* Existing relationships with analyst firms (Gartner, Forrester, and others) covering network security, Zero Trust, or security operations.
* Experience integrating or building go-to-market plans around a new or acquired product line.
* Published thought leadership — blogs, whitepapers, podcasts, or conference talks — on breach containment, Zero Trust, or cyber resilience.
* Familiarity with the broader Illumio platform: Illumio Segmentation, Illumio Insights, container/Kubernetes segmentation, OT/ICS environments, and hybrid cloud architectures.

**Our Commitment**

Illumio believes that an environment of unique backgrounds, experiences, viewpoints, and individual contributions creates a culture of belonging, drives our future, and makes us stronger together in support of our customers and their success.

Upon acceptance of any offer, we will request such information as part of the onboarding process prior to or on your first day of employment, and only after completing a background check through an authorized third-party vendor. If you receive any communication asking for personal details outside of these processes, please contact us immediately to verify the authenticity of the request. Your security is important to us, and we are committed to a safe and transparent hiring experience.*
