Title: IT Officer
Description:
The International Rescue Committee (IRC) responds to the world's worst humanitarian crises, helping to restore health, safety, education, economic wellbeing, and power to people devastated by conflict and disaster. Founded in 1933 at the call of Albert Einstein, the IRC is one of the world's largest international humanitarian non-governmental organizations (INGO), at work in more than 40 countries and 29 U.S. cities helping people to survive, reclaim control of their future and strengthen their communities. A force for humanity, IRC employees deliver lasting impact by restoring safety, dignity and hope to millions. If you're a solutions-driven, passionate change-maker, come join us in positively impacting the lives of millions of people world-wide for a better future.

**Position Summary**

The IT officer provides technical support, systems administration and network infrastructure management for the Hagadera field office. The role reports administratively to the head of the Hagadera field office (through the county area coordinator, Garissa) and technically to the IT manager.

The role combines hands-on support with planning for systems, networks and health information systems, including the electronic medical record (EMR) used in IRC-supported health facilities. The IT officer keeps staff and clinical teams connected, protects IRC data, and works closely with the service desk, NOC, SOC, GIS and the regional and HQ IT teams.

**Major Responsibilities**

**IT support (Level 1 and Level 2)**

  

* Work with end users, IT colleagues and the service desk to resolve Level 1 and Level 2 issues in the Hagadera field office.
* Resolve or escalate Level 3 issues to the right internal or external resource (IT manager, regional IT lead, applications team, service desk or vendor) as necessary
* Log, update and close all incidents and requests in Service-Now, with clear notes on actions taken.
* Provide remote support for field staff and off-site clinic locations.
* Run user training on IT tools, cybersecurity awareness and digital literacy.

**Network infrastructure and systems administration**

* **Servers and domain:** install, configure and manage Windows Server, the domain environment and essential network services.
* **End-user devices:** install and support desktops, laptops and peripherals using the IRC standard Windows 11 image and provide Microsoft Office support.
* **Specialized applications:** install and support applications such as the EMR among other systems.
* **Email:** assist with user email account set-up, archiving, and distribution group management.
* **Networks:** install, document, manage and support wired and secured wireless networks for the Hagadera field office and its satellite sites, including LAN, wireless and client-server architecture as appropriate.
* **Network equipment:** manage switches, routers, wireless access points and network security devices.
* **Backbone links:** monitor the performance of the microwave, point-to-point and fibre backbone networks serving Hagadera.
* **Performance:** monitor and optimize network performance, bandwidth use and connectivity, and improve the network infrastructure (internet servers, filters, domain controllers, backups, print servers and similar).
* **Backups:** manage on-premises and cloud backup solutions for servers, EMR databases and critical data, and test restores regularly.
* **Procurement:** advice on procurement on spare parts and new IT equipment so that purchases meet IRC standard specifications.

**EMR system implementation and support**

  

* Understand the EMR system well enough to troubleshoot, or to escalate technical errors to the focal IT person or the EMR developer.
* Be the point of contact for EMR issues raised by physicians, health records officers, the matron and clinicians in charge.
* Take part in planning, designing, developing and deploying new EMR modules and enhancements.
* Support EMR implementation on sites, documenting approaches, challenges and mitigation strategies.
* Prepare recommendations and alternatives to improve how the EMR operates.
* Work with facility teams to generate structured and ad-hoc reports for stakeholders such as the Ministry of Health, donors, administrators and clinicians.
* Keep EMR servers, databases, workstations and network links at the clinics available, backed up and patched, in line with the uptime targets below.
* Train and coach EMR users on basic troubleshooting, data security and good practice.

**Maintenance, repair and security**

  

* Carry out preventive maintenance on all IRC computers and network resources.
* Develop and follow maintenance protocols for laptops, desktops, photocopiers, printers and other IT and communication equipment.
* Implement backup solutions for the office and individual users in line with IRC IT recommendations (including Box), and train users on how to use them.
* Apply and update network security and data loss prevention procedures to protect systems from physical harm, viruses, unauthorized users and data damage.
* Review user accounts and access rights regularly and remove access promptly when staff leave.
* Report security incidents to the SOC and IT manager straight away and help contain them.
* Monitor power backup (UPS and generator or solar) for server and network rooms, and report faults early.
* Create and maintain network documentation, including IP addresses, system access, upgrades and changes to the original network.
* Investigate local internet connectivity options to link offices through VPNs and secure enough bandwidth for intranet and application access.
* Take part in disaster recovery and business continuity planning and testing for Hagadera.

**Collaboration, planning, reporting and capacity building**

  

* Act as IT liaison with field administration and staff, to understand and interpret IT needs at base level and meet them across teams.
* Work with the regional and HQ IT teams on the helpdesk, connectivity and other in-country and global IT projects.
* Take part as an IT team member in planning, problem resolution and reviewing department performance.
* Work with the IT manager on work plans to improve IT systems.
* Help write and put into practice IT policies and standard operating procedures.
* Deliver on-demand training so that staff strengthen their basic computer skills and write and maintain user guides and training materials.
* Maintain IT asset registers with equipment details, locations and warranty information.
* Submit monthly reports using the standard templates to the geographical and functional managers.
* Carry out any other IT-related tasks assigned by the supervisor or the regional and HQ IT teams.

**Cross-site collaboration (shared technical expertise)**

The IT officer is part of a shared technical pool across the Hagadera and Kakuma field offices.

For this position, approximately 20% of working time will be required to support the Kakuma field office on the common functions listed below. The time is planned with the IT manager and the Hagadera field office head so that service levels in Hagadera are not affected. Support is given remotely where possible and on site when needed.

* **Shared EMR expertise:** support the EMR module or modules in which the IT officer has expertise at Kakuma as well as Hagadera, including troubleshooting, configuration support, user guidance and escalation to the EMR developer.
* **Network updates:** carry out or coordinate network updates for Kakuma, such as configuration changes, firmware updates and keeping the network documentation current.
* **Server backups for EMR:** run, monitor and confirm the EMR server backups for Kakuma, report failures and take part in restore tests.
* **Routine user support:** provide Level 1 and Level 2 support to Kakuma users

**Working with other teams**

The IT officer is expected to work closely with the teams below:

* Service desk
* Network and Systems Engineering
* Global Information Systems

**Required qualifications**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in information technology, computer science or a related field.

Title: Senior Interior Designer
Description:
Overview:

KEO is a creative enterprise, where innovation is a way of life. We are uniquely resourced with end-to-end services to take clients from inspiration – through conceptualization – to realization of planning, design or project delivery in the built and natural environments. For over 57 years we’ve led with vision, contributing to many of the world’s most ambitious projects, iconic places, remarkable experiences and prosperous communities.

As a highly integrated and agile AEP/PMCM firm, KEO is ranked by ENR in the Top 225 International Design Firms; in the Top 20 International PM/CM Firms; and by World Architecture as 50th largest global architecture firm and #1 Firm in the Middle East Region in their 2023 WAS 100 Survey.

We invite you to join us.

Our newest opportunity is for a talented **Senior Interior Designer** to join our award winning Design team based in **Doha, Qatar.** This position is responsible for providing professional interior design services to world class corporate offices and residential projects including preparation and presentation of complete design scheme from concept design phase to the completion of construction documents. The roles requires preparation of interior design concepts and facilitates high quality project documentation required for the different project phases and coordinates with other design disciplines as required to integrate interior design on a project-by-project basis.

Responsibilities:

KEO is seeking an experienced and creative Senior Interior Designer to join our Design Team in Qatar.

The successful candidate will bring a minimum of 12 years of professional interior design experience, ideally gained within a multidisciplinary design or architectural consultancy environment. The role requires a strong design sensibility, with the ability to develop compelling design narratives and concepts and carry the design vision consistently through the different stages of a project.

We are looking for a designer who combines creativity with strong technical knowledge, presentation capability and multidisciplinary coordination skills, and who can confidently contribute to the delivery of high-quality interior environments from initial concept through detailed design.

We envisage success in this role to include;

* Leading and contributing to the development of interior design narratives, concepts and creative design directions in response to client briefs and project requirements.
* Translating initial narratives and concepts into cohesive interior design solutions and maintaining the integrity of the design vision throughout the project lifecycle.
* Developing concept presentations, mood boards, material palettes, precedent studies, space-planning strategies and design presentations.
* Preparing and reviewing interior layouts, plans, elevations, reflected ceiling plans, details and coordinated design packages.
* Developing projects through concept, schematic and detailed design stages, ensuring continuity between the original design vision and final technical solution.
* Leading the selection and specification of materials, finishes, fixtures, furniture, lighting and FF&E in accordance with the project's overall design narrative.
* Producing high-quality presentations and communicating design ideas clearly to clients, stakeholders and internal project teams.
* Participating in client presentations and design workshops and confidently articulating the rationale behind design decisions.
* Coordinating interior design requirements with architecture, MEP, structural, lighting and other specialist disciplines.
* Reviewing multidisciplinary design information to identify and resolve coordination issues that could affect the interior design intent.
* Working closely with BIM and technical teams to ensure designs are accurately developed and represented within project documentation.
* Reviewing design packages for consistency, quality, completeness and compliance with KEO's design standards.
* Providing design guidance and technical support to junior and intermediate members of the Interior Design team.
* Supporting Design Managers and discipline leadership in meeting project programmes, deliverables and quality expectations.
* Contributing to internal design reviews and helping maintain a consistently high standard of creative output across projects.

This emphasis on full-cycle design is consistent with the profile of previous Senior Interior Designer candidates assessed by KEO's Qatar team, including responsibilities spanning conceptual, schematic and detailed design.

  
Qualifications:

To be successful in this dynamic opportunity, we envision that your career journey to date will include;

* Bachelor's degree in Interior Design, Architecture or a related discipline.
* Minimum 12 years of interior design experience, preferably within a multidisciplinary design consultancy.
* Strong portfolio demonstrating concept and narrative development through concept, schematic and detailed design stages.
* Advanced proficiency in Revit, with hands-on experience developing and coordinating interior design packages within a BIM environment.
* Strong experience producing Revit-based interior layouts, plans, elevations, details, schedules and coordinated design documentation.
* Experience coordinating Revit models with Architecture, MEP and other disciplines, including resolving design and BIM coordination issues.
* Strong knowledge of space planning, materials, finishes, FF&E and interior detailing.
* Proficiency in AutoCAD, InDesign, Photoshop and PowerPoint.
* Strong client presentation, visual communication and multidisciplinary coordination skills.
* Experience guiding junior designers and reviewing design deliverables for quality, coordination and design intent.

A portfolio should be mandatory at application/shortlisting stage. This is especially appropriate for this role because KEO's recent Qatar Senior Interior Designer recruitment specifically requested candidate design portfolios for assessment

Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

 **Responsibilities**

Understand User Requirements

Partners with appropriate stakeholders (e.g., project manager, technical lead) to determine user requirements for a set of scenarios. Leverages a variety of feedback channels to incorporate insights into future designs or solution fixes. Leads incorporation of appropriate continuous feedback loops measuring customer value, usage patterns, and other actionable metrics of value. Begins to determine additional critical metrics.

Design

Leads efforts and discussions for the architecture of aspects of products/solutions (e.g., design, cost). Creates proposals for architecture and design documents and leads testing of hypotheses and proposed solutions. Shares and acts on findings from investigations, owns design decisions, and oversees the other team members. Leads the development of design documents for designs or User Stories and determines the technology that will be leveraged and how they will interact. Leads design discussions with the team and shares findings/learnings from investigations, holding ownership for design decisions. Leads efforts to assure system architecture meets security and compliance requirements and expectations.

Independently creates and mentors' others for a clear and articulated plan for testing and assuring the quality of solutions, and defines success for outcomes of tests (e.g., unit tests). Identifies needs for a broad versus selected approach in testing mechanisms and makes informed decisions to implement the most effective tests. Leads efforts to add new tests, remove antiquated tests, and aggregate tests to improve the overall test suite. Improves recommendations to the team and augments test cases to ensure that solutions have good test coverage. Leads efforts to continually integrate automation features when planning for testing.

Leads identification of dependencies and the development of design documents for a product, application, service or platform. Leads identification of other teams and technologies that will be leveraged, how they will interact, and when one's own system may provide support to others. Leads efforts to determine back-end dependencies associated with product, application, service, or platform functionality for the solution/product. Demonstrates deep understanding of up and downstream effects of solutions and work provided to ensure appropriate security and performance, driving reliability in the solutions, and optimize dependency chains and retrieves across teams. Identifies areas of dependency and overlap with other teams or team members and drives coordination. Enables cross team communications and resolves conflicts between teams.

Coding

Leads by example and mentors' others to produce extensible and maintainable code used across products. Leads efforts to optimize, debug, refactor, and reuse code to improve performance and maintainability, effectiveness, and return on investment (ROI). Identifies best practices and coding patterns and provides deep expertise in the coding and validation strategy. Creates and applies metrics to drive the quality and stability of code, as well as appropriate coding patterns and best practices.

Leads efforts to apply knowledge of debugging tools, logs, telemetry, and other methods, and leads verification of assumptions through writing and developing code proactively before issues occur and reactively as issues occur across products. Leverages minimal telemetry data, triangulates issues, and resolves with minimal iterations. Leads retrospective debugging of solutions to identify root causes of problems.

Reviews the code of a product to assure it meets the team's and Microsoft’s quality standards, is reliable and accurate, and is appropriate for the scale of the product/solution area. Applies feedback to current and future iterations. Participates in code reviews to ensure coding standards are followed. Considers diagnosability, reliability, and maintainability when reviewing code, and understands when code is ready to be shared or delivered. Title: Facility Coordinator
Description:
**Who we are**

At Namaa, we build and operate tech-enabled urban infrastructure that gives consumers fast, reliable access to meals, groceries, and everyday essentials.

Traditional retail models, built around brick-and-mortar locations, often struggle to compete in today's digital-first landscape. Challenges such as cost efficiency per square foot, logistics-optimized locations, and seamless technology integration have made it clear that a new approach is needed.

We believe the future of foodservice and commerce lies in purpose-built infrastructure designed for speed, accuracy, and scalability. That's why Namaa was established—to power the next generation of digital food and quick commerce ecosystems across the Middle East.

Our ecosystem is driven by a portfolio of specialized business units, including **KitchenPark**, **CloudRetail**, and **Profood Properties**, each playing a key role in enabling brands to grow and thrive in an increasingly on-demand world.

  

**About the role**

We are seeking an organized and hands-on Facility Coordinator to support the Facility Manager in running the day-to-day maintenance of our Riyadh facilities. The role receives and prioritizes work orders, schedules technicians and vendors, tracks preventive maintenance, keeps compliance records up to date, and reports on performance. It is the first point of contact for site teams and restaurant partners on anything maintenance-related.

  

**What you'll do**

* Receive, log, prioritize, and dispatch work orders from site operations teams and restaurant brands through the CMMS / ticketing system.
* Schedule and coordinate the daily work of facility technicians and external vendors across Riyadh sites.
* Track the preventive maintenance calendar (HVAC, kitchen exhaust, gas, firefighting, fire alarm, electrical, plumbing) and flag overdue items to the Facility Manager.
* Coordinate vendor visits: raise purchase requests, confirm scope and quotes, supervise access and completion, and verify invoices against work done.
* Maintain accurate records of inspections, permits, Civil Defense certificates, warranties, service logs, and equipment manuals.
* Manage the spare parts inventory and consumables: stock levels, reorders, and tracking of usage by site.
* Conduct site walk-throughs and basic inspections, and report hazards or defects.
* Follow up on open work orders until closure and keep requesters informed on status.
* Prepare weekly and monthly reports on work orders, PM completion, response times, vendor performance, and costs.
* Support the Facility Manager with budget tracking, incident documentation, and audit preparation.
* Support new-site openings and handovers (snag lists, asset tagging, documentation).

  

**What we're looking for**

* Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Civil, or a related engineering / facilities field.
* 1-3 years of experience in facilities coordination, maintenance planning, or a building-services role.
* Working knowledge of building systems (HVAC, electrical, plumbing, fire safety, gas).
* Experience using a CMMS / CAFM or ticketing system and strong Excel / Google Sheets skills.
* Highly organized, with the ability to manage many open items and follow through to closure.
* Strong communication skills; fluency in Arabic and English.
* Valid Saudi driving license and willingness to move between Riyadh sites daily

**Preferred qualifications**

* Experience in food service, cloud kitchens, hospitality, or retail facilities.
* Basic health and safety certification (e.g., OSHA, NEBOSH IGC, or IOSH).
* Vendor coordination and purchase-request experience.
* Using the AI tools in the work

  

**Why join us**

* Demand for online food delivery is growing really fast! In the last 5 years, just in the US, the overall market has expanded 10X from $10B to $100B, and could expand to $500bn- $1T by 2030.
* Changing the restaurant industry: You'll be part of a team that helps restaurants succeed in online food delivery.
* Collaborative environment: You will receive support and guidance from experienced colleagues and managers, helping you to learn, grow and achieve your goals, and you'll work closely with other teams to ensure our customer's success.

  

**What else you need to know**

This role is based in our Riyadh office location. As a company driven by innovation and continuous change, close collaboration is essential. We're constantly reimagining our industry, creating new products, and refining our processes, and we do our best work together. That's why all of our office-based teams work onsite, five days a week.

  

**Ready to join us as we serve those who serve others?**

Title: Regional Technology Specialist – Mission Critical & Enterprise
Description:
**Job Description**
The
**Regional Technology Specialist – Mission Critical & Enterprise (MEA)**
is a key member of the Mission Critical & Enterprise (MC-E) Technology Strategy team and reports to the Segment Technology Lead. The role serves as an important bridge between the segment’s global technology strategy, domain expertise, and the customer-facing Sales and Pre-Sales organizations across the Middle East and Africa Region.
  
  
T
**he position brings broad, horizontal technology depth across the MC-E segment’s mission-critical domains, including energy and utilities, transportation and rail, public sector and defence, and research and education.**
Rather than being focused on a single vertical or technology area, the Regional Technology Specialist is expected to understand the common technology requirements, architectural patterns, operational challenges, and emerging trends that cut across these industries and translate them into relevant solutions for customers in the region.
  
  
Working closely with the segment’s domain experts, the Regional Technology Specialist complements deep vertical expertise with a broader end-to-end technology and architecture perspective. The role helps connect customer requirements and business challenges with the appropriate technologies, solutions, architectures, and capabilities across the portfolio, ensuring that Sales and Pre-Sales teams can engage customers with a cohesive and technically credible point of view.
  
  
A significant part of the role is focused on supporting strategic customer engagements across MEA. This includes partnering with account teams during opportunity development, participating in customer workshops and technical discussions, helping shape solution architectures and technical value propositions, and providing guidance during complex or high-value pursuits. The specialist will also help identify where deeper involvement from MC-E domain experts, product teams, or other technology specialists is required and bring those resources together around the customer opportunity.
  
  
The role also acts as a two-way connection between the region and the broader MCE Technology Strategy organization. It helps bring global technology strategy, architectural direction, best practices, use cases, and lessons learned into MEA customer engagements, while also capturing regional customer requirements, competitive dynamics, technology trends, and emerging use cases and feeding those insights back into the segment.
  
  
Through this combination of regional engagement, horizontal technology expertise, and close collaboration with domain specialists, the Regional Technology Specialist strengthens the technical capabilities of the MEA field organization. The ultimate objective is to enable Sales and Pre-Sales teams to engage customers earlier and more strategically, develop stronger solution architectures, accelerate complex opportunities, and position the MC-E portfolio effectively across the region’s mission-critical markets.
  
  
**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**

* Partner with Sales and Pre-Sales teams to support opportunity qualification, solution architecture, and technical positioning across Mission Critical & Enterprise domains.
* Lead customer discovery sessions, architecture workshops, technical presentations, executive briefings, and competitive discussions.
* Support RFI/RFP responses, solution demonstrations, proof-of-concept planning, and strategic pursuits.
* Translate customer business and technology requirements into compelling solution architectures and value propositions.
* Gather and analyze customer, partner, market, and competitive insights, converting findings into actionable recommendations.
* Contribute to technology strategy by developing business cases, supporting roadmap discussions, and providing market-driven requirements.
* Act as a liaison between regional teams and global technology strategy functions, communicating portfolio direction, best practices, and technology updates.
* Provide competitive intelligence, field-readiness input, and technical enablement assets to strengthen customer engagement and drive growth across the region.

**Key Skills And Experience**
Must have:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, telecommunications, business, or equivalent practical experience.
* Typically 8+ years of relevant experience in IP networking, data centre networking, solution consulting, Pre-Sales, product management, or business development.
* Demonstrated experience supporting complex enterprise or mission-critical customer pursuits and collaborating with global Sales and Pre-Sales organizations.
* Broad working knowledge of IP/MPLS, Segment Routing, EVPN, timing (PTP/IEEE 1588), network security, and network automation, with the ability to apply them into mission-critical domains.
* Familiarity with one or more MC-E verticals (energy and utilities, rail and transport, public sector and defence, research and education).

Nice to have:
  
  

* Ability to translate technology capabilities into business outcomes and evidence-based business cases; strong presentation, facilitation, writing, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to work effectively across functions, regions, and time zones in a matrixed organization; willingness to travel for customer and field engagements.
* Working knowledge of hardware platforms, optics, network software, orchestration, and lifecycle considerations in high-availability environments.
* Ability to translate technical capabilities into business outcomes, differentiated value propositions, and clear customer recommendations.

The length of the recruitment process may vary depending on the specific role's requirements. We strive to ensure a smooth and inclusive experience for all candidates. Discover more about the recruitment process at Nokia .

**Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced and well-connected **Purchase Officer** with a strong background in the restaurant and food & beverage industry in Qatar.

The ideal candidate must have a minimum of 3 years of purchasing experience within the local market, with established relationships and contacts among food suppliers, distributors, wholesalers, and other relevant vendors.

* Identify, source, and purchase food ingredients, beverages, packaging materials, kitchen equipment, and other restaurant operational supplies.

* Develop and maintain an updated supplier database, including contact details, product categories, prices, and payment terms.

* Conduct regular market research to identify new suppliers and evaluate market prices and product quality.
* Ensure timely procurement and delivery of materials according to restaurant operational requirements.
* Coordinate with restaurant managers, chefs, and operations teams to understand purchasing requirements and maintain sufficient stock levels.
* Compare quotations from different suppliers and recommend the most cost-effective purchasing options without compromising quality.
* Monitor supplier performance regarding product quality, pricing, delivery schedules, and service reliability.
* Ensure all purchased products meet the required quality, food safety, and company standards.
* Prepare and maintain purchase orders, quotations, invoices, delivery notes, and other procurement documentation.
* Monitor market price fluctuations and identify opportunities to reduce purchasing costs.
* Handle urgent purchasing requirements and resolve supply-related issues efficiently.
* Ensure all procurement activities follow company policies and approved purchasing procedures.

Qualifications & Requirements

* Minimum **3 years of experience** as a Purchase Officer or Purchasing Executive within the restaurant, hotel, catering, or F&B industry.
* Strong knowledge of the Qatar local market and its purchasing channels.
* Must have established contacts and professional relationships with local food suppliers, distributors, wholesalers, and vendors.
* Good knowledge of food products, fresh and frozen items, meat, poultry, seafood, vegetables, dry goods, and restaurant consumables.
* Strong negotiation, communication, and supplier management skills.
* Ability to compare quotations, analyze prices, and identify cost-saving opportunities.
* Good knowledge of procurement procedures, inventory requirements, and purchase documentation.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and purchasing or ERP systems.
* Good command of English; Arabic is an added advantage.
* **Valid Qatar Driving License is mandatory.**
* Must be familiar with local supplier locations, wholesale markets, and distribution channels across Qatar.

Essential Requirements

The following requirements are mandatory:

* Previous purchasing experience specifically within the restaurant or F&B industry.
* Minimum 3 years of experience in the Qatar local market.
* Existing supplier contacts and established relationships with local vendors.
* Valid Qatar Driving License.

Preferred Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should be proactive, trustworthy, well-organized, and commercially aware, with the ability to independently manage purchasing activities and maintain a strong network of reliable suppliers in Qatar.

Title: Case Management & Resident Support Specialist
Description:
**Company:** Rwandan Canadian Healing Centre (RCHC)

**Location:** Toronto, Ontario

**Job Type:** Part-time

**Schedule:** 20 hours per week

**Work Arrangement:** On-site

**Reports To:** Program Manager

About the Rwandan Canadian Healing Centre

The Rwandan Canadian Healing Centre (RCHC) is a nonprofit organization supporting newcomers and refugees through transitional housing, employment assistance, community programs, and services that promote stability, inclusion, and independence.

Our approach emphasizes compassionate, culturally sensitive, and practical support that empowers individuals to overcome barriers, access essential resources, and achieve greater self-sufficiency.

Position Overview

RCHC is seeking a compassionate, experienced, and highly organized **Case Management & Resident Support Specialist** to provide individualized assistance to newcomers, refugees, and residents experiencing complex personal and social circumstances.

The successful candidate will conduct needs assessments, develop individualized support plans, coordinate access to community resources, and monitor client progress toward greater stability and independence.

This position requires strong interpersonal skills, sound professional judgment, cultural sensitivity, and the ability to maintain professional boundaries while providing respectful and practical support.

The primary focus of this role is case management, resident support, and service coordination rather than clinical therapy.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Client Intake, Assessment, and Case Planning**

* Conduct initial client intake meetings and comprehensive needs assessments.
* Identify individual strengths, challenges, risks, and support requirements.
* Assess barriers related to housing, employment, settlement, personal well-being, and independent living.
* Develop individualized case management plans with clear objectives, timelines, and follow-up activities.
* Monitor client progress and adjust support plans according to changing circumstances.
* Identify situations requiring specialized intervention or additional professional services.

**2. Resident Support and Client Engagement**

* Establish positive, respectful, and professional relationships with residents and clients.
* Provide practical guidance and support to individuals navigating personal, housing, settlement, and social challenges.
* Encourage problem-solving, personal responsibility, self-sufficiency, and independence.
* Communicate program expectations, available resources, and client responsibilities clearly.
* Follow up on missed appointments, outstanding actions, and resident concerns.
* Maintain appropriate professional boundaries while demonstrating empathy and cultural sensitivity.

**3. Crisis Support and Risk Management**

* Recognize signs of distress, vulnerability, crisis, or potential safety concerns.
* Respond appropriately to urgent situations in accordance with organizational procedures and professional responsibilities.
* Facilitate access to emergency services or specialized professionals when necessary.
* Support appropriate de-escalation, safety planning, and referrals within the scope of the position.
* Document incidents, actions taken, and required follow-up accurately and promptly.
* Escalate complex or high-risk situations to appropriate personnel.

**4. Service Coordination, Referrals, and Advocacy**

* Connect clients with relevant community services, including:
* Housing and shelter services
* Employment and training programs
* Settlement and immigration-related support services
* Healthcare and mental health resources
* Legal and financial assistance
* Government and community programs
* Assist clients in navigating service applications and accessing available resources.
* Establish and maintain relationships with community organizations and service providers.
* Advocate for clients when appropriate to help address barriers to accessing services.
* Coordinate referrals and follow up to confirm access to required support.
* Collaborate with external service providers while respecting confidentiality and consent requirements.

**5. Case Documentation and Confidentiality**

* Maintain accurate, timely, and organized case management records.
* Prepare and update intake assessments, individualized support plans, referrals, case notes, and progress reports.
* Document client interactions, incidents, decisions, and follow-up activities objectively and professionally.
* Protect confidential and sensitive information in accordance with organizational policies and applicable privacy requirements.
* Obtain and document client consent when information sharing is required.
* Ensure case records are properly maintained and accessible only to authorized personnel.

**6. Team Collaboration and Program Coordination**

* Collaborate with the Program Manager, Employment Services, HR, and other RCHC team members.
* Participate in case conferences, team meetings, and client progress reviews.
* Communicate emerging concerns, service gaps, and recommendations to appropriate colleagues.
* Coordinate support for clients with complex or overlapping needs.
* Provide regular updates on case progress, client outcomes, and outstanding follow-up actions.
* Contribute to the improvement of case management procedures and resident-support services.

**7. Community Engagement and Program Improvement**

* Maintain up-to-date information on community resources and referral services.
* Identify emerging client needs and barriers to accessing support.
* Support relationships with community organizations and service providers.
* Recommend improvements to case management practices and service coordination.
* Contribute to initiatives that strengthen housing stability, settlement, well-being, and independent living.

Qualifications and Experience

**Required Qualifications**

* Relevant education, training, or demonstrated professional experience in one or more of the following areas:
* Social work or case management
* Community and social services
* Housing, shelter, or settlement services
* Counselling or crisis support
* Community outreach or client advocacy
* Pastoral care, chaplaincy, or community leadership involving direct support to individuals and families
* Experience supporting individuals facing complex personal or social circumstances.
* Ability to conduct needs assessments and develop practical action plans.
* Knowledge of community resources, government programs, and referral processes.
* Strong interpersonal communication, active listening, and relationship-building skills.
* Excellent documentation, organizational, and follow-up abilities.
* Ability to exercise professional judgment and maintain appropriate boundaries.
* Ability to manage confidential information with discretion.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently and collaboratively.
* Commitment to culturally sensitive and inclusive client support.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor of Social Work (BSW), Master of Social Work (MSW), or relevant education in counselling, social services, or a related field.
* Registration with the Ontario College of Social Workers and Social Service Workers (OCSWSSW), or another applicable professional regulator, where relevant.
* Experience in transitional housing, settlement programs, shelters, or community-based organizations.
* Experience supporting newcomers, refugees, and individuals navigating major life transitions.
* Experience with crisis intervention, client advocacy, and coordinated service delivery.

Candidates from diverse professional backgrounds are encouraged to apply where they can demonstrate the practical case management skills and professional judgment required for this position.

Professional credentials must be accurately represented. Any regulated activities must remain within the individual's authorized scope of practice.

Key Competencies

The successful candidate will demonstrate:

* Compassion, empathy, and active listening.
* Strong professional ethics and appropriate boundaries.
* Cultural sensitivity and respect for diverse backgrounds.
* Effective crisis response and sound judgment.
* Excellent case documentation and recordkeeping.
* Accountability, initiative, and consistent follow-through.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills.
* Effective collaboration with colleagues and community partners.
* The ability to communicate expectations respectfully and confidently.
* A commitment to promoting client dignity, stability, and independence.

Working Environment

* Part-time, on-site position based in Toronto, Ontario.
* 20 hours per week.
* Regular collaboration with the Program Manager and RCHC team.
* Direct interaction with residents, clients, and community service providers.
* Responsibilities requiring confidentiality, professional judgment, and consistent follow-through.

Why Join RCHC?

* Make a meaningful difference in the lives of newcomers and refugees.
* Support individuals as they work toward housing stability, successful settlement, and independence.
* Collaborate with dedicated professionals and community organizations.
* Contribute to individualized case planning and coordinated support services.
* Work in an environment that values compassion, accountability, and professional judgment.

How to Apply

Interested candidates are invited to submit:

* An updated résumé highlighting relevant education, training, and professional experience.
* A brief cover letter explaining their interest in the role and experience supporting individuals with complex needs.

**Application Method:** Apply directly through Indeed.

Equity and Accessibility

RCHC is committed to maintaining an inclusive, equitable, and accessible recruitment process.

We welcome applications from qualified candidates of diverse professional and cultural backgrounds.

Applicants requiring accommodations during the recruitment process are encouraged to communicate their needs so that appropriate arrangements can be made.

Only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

Title: Chief Operating Officer
Description:
Syntys is a leading digital infrastructure platform specializing in the design, development, and operation of carrier-neutral data centers across the Middle East and North Africa (MENA). With an established and expanding network of facilities across strategic markets, Syntys delivers secure, resilient, and scalable infrastructure for hyperscalers, AI clusters, and wholesale colocation providers. Through purpose-built facilities and build-to-suit solutions, Syntys supports the growing demand for cloud, AI, and advanced computing infrastructure, enabling the continued growth of the digital economy.

The Chief Operating Officer (COO) at Syntys is a key member of the executive leadership team, responsible for overseeing and optimizing day-to-day operations across headquarters and all markets. The role provides strategic and operational leadership to ensure efficient, scalable, and high-quality operations supporting Syntys’ ambitious growth in the data center and digital infrastructure sector.

The COO oversees HQ and Market Operations, IT, Procurement, Environmental Health & Safety (EHS), and Sustainability, ensuring operational excellence, risk management, and effective support for hyperscalers, wholesale colocation providers, and strategic partners. The role plays a critical part in building the operational foundation required to meet world-class standards for reliability, efficiency, and sustainability.

**ROLE ACCOUNTABILITIES**

**Operational Leadership & Excellence**

* Lead the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of operational processes across HQ and Market operations to ensure efficiency, scalability, and service excellence.
* Establish and oversee operational standards, KPIs, and governance frameworks to ensure consistency and alignment across all Syntys locations.
* Ensure operational readiness, service quality, and risk management across all data center operations.
* Collaborate with Country Managers and OpCos to drive operational alignment and excellence in all markets.

**IT & Technology Operations**

* Oversee the Group’s IT function, ensuring robust, secure, and scalable IT infrastructure and services to support business needs.
* Lead the development and implementation of digital transformation initiatives that enhance operational efficiency, automation, and business resilience.
* Ensure cybersecurity, data protection, and IT risk management are fully integrated into operations.
* Collaborate with other leaders to ensure technology investments support operational and commercial objectives.

**Procurement & Supply Chain Management**

* Lead the Group Procurement function to ensure efficient, transparent, and cost-effective sourcing of goods and services.
* Develop and implement procurement strategies to support operational needs, vendor performance, and supply chain resilience.
* Oversee strategic supplier relationships and contract negotiations to ensure value for money and alignment with project timelines.
* Ensure compliance with procurement policies, regulatory requirements, and ethical standards.

**Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) & Risk Management**

* Establish and enforce EHS standards, policies, and programs to ensure a safe, compliant, and risk-aware working environment across all operations.
* Drive a culture of safety excellence and regulatory compliance across all Syntys sites.
* Lead incident prevention, reporting, and response initiatives to minimize operational disruptions and ensure employee well-being.
* Ensure robust risk management practices are embedded in all operational activities.

**Sustainability & Environmental Responsibility**

* Lead the development and implementation of sustainability strategies that align with Syntys’ environmental, social, and governance (ESG) commitments.
* Drive operational initiatives to reduce environmental impact, improve energy efficiency, and promote sustainable power strategies within Syntys operations.
* Collaborate with the CEO, Commercial, and Engineering teams to integrate sustainability into operational and infrastructure planning.
* Represent Syntys in sustainability-related forums and with external stakeholders.

**Leadership & Team Development**

* Build, lead, and develop high-performing operational teams across HQ and Markets, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, and operational excellence.
* Set clear performance expectations, KPIs, and development plans for operational leaders and teams.
* Ensure effective succession planning and leadership development within the operations function.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with Commercial, Engineering, Finance, HR, and Legal teams to ensure operational alignment with strategic business objectives.
* Support Commercial teams in translating client requirements, especially from hyperscalers, into operational deliverables.
* Collaborate on infrastructure development plans to ensure operational readiness and sustainability integration.

**EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS**

* Minimum 15 years of progressive leadership experience in data center operations, infrastructure, or technology-driven environments.
* Proven experience managing hyperscaler operations, client requirements, and critical infrastructure.
* Strong background in IT operations, procurement, supplier management, and EHS.
* Demonstrated success in leading sustainability initiatives within an operational environment.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Operations, Business, IT, or a related field (required).
* Master’s degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, or equivalent (preferred).
* Fluent in English; Arabic language capability preferred.

### **Job Description**

**Dean of Students**
====================

**Department:** Student Affairs / Pastoral Care
  
**Direct Reports:** As assigned
  
**Location:** School Campus
  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Job Purpose**
---------------

The Dean of Students is responsible for promoting a safe, positive, inclusive, and supportive school environment in which students can thrive academically, socially, and personally.

The role provides strategic and day-to-day leadership of student wellbeing, behaviour, discipline, attendance, student engagement, and pastoral systems. The Dean works closely with school leadership, teachers, counsellors, parents, and support staff to ensure that student-related matters are managed consistently, fairly, and in accordance with school policies and procedures.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **1. Student Behaviour and Discipline**

* Lead and oversee the school's student behaviour and discipline processes.
* Ensure that behaviour expectations and consequences are applied consistently and fairly.
* Investigate and manage significant student behaviour incidents and disciplinary cases.
* Maintain accurate records of disciplinary incidents, interventions, and outcomes.
* Work with teachers and school leaders to develop appropriate behaviour interventions and support plans.
* Monitor recurring behaviour concerns and identify patterns requiring further intervention.
* Support restorative practices and strategies that promote accountability and positive behaviour.
* Escalate serious or repeated concerns to the appropriate member of the Senior Leadership Team.

### **2. Student Wellbeing and Pastoral Care**

* Promote a positive school culture focused on student wellbeing, belonging, respect, and inclusion.
* Work closely with school counsellors and pastoral staff to identify and support students requiring additional assistance.
* Monitor students who may be experiencing academic, social, behavioural, or personal difficulties.
* Coordinate appropriate interventions and follow-up support.
* Ensure student concerns are appropriately documented, managed, and escalated where required.
* Promote student voice and encourage students to take an active role in the school community.

### **3. Attendance and Student Engagement**

* Monitor student attendance, punctuality, and patterns of absence.
* Work with relevant staff and parents to address persistent attendance or punctuality concerns.
* Identify students who may be disengaged from school and coordinate appropriate interventions.
* Support initiatives designed to improve attendance, participation, and student engagement.

### **4. Safeguarding and Student Protection**

* Work collaboratively with the school's safeguarding team to promote student safety and welfare.
* Follow all school safeguarding policies and procedures.
* Report and escalate safeguarding concerns in accordance with school requirements.
* Maintain appropriate confidentiality when dealing with sensitive student matters.
* Contribute to safeguarding education, awareness, and prevention initiatives.

### **5. Parent and Community Relations**

* Serve as a key point of contact for parents and guardians regarding significant student behaviour, wellbeing, attendance, and pastoral matters.
* Conduct meetings with parents to discuss concerns, interventions, and student progress.
* Communicate professionally and constructively, particularly when dealing with sensitive or challenging situations.
* Build positive relationships with families and promote partnership between home and school.

### **6. Student Leadership and Activities**

* Support and develop student leadership opportunities.
* Encourage student participation in school activities, events, clubs, and community initiatives.
* Support student councils and other student leadership structures.
* Promote student responsibility, leadership, citizenship, and positive contribution to the school community.

### **7. School Culture and Community**

* Promote the school's values, expectations, and standards of conduct.
* Contribute to initiatives that strengthen school culture, student belonging, and community spirit.
* Support the organisation and delivery of assemblies, student events, campaigns, and wellbeing initiatives.
* Act as a visible and approachable presence around the school campus.

### **8. Staff Support and Collaboration**

* Provide guidance to teachers and staff regarding student behaviour, pastoral concerns, and appropriate interventions.
* Work collaboratively with Heads of School, Heads of Department, Year Leaders, Counsellors, SEN/SEND staff, and other relevant teams.
* Support staff in implementing consistent behaviour and pastoral expectations.
* Deliver or coordinate staff training related to student behaviour, wellbeing, safeguarding, and pastoral care where appropriate.

### **9. Data, Reporting and Continuous Improvement**

* Maintain accurate student records relating to behaviour, attendance, wellbeing, and interventions.
* Analyse student behaviour and attendance data to identify trends and areas requiring action.
* Prepare reports for school leadership as required.
* Evaluate the effectiveness of student support and behaviour systems.
* Recommend improvements to policies, procedures, and student support programmes.

### **10. Leadership and School Operations**

* Contribute to the development and implementation of school policies relating to students.
* Participate in leadership meetings and relevant school committees.
* Support the Principal and Vice Principal with student-related matters and school-wide initiatives.
* Assist with crisis management and major student incidents when required.
* Undertake other duties reasonably assigned by the Principal or designated member of the Senior Leadership Team.

**Qualifications and Experience**
---------------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Education, Psychology, Social Sciences, Leadership, or a related field.
* Relevant postgraduate qualification or leadership qualification is desirable.
* Previous experience in a school-based pastoral, student affairs, behaviour, safeguarding, or leadership role.
* Experience managing complex student behaviour and wellbeing matters.
* Experience working collaboratively with parents, teachers, school leaders, and external professionals.
* Knowledge of safeguarding principles and child protection practices.
* Experience in an international or multicultural school environment is desirable.

**Skills and Competencies**
---------------------------

* Strong leadership and interpersonal skills.
* Excellent communication and relationship-building abilities.
* Strong understanding of student behaviour, wellbeing, and pastoral care.
* Excellent conflict-resolution and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information appropriately.
* Strong organisational and case-management skills.
* Ability to remain calm and professional in challenging situations.
* Strong decision-making and judgement.
* Ability to work effectively with students from diverse cultural and social backgrounds.
* Proficiency in maintaining accurate records and using student information systems.
* Commitment to safeguarding, inclusion, student wellbeing, and educational excellence.

**Personal Attributes**
-----------------------

The successful candidate will demonstrate:

* Integrity and professionalism.
* Empathy and emotional maturity.
* Fairness, consistency, and sound judgement.
* A student-centred approach.
* Resilience and composure.
* Strong accountability and ownership.
* Collaborative and approachable leadership.
* Commitment to continuous improvement.
* Ability to build trust with students, parents, and colleagues.

**Key Performance Areas**
-------------------------

Performance in the role may be assessed against:

* Effectiveness of student behaviour and discipline systems.
* Student wellbeing and pastoral support.
* Attendance and punctuality improvement.
* Consistency and effectiveness of behaviour interventions.
* Quality and timeliness of student case management and documentation.
* Parent and student engagement.
* Safeguarding compliance.
* Student leadership and engagement initiatives.
* Staff support and collaboration.
* Contribution to a positive and inclusive school culture.

Title: Future Talent - CSO Trainee
Description:
Job Title: Future Talent - CSO Trainee

Job Location:

Denton, Texas United States

*At Tetra Pak we commit to making food safe and available, everywhere; and we protect what's good – protecting food, protecting people, and protecting the planet. By doing so we touch millions of people's lives every day.*

*And we need people like you to make it happen.*

***We empower you to reach your potential with opportunities to make an impact to be proud of – for food, people and the planet.***

**Future Talent - Maintenance Engineer Trainee**
------------------------------------------------

***On the Service Delivery Track of our Future Talent Programme, your work goes beyond borders and makes a difference to communities worldwide. Our presence across the globe puts new projects and innovations in your reach, all with freedom to learn, grow and develop.***

***It’s opportunities like this that give your career the head start it deserves.***

***Join us and make an impact to be proud of – for food, people and the planet. Future Talent - Maintenance Engineer Trainee***

At Tetra Pak, you will have the freedom to use your expertise and deliver world-class services and solutions that make a real difference. As part of our Future Talent Program – Service Delivery Track, a 24-month journey crafted to help you unlock your potential and make a meaningful impact.

  

This program will develop your hands-on skills in an accelerated way to become a technical expert in Services, which is the area in charge of the maintenance, troubleshooting, installations and commissioning of Tetra Pak’s machines that are in our customers’ facilities. As a valued team member, you’ll follow a development plan tailored to your role, filled with learning experiences on the Tetra Pak production lines installed in our customers’ factories.

  

As a Future Talent – CSO Trainee, you will learn how to perform preventive and corrective maintenance, support equipment installations, troubleshoot technical issues, and contribute to performance validation and continuous improvement. Through project rotations and on-site assignments, you’ll gain hands-on experience with technologies across electrical, mechanical and automation domains, working on Filling Equipment, Distribution Equipment, Processing Systems and Components. You’ll also collaborate closely with customers, learning how their operations run and supporting them in areas such as calibrations, equipment assessment and service delivery in the Food and Beverage industry.

  

By the end of the program, you’ll be ready to take on a field-based engineering role, equipped with the technical depth, customer focus and problem-solving mindset needed to deliver high-quality service and build strong relationships with our clients. This is your opportunity to grow with purpose and make a lasting impact.

  

We are looking for recent grads that are highly driven, have an innovative mindset, an aptitude for problem solving, passion in applying theoretical knowledge to real challenges, strong communication skills and are true team players that enjoy working with people from various cultures.

  

No matter what you do, you play a part in achieving our purpose. We commit to making food safe and available everywhere, and we promise to protect what’s good: food, people, and the planet. As you advance your skills in an environment where you’ll truly feel supported, you’ll gain broad insights into our company, our culture, and our values.

  

This is a24‑month technical development program focused on industrial maintenance, troubleshooting, installation, and commissioning of food and beverage processing and packaging equipment at customer manufacturing sites.This role is designed for early‑career technical graduates from associate degree, certification, or hands‑on technical programs.

  

Join us, and make an impact to be proud of!

  

We have 2 possible Start Dates for the Future Talent Program: **February 8, 2027** or **July 19, 2027.**

This is a remote position that requires travel to customer sites across the United States.

You may be required to travel 80% sites of your time domestically to customers sites.

Tetra Pak is not sponsoring work visas or relocation for this position.

**What you will do**
--------------------

**As a Future Talent - Maintenace Engineer Trainee, you will learn to:**

  

* Perform preventive, corrective, and reliability‑focused maintenance
* Diagnose and troubleshooting mechanical, electrical, and automation faults
* Support equipment installation, commissioning, and startup activities
* Interpret electrical schematics
* Use PLC software (e.g., Allen‑Bradley and Siemens) for diagnostics and functional checks
* Apply root cause analysis and continuous improvement practices
* Complete service documentation and maintenance records
* Follow lockout/tagout (LOTO), machine safety, and site‑specific safety procedures
* Collaborate with experienced service engineers, technicians, and customer maintenance teams

**We believe you have**
-----------------------

**Degrees and Certifications:**

* Associate degrees
* Technical diplomas or certifications
* Trade, vocational, or military technical training programs
  

**Relevant fields include (but are not limited to):**

* Industrial Maintenance Technology
* Electromechanical Technology
* Automation and Control Systems
* Electrical or Mechanical Technology
* Mechatronics
* Diesel Technology
* Heavy Equipment Maintenance
* Industrial Robotics

Bachelor’s degrees in engineering or related disciplines are **welcome but not required** .

  

**Location & Travel Requirements**

* **Home‑based position**

**Program Eligibility**

* Graduation or expected graduation between **2025 and 2027**
* Willingness to travel for on‑site customer support
* Valid U.S. driver’s license required
* Authorized to work in the U.S.
  

**Career Progression**

Upon successful completion of the 24‑month program, trainees are prepared to move into a field‑based service or maintenance engineering role, supporting customer equipment uptime, performance, and reliability.

This compensation range is based on a full-time schedule. The estimate displayed is just one component of Tetra Pak's total compensation package for employees. Other rewards include annual performance bonus, competitive benefits, and work-related allowances.

* A culture that pioneers a spirit of innovation where our industry experts drive visible results

Title: Oshawa Power Control Room Operator
Description:
**CONTROL ROOM OPERATOR**
-------------------------

Oshawa Power Group of Companies is a parent company of fiber optic, district energy and renewable generation businesses, and the local electricity distribution company that supplies electricity to more than 63,000 customers in the city of Oshawa. Located just 45 minutes east of Toronto off the shores of Lake Ontario, Oshawa serves as the economic engine for the Durham Region. Oshawa Power maintains 1000 km of overhead and underground distribution lines within a 150 km2 service territory, operated at 44 and 13.8 kV, supplied by 9 distribution and 3 transmission substations. The organization is committed to the safe, reliable and efficient delivery of electricity through responsible financial management, strategic reinvestment and continuous innovation.

**ABOUT THIS OPPORTUNITY**

Reporting to the Manager, Distribution Construction, the Control Room Operator is responsible for the safe, reliable and efficient real-time operation and control of the company's electrical distribution and sub-transmission systems during normal, planned, abnormal and emergency conditions.

As a designated Controlling Authority, the position monitors system conditions, authorizes and directs switching, administers work protection, coordinates field response and manages power restoration while protecting employees, contractors, the public and electrical equipment.

**Hourly Rate:** $44.99- $59.23 per our Collective Agreement with **IBEW 636**

**Vacancy Type:** Replacement

**AS THE SUCCESSFUL APPLICANT, YOU HAVE THE OPPORTUNITY TO BE INVOLVED WITH:**

**System Operations & Monitoring**

* Exercise real-time operational control of the company's distribution, sub-transmission and station systems during normal, planned, abnormal and emergency conditions.
* Monitor SCADA, ADMS, GIS, alarms, voltage, loading, equipment status and other operating information; identify abnormal conditions and take or direct timely corrective action to maintain safe and reliable system operation.
* Authorize and direct the safe operation of switches, breakers, reclosers, intelligent field devices, station equipment and other electrical apparatus.
* Monitor feeder, station, transformer and equipment loading; respect established ratings and operating limits and initiate or recommend corrective action.
* Use automated and self-healing distribution devices to support sectionalizing, fault isolation, load transfer and service restoration.

**Switching & Work Protection**

* Prepare, check, issue and administer switching orders, Orders to Operate, Hold-Offs, work permits and other work protection documents in accordance with the Utility Work Protection Code (UWPC), Electrical Utility Safety Rules (EUSR), and company procedures.
* Control and authorize operational access to electrical plant and equipment in accordance with the UWPC, EUSR, and company procedures.
* Review planned work with field crews, supervisors, contractors and authorized parties to confirm system configuration, isolation requirements, operating sequences and appropriate work protection.
* Direct overhead, underground, station and sub-transmission switching for planned work, system reconfiguration, load transfers, equipment isolation and service restoration.

**Outage & Emergency Response**

* Coordinate planned and unplanned interruptions; dispatch and direct field personnel to investigate trouble, isolate hazards, complete emergency repairs and safely restore service.
* Assess disturbances and establish restoration priorities that protect public and employee safety, safeguard equipment, maintain system integrity and minimize customer impact.
* Respond to emergencies involving downed conductors, damaged equipment, fires, motor-vehicle incidents, public hazards and possible life-safety concerns.

**Coordination & Communication**

* Coordinate planned and emergency switching, supply interruptions, load transfers and station operations with Hydro One's control centre.
* Communicate with the IESO, Electrical Safety Authority, emergency services, neighbouring LDCs, contractors, major customers and other authorities as required.
* Provide clear operational direction to field personnel and accurate, timely outage and system information to internal and external stakeholders.
* Respond professionally to customer inquiries involving outages, partial power, voltage concerns and other distribution-system conditions, and arrange investigation as required.

**Operating Records, Systems & Improvement**

* Maintain accurate operating diagrams, maps, open-point records, equipment status information, switching records, outage records, operating logs and required reports.
* Support investigations of system events, equipment operations, interruptions, power-quality concerns and feeder performance, and assist with corrective actions.
* Assist with the development and continuous improvement of operating procedures, emergency and restoration plans, switching practices and System Control Center processes.

**Training, Safety & Other Requirements**

* Provide instruction and operational support to Apprentice or backup operators and maintain required technical, safety, emergency-response and cybersecurity training.
* Comply with the Occupational Health and Safety Act, applicable regulations, UWPC, EUSR, company policies and safe work practices.
* Available for emergency response, overtime and call-ins on an as-needed basis in accordance with established schedules and the collective agreement. Rotational shifts may be introduced in the future and would be included in the collective agreement.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**WHAT YOU HAVE TO OFFER**

**Education:**

* Three-year college diploma in Electrical Engineering Technology, Electronics Engineering Technology or a related electrical discipline; an equivalent combination of relevant utility experience, education and technical training may be considered.
* Successful completion of the MEARIE Operator-in-Training Program and certification as an EDA Journeyperson Electrical Operator is required.
* OACETT certification, or eligibility for certification, as a C.E.T. or C.Tech. is considered an asset.
* Current UWPC certification is required.

**Experience:**

* Minimum four years of progressively responsible experience in electrical distribution-system operations, System Control Center operations, utility field operations, protection and control, stations or a directly related electrical utility function.
* Demonstrated experience with SCADA, ADMS, GIS, switching orders, work protection, system isolations, load transfers and service restoration.
* Experience coordinating field crews and external authorities during planned work, outages and emergencies.
* Experience operating 13.8 kV distribution and 44 kV sub-transmission systems, including associated stations and protection schemes, is preferred.

**Required Competencies**

* Advanced knowledge of overhead and underground distribution, sub-transmission, transformer stations, protection schemes and associated equipment.
* Advanced knowledge and practical application of the UWPC, electrical isolation, switching and work-protection principles.
* Strong understanding of electrical fundamentals, loading, voltage, equipment ratings, fault response, system restoration and operating contingencies.
* Ability to interpret and maintain single-line diagrams, operating maps, schematics, wiring diagrams, engineering drawings and switching documents.
* Ability to assess complex, changing conditions and make timely, accurate and defensible operating decisions with minimal supervision.
* Advanced problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to remain calm and decisive during outages and emergencies.
* High accuracy and attention to detail when preparing and administering operating and work-protection documents.
* Strong organization and time-management skills, with the ability to coordinate simultaneous switching, outage, dispatch and communication activities.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including clear and unambiguous direction by radio, telephone and electronic systems.
* Ability to direct field activities and establish operational priorities without direct supervisory authority.
* Professional interpersonal skills and the ability to work effectively with employees, contractors, customers, emergency services, regulators and other utilities.
* Proficiency with SCADA, ADMS, GIS, Microsoft Office and other operational technology systems.
* Strong commitment to safety, system reliability, customer service, teamwork, respect and continuous improvement.
* Ability to work established schedules and maintain the concentration required to safely manage multiple concurrent activities, including rotational shifts if introduced in the future.
* Valid Ontario Class G driver's licence with a driving record satisfactory to the company.

Title: Receiving Clerk

The Receiving Clerk is responsible for checking in all incoming product and guest packages. This person is also responsible for shipping packages and in house needs.

Researches a range of HR related issues and assists in the preparation of notes/reports. • Performs other related duties, as assigned.

Shows pride in work and in achievements; demonstrates professional competence and mastery of subject matter; is conscientious and efficient in meeting commitments, observing deadlines and achieving results; is motivated by professional rather than personal concerns; shows persistence when faced with difficult problems or challenges; remains calm in stressful situations.
