**Description**

At the International Finance Corporation (IFC), a member of the World Bank Group (WBG), you’ll join a diverse, global community working across cultures, disciplines, and borders to address the world’s most pressing development challenges. With 1.2 billion young people reaching working age in the decade ahead, the challenge of job creation has never been greater. Through partnerships across 145 countries and more than 182 offices worldwide, we work with governments, private sector, development partners and other stakeholders to invest in people, strengthen markets, and deliver scalable, data-driven solutions that generate more and better jobs and improve lives. In fiscal year 2026, IFC committed a record $105.6 billion to private companies and financial institutions in developing countries. For more information, visit www.ifc.org.

Private sector financial development is essential to the promotion of successful and sustainable economies in low- and middle-income countries around the world. Infrastructure plays a key role in sustained economic growth by providing critical public services to the citizens in a country as well as a platform for efficient operation of businesses that create jobs. The private sector plays an increasingly important role in the financing and delivery of infrastructure and public services, including through Corporate Finance Services.

IFC’s transaction advisory services department (CTA) is housed in the World Bank Group’s Client’s and Products Vice Presidency (CCPVP) and consists of two business lines:

* PPP Transaction Advisory (C3P) offers transaction advisory services to governments design, structure PPP transactions in infrastructure to help client governments partner with the private sector to deliver affordable and high-quality infrastructure.
* Corporate Finance Services (CFS) has three key product offerings: (1) M&A Advisory: supporting investment departments in business development and creating investment opportunities; (2) Equity Mobilization Program (EMP): supporting third party equity mobilization alongside IFC investment; (3) Asset monetization involving listed or listing public entities.

CTA has mobilized $6.6B for FY25 which translates into around 17% of IFC’s total core mobilization, of which CFS mobilized over $1.5B of this amount. The department is expected to continue playing a leading role in mobilizing private capital for the WBG.

CFS is seeking a (Senior) Investment Officer with strong M&A experience to help support the execution of our business strategy in the Middle East, Turkey and Central Asia Region. The position will be based in Dubai, UAE and will report to the Global Manager, CFS. The (Senior) Investment Officer will support the CFS regional teams with global capacity, with the objective of facilitating business development and executing transactions

**Duties and accountabilities:**

* Contribute to the development and implementation of CFS’s strategy, working closely with regional and World Bank Group teams to advance business priorities and support delivery against WBG strategic objectives, with a particular focus on the MCA region.
* Collaborating with regional leads to originate, structure, and execute EMP and M&A advisory mandates across the MCA region, including buy-side and sell-side transactions, restructuring advisory, and EMP services.
* Lead the origination and execution of strategic pre-IPO advisory mandates across the five regions, working closely with relevant regional, industry, and advisory teams.
* Advise clients on listing readiness, process, timing, and regulatory considerations, including the assessment of corporate and balance sheet structures, valuation and business plans; development of listing roadmaps and timetables; broker selection and prospectus review; preparation of management teams and Boards for listing; and coordination with relevant corporate governance advisory teams, as appropriate.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with regional and industry counterparts, identifying opportunities for collaboration that strengthen business development, enhance transaction delivery, and support IFC’s corporate and regional objectives.
* Develop and manage strong client relationships, working closely with multi-regional clients and relevant IFC teams to develop transaction strategies and provide advice on bankability, funding feasibility, financial modeling, business planning, and restructuring.
* Provide senior-level oversight and guidance on the preparation of key transaction materials and project documentation, including transaction marketing materials, information memoranda, due diligence and transaction structuring reports, and transaction contracts and agreements, ensuring high-quality analytical and transaction outputs.
* Mentor and support junior colleagues, providing guidance on transaction execution, client engagement, and business development, and helping strengthen team capabilities and delivery against business objectives.
* Contribute to strengthening IFC’s positioning and visibility in the CFS space, leveraging IFC’s regional presence, client relationships, and broader communications strategy to support market development and business origination.

**Selection Criteria**

* Master’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, or another relevant field, with at least 8 years of relevant professional experience, preferably 12 or more years of experience in investment banking, corporate finance, M&A advisory, or other relevant areas.
* Seasoned in equity transactions, as a principal investor, an advisor, or underwriter, including in an investment bank, VC, PE type institution.
* Transaction advisory experience in buy side mandates, sell side mandates, restructuring mandates, preferably in the disruptive technology space.
* Track record of delivering targeted results on M&A, Restructuring and IPO mandates under stressful timetables and environment.
* Proven success in developing strong client relationships and executing mandates across-borders and in difficult environments.
* Experience taking companies public on major international stock exchanges such as the New York stock exchange, London Stock exchange etc, is plus.
* Strong track record of business delivery, demonstrated investment experience, superior business judgment and established professional credibility.
* Excellent team player and demonstrated ability to work effectively with a dispersed team in a dynamic and multicultural environment.
* Ability to work collaboratively with superior facilitation, and interpersonal skills.
* Strong written and verbal communications skills. English is mandatory, and Arabic and/or Russian would be an asset
* Ability to represent IFC externally and to develop and manage relationships with clients, media, donors, and other stakeholders.
* Ability to use commercially available LLM tools like Claude, ChatGPT and Copilot for research, analysis, and drafting in investment, validate outputs against primary sources, and remain accountable for recommendations
* Commitment to development and alignment with the World Bank Group and IFC's mission, strategy, and values.

As the World Bank Group continues to evolve, we value candidates who:  

* Demonstrate the ability to collaborate effectively across teams, disciplines, cultures, and institutional boundaries.
* Responsibly leverage digital and AI-enabled tools to enhance productivity, learning, and decision-making.
* Bring experience working in fragile, conflict-affected, and violent (FCV) contexts and are encouraged to highlight relevant experience in their application materials, where applicable.

**WBG Culture Attributes:**

1. Sense of urgency: Anticipate and quickly respond to the needs of internal and external stakeholders.  
2. Thoughtful risk-taking: Challenge the status quo and push boundaries to achieve greater impact.
  
3. Empowerment and accountability: Empower yourself and others to act and hold each other accountable for results.

Title: Home Care Startup & Operations Consultant – Ontario
Description:
Home Care Startup & Operations Consultant – Ontario

**Company:** Altura Care Group Inc.  
**Location:** Mississauga, Ontario (Hybrid / Remote, with occasional GTA meetings)  
**Job Type:** Contract / Project-Based Consulting  
**Compensation:** Negotiable based on experience, project scope and deliverables  
**Schedule:** Flexible, with sufficient availability to support startup planning, implementation and launch

About Altura Care Group Inc.

Altura Care Group Inc. is a newly incorporated Ontario company preparing to launch a premium private home-care service in Mississauga and surrounding GTA communities.

Our goal is to establish a reputable, professionally managed home-care organization providing safe, compassionate, reliable and high-quality services to clients and their families.

We are seeking an experienced **Home Care Startup & Operations Consultant** to work directly with the founder and provide comprehensive, step-by-step guidance throughout the development and launch of our agency.

The founder brings business ownership and management experience but is new to the home-care industry. We are therefore looking for someone who can proactively identify what needs to be done, establish priorities, guide implementation and help build the business from the ground up.

**This is not a traditional nursing position or a role limited to providing occasional professional advice.**

We are looking for someone who has personally participated in establishing, launching, expanding or managing a home-care agency, preferably within Ontario's private-pay home-care sector.

Key Responsibilities1. Startup Planning and Project Leadership

* Evaluate the company's current stage of development.
* Develop a comprehensive startup roadmap, including milestones, priorities, responsibilities and timelines.
* Identify the operational, staffing, administrative and regulatory preparations required before launch.
* Provide proactive, step-by-step guidance throughout the startup process.
* Assist with implementation, coordinate agreed activities and monitor progress.
* Identify when additional specialized professionals are required.

2. Business Model and Operational Development

* Advise on the selection of initial home-care services and service packages.
* Help establish pricing structures, staffing models and operational budgets.
* Develop practical workflows and day-to-day management procedures.
* Assist with organizational planning and operational responsibilities.
* Help establish sustainable processes that can support future business growth.

3. Regulatory Readiness, Policies and Risk Management

* Identify applicable Ontario home-care operational and regulatory requirements.
* Assist with insurance, privacy, employment and workplace safety preparations in coordination with qualified professionals.
* Help develop and implement essential policies, procedures and documentation.
* Establish processes for client intake, care planning, service agreements, incidents, complaints, emergencies and continuity of care.
* Help establish quality assurance and risk-management systems.

4. Recruitment, Staffing and Training

* Advise on the appropriate staffing and management structure.
* Help identify and recruit key local clinical and operational personnel.
* Develop job descriptions, recruitment procedures and interview criteria.
* Establish caregiver screening, onboarding, training and competency-assessment processes.
* Assist with supervision, performance evaluation and ongoing staff development systems.

5. Software and Administrative Systems

* Recommend appropriate home-care management and scheduling software.
* Assist with implementation of client records, care documentation and staff scheduling systems.
* Establish administrative processes for time tracking, invoicing, payroll coordination and reporting.
* Help create practical systems that are efficient, secure and suitable for a growing agency.

6. Business Development, Referral Relationships and Client Acquisition

**Strong preference will be given to candidates with proven hands-on experience acquiring private-pay home-care clients and developing referral relationships.**

An important objective for Altura is establishing a reliable client acquisition process from the beginning.

We are particularly interested in candidates who can help us:

* Develop a practical client acquisition and community outreach strategy for Mississauga and surrounding GTA communities.
* Identify appropriate referral partners, community organizations and professional contacts.
* Establish relationships with retirement residences, healthcare professionals, senior organizations and other relevant community partners.
* Develop introductory presentations, outreach scripts, follow-up procedures and lead tracking systems.
* Guide initial business development activities and participate in outreach where appropriate.
* Help generate and manage qualified client inquiries.
* Train and mentor an existing team member who will gradually assume responsibility for community outreach and business development.
* Establish measurable activities and sustainable processes for ongoing client acquisition.

**We recognize that startup operations and business development are distinct areas of expertise.**

Candidates who are exceptionally qualified in startup operations but do not personally specialize in client acquisition are still encouraged to apply.

In such cases, we are open to engaging a separate experienced home-care business development specialist to lead outreach and train our team member.

7. Operational Launch and Early Client Support

* Develop a comprehensive launch-readiness checklist.
* Help establish client inquiry, assessment, onboarding and service delivery processes.
* Support preparation for accepting the agency's first clients.
* Assist with initial operational challenges and process improvements.
* Guide the transition toward independent day-to-day management by the founder and local team.

8. Ongoing Guidance and Knowledge Transfer

* Provide regular progress meetings and clear recommendations.
* Proactively identify upcoming tasks, priorities and potential challenges.
* Explain important operational decisions and industry practices.
* Help the founder develop the knowledge and confidence to manage the business effectively.
* Deliver agreed project milestones and practical implementation support.

Required Qualifications

* Significant operational, management or business development experience in the home-care industry.
* Direct experience establishing, launching, expanding or managing a home-care agency, preferably in Ontario.
* Strong understanding of home-care staffing, service delivery, operational systems and quality management.
* Demonstrated ability to develop and implement practical business processes.
* Strong project management, communication and organizational skills.
* Ability to work effectively with a business owner who is new to the healthcare industry.
* Sufficient availability to provide consistent support throughout the agreed startup project.

Strongly Preferred Experience

* Founding or helping establish a private-pay home-care agency.
* Successfully developing home-care referral networks and acquiring paying clients.
* Building relationships with retirement residences, healthcare organizations and community partners.
* Leading business development teams or training community outreach staff.
* Experience with the Mississauga and Greater Toronto Area home-care market.
* Developing startup policies, procedures, caregiver training programs and operational systems.

An RN or RPN designation, healthcare management qualification or relevant business consulting background is an asset but is not mandatory.

Ideal Candidate

Our ideal candidate is an experienced home-care professional who understands what it takes to build an agency from its earliest stages.

We value practical experience, initiative, accountability and the ability to guide implementation.

We are not simply looking for someone who can tell us what should be done. We are seeking someone who can help us understand **how to do it, in what order, and how to ensure it is completed successfully.**

The founder will retain responsibility for business ownership, management decisions, financial approvals and ongoing operations.

Consulting Structure

We anticipate a phased consulting arrangement beginning with an assessment of our current stage of development and preparation of a detailed startup roadmap.

Subsequent phases may include operational development, staffing, system implementation, launch preparation and early operational support.

The scope, expected deliverables, timeline, availability and compensation will be agreed upon before commencement.

Application Questions

Please include responses to the following questions with your application:

* Have you personally established, launched or significantly expanded a home-care agency? Please describe the organization, your role and the work you performed.
* What experience do you have developing home-care operational systems, policies, staffing procedures and startup processes?
* Have you personally developed referral relationships or helped acquire private-pay home-care clients? If yes, please describe your approach and results.
* Would you be comfortable leading initial business development activities and training an existing employee to manage community outreach?
* If business development is not your specialty, would you be comfortable collaborating with a separate specialist?
* Can you provide proactive, hands-on guidance from startup planning through operational launch?
* What is your approximate weekly availability, and what consulting fee structure would you propose?
* Are you available for occasional in-person meetings in Mississauga, Ontario?

We welcome applications from experienced home-care agency founders, operations directors, general managers, startup consultants and healthcare business leaders with relevant operational experience.

Pay: $75.00-$125.00 per hour

Application question(s):

* 1.Have you directly helped launch or establish a home-care agency? Yes / No

2.How many years of home-care operations or management experience do you have? Numeric

3.Have you personally acquired private-pay home-care clients? Yes / No

4.Have you developed or managed a home-care referral network? Yes / No

5.Can you commit sufficient time to a project extending through launch? Yes / No

Title: Principal Network Developer
Description:
As a Principal Network Development Engineer within NAT, you will serve as a senior technical leader for network acquisition, connectivity delivery, and activation across OCI’s global infrastructure. You will guide the engineering execution of connectivity supporting OCI regions, AI infrastructure, capacity expansion, backbone growth, and strategic network deployments.

You will operate at the intersection of network architecture, telecommunications, optical infrastructure, service providers, data center engineering, deployment, and operations. Your scope will span carrier circuits, dark and lit fiber, DWDM and wavelength services, optical transport, Internet transit, peering, backbone connectivity, cross-connects, and data center interconnects. You will translate complex network designs and business requirements into clear technical specifications, implementation approaches, and acceptance criteria for internal teams and infrastructure partners.

At the Principal level, you will lead engineering decisions across programs and deployments, resolve ambiguous technical requirements, and evaluate tradeoffs involving capacity, performance, resiliency, physical route diversity, operational supportability, and delivery constraints. You will partner with architecture and engineering teams to identify implementation gaps early and use delivery and operational experience to influence future designs, technical standards, and supplier requirements.

You will establish the technical requirements for circuit acceptance, fiber and optical validation, turn-up, activation, and production readiness. You will guide teams in evaluating test evidence, resolving deficiencies, and documenting readiness decisions, exceptions, and remediation requirements before operational handoff. As a senior technical escalation point, you will lead the resolution of complex Layer 1 through Layer 3 issues across OCI teams and external providers, drive root cause analysis, and ensure recurring failures result in corrective actions and engineering improvements.

You will work closely with Program Managers to assess technical risks, dependencies, blockers, and recovery options across the delivery portfolio. You will strengthen NAT’s engineering practices through reusable standards, Methods of Procedure, runbooks, acceptance frameworks, accurate infrastructure records, and clear operational handoffs. You will also guide the use of automation, scripting, telemetry, database management tools, and AI-assisted engineering to improve validation, troubleshooting, data quality, and delivery efficiency while maintaining engineering rigor and validating outputs.

This role requires deep network engineering expertise, sound technical judgment, and the ability to drive complex outcomes across organizations and external suppliers. You will influence technical direction, mentor engineers, and raise engineering standards across NAT, with an emphasis on repeatable practices that improve connectivity quality, reliability, and readiness at global scale.

  

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

**What You'll Do**
==================

* Provide senior technical leadership for complex global connectivity programs supporting OCI regions, AI infrastructure, capacity expansion, and strategic network deployments.
* Own technical outcomes across the lifecycle of carrier circuits, dark fiber, lit fiber, wavelengths, optical transport, Internet transit, peering, backbone connectivity, cross-connects, and data center interconnects.
* Translate high-level network architecture and business requirements into detailed technical delivery requirements and implementation strategies.
* Lead technical design reviews covering topology, physical paths, diversity, demarcation, transport, interfaces, optics, capacity, routing, resiliency, and operational readiness.
* Identify design and delivery risks early and drive engineering decisions that prevent downstream deployment and operational issues.
* Define technical acceptance standards and validation requirements for network infrastructure delivered by external providers.
* Lead complex Layer 1 through Layer 3 troubleshooting across fiber, optical transport, Ethernet, routing, and provider networks.
* Serve as a senior escalation point for systemic or high-impact connectivity issues.
* Lead deep-dive root cause analysis and drive permanent corrective actions across Oracle and supplier engineering organizations.
* Act as a technical authority in supplier engagements, challenging proposed solutions and ensuring services meet OCI engineering, reliability, scalability, and operational requirements.
* Partner with Program Managers to assess technical risk, establish delivery strategy, make tradeoffs, and develop recovery plans for critical infrastructure.
* Lead cross-functional engineering efforts involving network architecture, backbone, Internet, optical, capacity, deployment, operations, data center teams, and suppliers.
* Develop technical standards, design patterns, acceptance criteria, Methods of Procedure, runbooks, and engineering best practices that can be applied globally.
* Identify systemic gaps in network acquisition and delivery and lead technical improvements that increase quality, predictability, and operational readiness.
* Influence supplier capabilities, technical roadmaps, testing methodologies, and service offerings based on OCI requirements.
* Lead or contribute to technical evaluation of new carriers, services, hardware, optical technologies, and connectivity solutions.
* Define requirements for automation and tooling that improve network delivery, validation, monitoring, inventory accuracy, and troubleshooting.
* Partner with software and automation teams to ensure engineering requirements are translated into scalable tools and workflows.
* Use AI-assisted engineering tools to accelerate technical analysis, troubleshooting, documentation, and solution development while maintaining engineering rigor.
* Provide technical coaching and mentorship to NDEs, Program Managers, and partner teams.
* Raise the technical bar for NAT and serve as a trusted technical advisor across the organization.

**Critical Focus Areas**
========================

* Global carrier and service provider networking
* Optical transport, DWDM, dark fiber, lit fiber, and wavelengths
* Internet transit, peering, and inter-domain networking
* Backbone and metro connectivity
* Network architecture and resiliency
* Circuit and fiber acceptance
* Layer 1 through Layer 3 troubleshooting
* Supplier technical leadership
* Network readiness and production acceptance
* Root cause analysis and systemic remediation
* Technical standards and engineering governance
* Automation requirements and AI-assisted engineering

**Qualifications**
==================

* Extensive experience designing, building, operating, or delivering large-scale networks within hyperscale cloud, Tier 1 ISP, telecommunications, service provider, or comparable environments.
* Expert-level knowledge in at least one networking domain such as routing, optical transport, Internet, backbone, or data center networking, with strong knowledge across multiple adjacent domains.
* Deep understanding of network architectures and network device behavior.
* Strong knowledge of routing and networking protocols including BGP, OSPF, IS-IS, MPLS, TCP/IP, IPv4, and IPv6.
* Deep experience troubleshooting complex network problems across physical, optical, Ethernet, transport, and routing layers.
* Strong understanding of optical networking, fiber infrastructure, structured cabling, cross-connects, transceivers, and physical network design.
* Experience with Internet peering, transit, inter-domain networking, backbone infrastructure, or large-scale service provider connectivity.
* Experience translating high-level architectures into detailed technical designs and implementation requirements.
* Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical initiatives involving multiple engineers and cross-functional organizations.
* Experience working directly with supplier engineering teams to resolve technical issues and improve infrastructure solutions.
* Demonstrated ability to serve as an escalation point and lead root cause analysis for complex or large-scale network events.
* Strong technical judgment and ability to evaluate tradeoffs involving architecture, resiliency, performance, cost, schedule, and operational complexity.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate technical issues and recommendations to engineering and senior leadership audiences.
* Experience with scripting or programming and a strong understanding of software development and network automation concepts.
* Experience defining technical requirements for automation, tooling, monitoring, or operational systems.

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* Experience designing or delivering carrier connectivity at global scale.
* Deep experience with dark fiber, lit fiber, DWDM, optical transport, wavelengths, metro fiber, or long-haul networks.
* Experience with OTDR, optical power testing, fiber characterization, acceptance testing, and complex optical troubleshooting.
* Experience working directly with major telecommunications carriers, ISPs, fiber providers, optical vendors, or colocation providers.
* Experience with network diversity, route engineering, physical path analysis, and resiliency requirements.
* Experience with Internet peering, transit architecture, BGP policy, and inter-domain networking.
* Experience supporting hyperscale AI or GPU infrastructure.
* Familiarity with Broadcom and NVIDIA/Mellanox-based networking platforms.
* Familiarity with YANG, OpenConfig, NETCONF, gNMI, telemetry, and model-driven networking.
* Experience influencing supplier technical roadmaps, hardware adoption, testing strategies, or service capabilities.
* Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools to accelerate troubleshooting, analysis, documentation, scripting, and engineering workflows.
* Demonstrated mentorship and technical leadership across engineering organizations.

Title: Logistics Operations Officer
Description:
### KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

#### 1. Shipment & Logistics Coordination

\* Coordinate daily import and export shipments from origin to final delivery.

\* Arrange and monitor \*\*FCL, LCL, air freight, and land transportation\*\*.

\* Coordinate with shipping lines, freight forwarders, airlines, transporters, customs brokers, and clearing agents.

\* Obtain freight quotations and negotiate competitive rates and service terms.

\* Ensure timely booking of containers, vessels, flights, and trucks.

\* Monitor shipment schedules, ETD/ETA, transshipment, delays, and delivery status.

\* Maintain an updated shipment tracker for all active shipments.

#### 2. Import & Export Operations

\* Handle complete import/export logistics documentation.

\* Coordinate \*\*Bill of Lading, Air Waybill, Commercial Invoice, Packing List, Certificate of Origin, Phytosanitary Certificate, Health Certificate, COO and other relevant documents\*\*.

\* Coordinate with suppliers to ensure documents are received accurately and on time.

\* Liaise with customs and relevant government authorities for shipment clearance.

\* Ensure compliance with UAE import regulations and GCC requirements.

\* Coordinate inspection, approval, sampling, and release of shipments where required.

#### 3. Perishable & Food Cargo

\* Manage logistics for \*\*fresh fruits, vegetables, rice, wheat flour, sugar, edible oils and other food products\*\*.

\* Coordinate temperature-controlled transportation and reefer containers where required.

\* Monitor cold-chain requirements and ensure cargo is handled within the required temperature range.

\* Coordinate urgent action in case of cargo delays, port issues, customs holds, or quality concerns.

\* Ensure perishable shipments are prioritized for clearance and delivery.

#### 4. Port, Airport & Customs Coordination

\* Coordinate with \*\*Jebel Ali, Khorfakkan, Fujairah and UAE airports\*\* as required.

\* Coordinate trucking arrangements for container pickup and delivery.

Title: Inflight Training Operations Controller
Description:
Job Summary:

Reporting to the Manager, Crew Planning, the Inflight Training Operations Controller is responsible for the coordination, execution, and oversight of all short-term inflight training activities. This role manages the day-to-day and monthly scheduling of Flight Attendant training programs, ensuring compliance with all regulatory and company training requirements.

Working collaboratively with Inflight Training, Crew Planning, and operational stakeholders, the Controller ensures training activities are effectively scheduled, monitored, and recovered in the event of operational disruptions. The role is critical to maintaining crew qualifications, operational readiness, and compliance with Transport Canada regulations and company standards.

Duties & Responsibilities:

### **Training Operations & Scheduling**

* Execute and manage all short-term (current month and day-of) inflight training schedules.
* Plan, adjust, and optimize training activities within crew management systems.
* Coordinate recovery of disrupted training events, including initial, recurrent, upgrade, and specialized training.
* Schedule and adjust instructor resources to support training delivery requirements.

### **Tracking & Compliance**

* Monitor and track completion of all inflight training to ensure regulatory and company compliance.
* Oversee inflight crew training validity and currency in accordance with Transport Canada regulations and company policies.
* Identify, escalate, and mitigate compliance risks, including expiries or missed training.

### **Coordination & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Liaise with Inflight Training, Crew Scheduling, and external vendors to support training delivery and recovery efforts.
* Partner with Inflight leadership on training priorities, constraints, and operational impacts.
* Communicate training schedules, updates, and changes clearly to inflight crew members.

### **Systems & Administration**

* Maintain accurate training records and scheduling updates within crew management systems.
* Input and validate schedule adjustments and associated pay implications.
* Review and reconcile manual adjustments related to training and crew utilization.

### **Reporting & Monitoring**

* Monitor daily training performance and identify risks to completion or operational readiness.
* Generate and maintain reports on training status, expiries, and recovery plans.
* Provide data-driven insights to support planning and decision-making.

### **Safety & Compliance**

* Actively participate in the Safety Management System (SMS), including reporting hazards and operational irregularities.
* Promote adherence to company safety policies and regulatory requirements.

Behavioural Competencies:

* **Concern for Safety:** Identifying hazardous or potentially hazardous situations and taking appropriate action to maintain a safe environment for self and others.
* **Teamwork:** Working collaboratively with others to achieve organizational goals.
* **Passenger/Customer Service:** Providing service excellence to internal and/or external customers (passengers).
* **Initiative:** Dealing with situations and issues proactively and persistently, seizing opportunities that arise.
* **Results Focus:** Focusing efforts on achieving high quality results consistent with the organization’s standards.
* **Fostering Communication:** Listening and communicating openly, honestly, and respectfully with different audiences, promoting dialogue and building consensus.

Qualifications:

* Minimum 1 year of experience in Crew Scheduling, Crew Planning, Training Coordination, or a related operational role
* Experience in inflight operations or training environments is considered an asset
* Familiarity with aviation regulatory requirements (e.g., Transport Canada Cabin Safety) is preferred
* Experience with crew management systems (e.g., Navblue or similar platforms) is an asset
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and Google Workspace
* Strong organizational and time management skills with exceptional attention to detail
* Ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced, operational environment
* Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities
* Effective interpersonal and communication (written and verbal) skills

This role goes beyond traditional project coordination and administration. You will serve as a strategic integrator, working closely with Project Managers, Program Managers, Project Coordinators, Finance, and stakeholders across the organization to ensure projects remain aligned with approved scope, schedule, budget, quality, and governance requirements.

**What You Will Do**
--------------------

Reporting to the Head of Renewable Energy Programs, you will provide project controls leadership and coordination across a large and complex portfolio of renewable energy, fleet electrification, charging infrastructure, energy storage, solar generation, and facility modernization projects that support TTC's transition to a net-zero fleet.

  

As one of only two Project Controls Coordinators supporting the portfolio, you will serve as a key interface between project teams, finance, project management, and TTC stakeholders, ensuring project controls processes are consistently applied and project performance is effectively monitored throughout the project lifecycle.

  

You will work closely with Senior Project Managers, Program Managers, Project Coordinators, consultants, contractors, and internal stakeholders to coordinate planning and scheduling activities, maintain cost controls, manage budgets and forecasts, monitor project performance, and support governance and reporting requirements. Through ongoing analysis and engagement with project delivery teams, you will ensure decision-makers have accurate and timely information regarding project health, risks, costs, schedules, and forecast outcomes.

From Geneva, UNOPS facilitates the achievement of the 2030 Agenda and the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), working with governments, other United Nations (UN) agencies and partners by providing quality servces, integrated solutions and management support through strategic, cost-effective and results-oriented approches. This includes supporting platforms and hosting high-profile, flagship initiatives and funds focusing on health, nutrition, water and sanitation, sustainable cities, environment, energy, climate and trade. UNOPS is a recognized resource for the UN system in Geneva – from fund management and oversight and advisory services, to providing hosting solutions to a range of global initiatives, as well as operational support to partner organizations.

### **Job Specific Context**

UNOPS Geneva Office is providing support to a wide range of portfolios, including UNEP, UNICEF, UNHCR, and other partners.

  
  

UNICEF works in some of the world’s toughest places, to reach the world’s most disadvantaged children. To save their lives. To defend their rights. To help them fulfill their potential.

  
  

This position is a Partner Personnel role. UNOPS is supporting UNICEF-DI as a UN partner and is acting on its behalf to provide recruitment and administrative support for this position. The selected candidate will be recruited through UNOPS in accordance with UNOPS recruitment rules, and will be engaged as UNICEF-DI personnel. The incumbent will work under the effective management and supervision of UNICEF-DI, not UNOPS.

  
  

**About UNICEF Digital Impact Division (DID)**

  
  

Digital Impact Division (DID) is at the heart of reshaping how UNICEF delivers lasting results for children. We are committed to harnessing the full potential of emerging digital technologies

to advance UNICEF’s mission.

  
  

DID works in close collaboration with regional Digital Impact teams and colleagues across headquarters divisions, regions, and country offices to leverage technologies and capabilities that accelerate progress on UNICEF’s goals, strengthen community resilience, and expand access to essential digital services and information.

  
  

Our mission is to enhance UNICEF’s global digital impact by promoting equitable access to information and services, empowering communities to create lasting, positive change for children, and foster a more inclusive, interconnected, and sustainable world for every child, everywhere.

  
  

UNICEF's Supporter Engagement Strategy (SES) is a global digital transformation programme delivering a unified fundraising, supporter engagement and digital marketing ecosystem across multiple UNICEF markets. The platform leverages Salesforce technologies including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Marketing Cloud, Experience Cloud, integrations, data platforms and analytics capabilities to support global fundraising operations and supporter journeys. The SES platform continues to expand across countries with increasing emphasis on standardization, scalability, automation, data-driven engagement and adoption of emerging capabilities such as Data Cloud, advanced analytics and AI

  
  

The position sit under the Digital Impact Division, Technology Foundation for Business, and report to Digital Impact Manager (CRM Solutions).

### **Role Purpose**

Working within the CRM Solutions team and reporting to the Digital Impact Manager, CRM Solutions, the incumbent will support in defining solution architecture, managing complex implementations, support global rollouts and ensure Marketing Cloud solutions are secure, scalable, reusable and aligned with UNICEF enterprise architecture standards and the broader SES ecosystem, including Salesforce CRM, integrations, analytics and emerging platform capabilities. The role will work closely with business stakeholders, Product Owners, CRM Architects, Data & Integration teams, solution engineers, and external implementation partners.

* Design and build advanced supporter journeys using Journey Builder.
  
* Configure Contact Builder, Automation Studio, Email Studio, Mobile Studio and Cloud Pages.
  
* Develop and troubleshoot advanced AMPscript, SQL, Server-Side JavaScript (SSJS) and Marketing Cloud automation processes.
  
* Build proof-of-concepts and pilot solutions for emerging platform capabilities.
  
* Participate directly in sprint planning, design workshops and technical delivery activities.
  
* Support solution deployment, release management and production go-live activities.
  
* Provide advanced troubleshooting and root-cause analysis for complex platform incidents.
  
* Support country implementation teams during onboarding and rollout phases.
  
* Work alongside developers and solution engineers to resolve technical challenges and delivery blockers.
  
* Participate in code reviews and technical quality assurance activities.
  
* Contribute to DevOps practices, release planning and solution optimisation initiatives.
  

  

**Marketing Cloud Platform Strategy**

  

* Support the manager in Defining the strategic roadmap for Marketing Cloud capabilities within SES.
  
* Identify opportunities to improve supporter engagement through automation, personalization and digital innovation.
  
* Provide technical input on Marketing Cloud Next, Data Cloud, Agentforce, AI-driven engagement and emerging Salesforce capabilities.
  
* Develop reusable global assets and frameworks to improve rollout efficiency.
  
* Drive platform simplification and reduction of technical debt.

**Supporter Journey and Engagement Architecture**
-------------------------------------------------

  

* Design scalable multi-channel supporter journeys.
  
* Establish standards for campaign management, personalization, testing and optimization.
  
* Develop audience segmentation frameworks and supporter communication strategies.
  
* Enable data-driven fundraising and engagement initiatives through marketing automation

**Governance, Security and Operational Excellence**
---------------------------------------------------

  

* Ensure compliance with UNICEF security, privacy and governance standards.
  
* Help the manager Leading platform health reviews and architecture assessments.
  
* Contribute to monitoring, resilience, and recovery strategies.
  
* Review solution security and data protection controls.
  
* Support audit and compliance activities.
  
* Coordinate with Salesforce on major incidents, platform improvements and technical escalations.

**Capacity Building and Knowledge Transfer**
--------------------------------------------

  

* Mentor internal UNICEF staff, consultants and implementation partners.
  
* Support Leading architecture walkthroughs and technical training sessions.
  
* Develop implementation standards, best practices and technical playbooks.
  
* Promote adoption of reusable components and proven delivery approaches.

**A Brief Summary of This Position:**
-------------------------------------

  

The Operations Engineer provides hands-on Tier 1 and Tier 2 support for Valmont employees in Omaha and participates in the Nerve Center's day-to-day operations. This individual contributor troubleshoots end-user hardware, software, and connectivity; fulfills service requests; monitors and triages operational events; and coordinates timely escalation. The role combines responsive on-site support with reliable Nerve Center processes, documentation, and handoffs.

  

It is essential to embody Valmont’s core values of Passion, Integrity, Continuous Improvement, and Delivering Results while cultivating a workplace where employees feel valued, trusted, understood, and respected.

  

**Essential Functions:**
------------------------

  

* This individual contributor works with the Nerve Center team and has no direct or indirect reports.
* This position provides hands-on support in Omaha. Work hours and coverage expectations will be confirmed before posting.
* Any travel between Omaha, Valley, or other locations is subject to confirmation of the support scope.
* Collaborate with Valmont staff and external partners to restore reliable technology services and support employees' day-to-day business needs.
* Monitor assigned Nerve Center queues and alerts, perform initial diagnosis, resolve routine operational events, and coordinate timely escalation when specialist support is required.

* Support major incident responses by gathering evidence, performing assigned checks, supporting communications, and documenting actions and outcomes.
* Prepare, deploy, replace, and retire end-user equipment using approved standards and asset-management practices.
* Identify recurring support issues and recommend practical improvements to reduce repeat incidents and improve service.
* Provide first-line conference-room audio/video and collaboration support, coordinating with specialists for complex problems.
* Ensure support activities comply with approved security controls, standards, procedures, and change-management requirements.
* Develop trusted relationships with employees and translate reported symptoms and service needs into actionable support requests.
* Keep users informed of progress, next steps, and resolution or escalation status throughout the support process.
* Use approved remote-support, monitoring, endpoint-management, and IT service-management tools for assigned duties.
* Maintain complete ticket and resolution records, including business impact, troubleshooting steps, actions, and outcomes.
* Coordinate effectively across IT Shared Services and provide reliable handoffs between local support and global Nerve Center teams.
* Own assigned tickets through resolution or documented handoff; escalate issues beyond the role's authority or capability.
* Provide practical guidance to employees on approved devices, applications, collaboration tools, and common self-service procedures.
Complete all organization-required training and pursue learning relevant to end-user support and Nerve Center operations, while sharing useful troubleshooting knowledge and participating in Omaha office-specific and Nerve Center process training.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  

* Preferred Bachelors Degree with 5+ years relevant experience or Associates Degree with 7+ years relevant experience or 9+ years of relevant experience.
* Continuously learn, apply, and share approved artificial intelligence (AI) tools responsibly to improve support outcomes, strengthen team capabilities, and help IT work more proactively.

* Demonstrated knowledge of PC hardware, operating systems, common business applications, remote-support tools, and basic network connectivity troubleshooting.
* Working knowledge of incident, request, access, and change-management practices and supporting ticketing tools.
* Ability to follow, develop, and improve standard operating procedures, troubleshooting guides, and technical documentation.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to gather evidence and recognize when to escalate.
* Clear written and oral communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues and next steps to nontechnical users.
Ability to prioritize work, provide responsive customer service, and collaborate with local and distributed support teams.  

  

**Highly Qualified Candidates Will Also Possess These Qualifications:**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

  

* Highly effective customer-service, written, and oral communication skills.
* Self-motivated, collaborative working style across desktop support, infrastructure, application, security, and service teams.
* Experience with monitoring, alert triage, incident escalation, and Nerve Center or network operations workflows.
* Experience applying ITIL practices, particularly incident, request, problem, change, and continual service improvement.
* Record of improving support procedures, knowledge articles, equipment deployment, or other repeatable service activities.
* Practical understanding of enterprise desktops, laptops, peripherals, business applications, and common network connectivity issues.
* Experience with ticketing, endpoint-management, remote-support, conference-room, reporting, and collaboration tools.
* Relevant technical training or certifications in end-user computing, service management, or related technologies.
Experience working in a corporate or manufacturing environment with coordinated handoffs between local and global support teams.

Work is typically performed in an office setting in Omaha. The role includes desk-based troubleshooting, telephone and online support, in-person conversations and meetings, and hands-on setup and support of computer equipment. The environment can be fast paced and requires balancing user needs with incident and request priorities. Head of Channel Relations

Dubai

Full Time

|

Salary + Incentive

**Department:** Sales

**Reports to:** Managing Director

**Direct reports:** 4–5 Relationship Managers (RMs)

**Employment type:** Full-time

**Location:** Artha office and project sales gallery, Dubai

**Working pattern:** Includes launches, weekend broker activity and roadshow travel as needed

### **Role Purpose**

The Head of Channel Relations will lead Artha Realty's B2B sales and drive revenue from our exclusive and master agency projects through the broker channel. ‍

### **Scope of the Role**

* Owns the B2B team's targets, Broker Connect, the RM team, broker terms and channel reporting.
* Developer relationships sit with the Associate Director, Sales, who remains the sole point of contact with the developer. This role supports that relationship with channel data and insight.
* Overall project launch plans and pricing are agreed with the Managing Director and the Associate Director, Sales. This role owns the channel plan within them.
* Works alongside Artha's other sales teams, which may continue to work with their own existing broker contacts, under shared rules on lead ownership and inventory. New broker leads and gallery walk-ins are handled by this role's team.  
  ‍

### **Key Responsibilities**

**B2B Sales Leadership and Strategy**

* Define and execute the B2B sales strategy, targets and annual revenue plan for exclusive and master agency projects.
* Set monthly, quarterly and project-level B2B targets and track performance against them.
* Build the channel plan for each launch, covering broker allocation, inventory access, incentives and sales timelines.
* Own the B2B pipeline, forecasting and reporting to the Managing Director, and provide channel data for developer reporting through the Associate Director, Sales.
* Identify market opportunities, broker segments and investor profiles across local and international markets.
* Track competitor commissions, incentives and launches, and Artha's share of broker attention.

* Lead, coach and manage 4–5 Relationship Managers, with clear portfolio ownership, targets and KPIs.
* Allocate broker accounts across the RM team, with named key accounts for each RM.
* Set RM activity standards for broker meetings, site visits and registered leads.
* Run weekly pipeline reviews, one-to-ones and performance discussions.
* Develop RM capability in product knowledge, negotiation, closing and broker handling.
* Work with HR on hiring, onboarding, incentive structures and retention for the team.

**Broker Connect Expansion**

* Grow and structure the Broker Connect network, onboarding new brokerages and individual agents.
* Create a clear broker proposition: commission structure, incentives, launch access, training and support.
* Segment brokers into tiers by productivity, with service levels and access to match each tier.
* Hold regular broker events, project briefings, roadshows and site visits.
* Track broker activity, conversion and productivity, and manage underperforming partners.
* Ensure brokers are onboarded and operate in line with RERA, Dubai Land Department and company requirements.

**Channel Rules and Deal Governance**

* Set and enforce rules for broker registration, lead and client ownership, and validity periods.
* Resolve disputes between brokers, or between brokers and other Artha sales teams, through a clear written process.
* Apply agreed rules for unit holds, blocking and release to brokers, including any priority access for top performers.

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Real Estate or a related field.

* Demonstrated track record of managing and growing broker channels or brokerage partnerships.
* Experience leading a team of sales managers or RMs and meeting revenue targets.
* Strong network among brokerages and investors in Dubai.
* Strong working knowledge of Dubai real estate regulations.

* Experience with exclusive project launches and large-scale inventory sell-through.
* Established relationships with international broker networks and investor markets.
* Hands-on experience with real estate CRM platforms and sales analytics.
* Additional languages such as Arabic, Russian or Hindi/Urdu.  
  ‍

### **What We Offer**

* Competitive base salary and commission/incentive structure linked to performance.
* Access to exclusive developer projects.
* Opportunity to build and shape the B2B function and the Broker Connect channel.
* UAE employment benefits in line with UAE Labour Law.

The Manager, Customer Experience & Transformation puts the customer at the centre of process design and continuous improvement. The role analyzes customer complaints, surveys and NPS results, incidents, operational data and competitive benchmarks, including Bain, to identify root causes of customer friction, emerging trends and opportunities for improvement.
  
  
These insights are translated into prioritized, actionable recommendations, with initiatives advanced at pace to improve customer outcomes, NPS and competitive performance.
  
  
The role designs, develops, tests, implements, measures and manages processes, ensuring process design reflects current business strategy and stakeholder requirements while supporting the desired customer experience. Processes may relate to, but are not limited to, fulfillment, operations, servicing and sales.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**
**Customer Insights & Experience Improvement**

* Analyzes customer complaints, survey results (NPS, Bain), incidents and call drivers to identify the root causes of customer pain points and detractor themes.
* Recommends and implements solutions that improve NPS and Bain ranking, based on analysis of customer impact, volume and business implications.
* Identifies emerging issues and trends early to inform decision-making and shift the business from reactive to proactive.
* Integrates information from multiple sources (feedback, complaints, incidents, operational data) into a single view of the customer experience.
* Designs and produces regular and ad-hoc reports and dashboards. Monitors performance against customer experience targets and addresses issues quickly.
* Establishes success measures and evaluates post-implementation results to determine whether changes have delivered the intended customer and business outcomes.

**Trusted Advisor & Strategy**

* Acts as a trusted advisor to business partners and leaders on customer experience opportunities, priorities and transformation initiatives.
* Uses customer insights and data to influence decision-making and recommend priorities.
* Develops clear, concise recommendations and materials for senior leadership, translating complex issues into actionable business decisions.
* Conducts independent analysis and assessment to resolve strategic issues and develops data-driven recommendations.
* Builds alignment across stakeholders with competing priorities and drives decisions toward a common outcome.
* Supports the development and execution of strategic initiatives with internal and external stakeholders.

**Process Design & Optimization**

* Leads the design, development, testing, implementation, measurement and ongoing management of processes that support business strategy and deliver the desired customer experience.
* Designs processes based on business requirements and best practices. Ensures they adhere to applicable risk, regulatory and compliance requirements.
* Streamlines, simplifies and continuously improves existing processes at pace to minimize customer friction.
* Identifies opportunities to eliminate, simplify, automate or digitize processes and recommends changes that improve efficiency and customer outcomes..
* Collaborates in the design, implementation and management of core business/group processes.
* Participates in the integration of core process transformation across business/groups to deliver productivity savings and a better customer and employee experience.
* Resolves process issues raised by any source or stakeholder, including customers, frontline teams and partners.

* Builds effective relationships and ensures alignment across internal and external stakeholders.
* Develops an understanding of organizational interactions and complexity to engage the right stakeholders.

* Ensures processes meet established standards and uses templates and tools to track compliance and operational effectiveness.
* Supports process management using established methodologies and tools/systems/technology.
* Assists with training and the transition of processes and tools/templates to process owners.
* Provides input into the planning and implementation of operational programs.

* Provides specialized consulting, analytical and technical support.
* Exercises independent judgment to identify, diagnose and resolve complex and non-routine customer experience and business problems, escalating where appropriate.
* Stays current on industry, customer experience and business trends through professional associations, practice communities and individual learning.
* Broader work or accountabilities may be assigned as needed.

* Deep understanding of, and problem-solving ability for, issues within the business/group.
* Experience analyzing customer feedback (NPS, surveys, complaints, incidents) and translating insights into actions that improve the customer experience. (In-depth)
* Experience with customer analytics, reporting and visualization tools such as Excel and Power BI.
* Strong ability to influence stakeholders and drive outcomes without direct authority.
* Proven ability to effectively manage multiple priorities and initiatives.

* Knowledge of business/group processes, procedures and controls, including process design and continuous improvement. (In-depth)
* Understanding of risk, regulatory and compliance requirements. (In-depth)
* Deep knowledge and technical proficiency gained through extensive education and business experience.
* Verbal and written communication skills. (In-depth)
* Collaboration and team skills. (In-depth)
* Analytical and problem-solving skills. (In-depth)
* Influence skills. (In-depth)
* Data-driven decision making. (In-depth)

The Group operates multiple F&B concepts, with a focus on casual fine dining and premium dining experiences. This role will play a pivotal part in strengthening operational excellence, driving commercial performance, developing scalable business models, and supporting the Group's long-term growth ambitions.

Job Purpose

The Head of F&B will provide strategic direction and end-to-end operational leadership across the Group's F&B entities. The position requires a commercially driven hospitality professional with a proven track record in managing multi-unit restaurant operations, driving profitability, developing people, and scaling F&B businesses.

The successful candidate will be responsible for translating business objectives into actionable strategies, ensuring operational consistency across concepts, and identifying opportunities for sustainable growth and expansion.

Key Responsibilities

1. Strategic Leadership & Business Development

* Develop and implement the overall F&B strategy in alignment with the Group's vision, business objectives, and growth plans.
* Lead the development, expansion, and scaling of existing restaurant concepts and identify opportunities for new concepts.
* Drive business growth through market analysis, competitor benchmarking, and identification of new revenue streams.
* Establish organisational structures, operational frameworks, and business processes to support a growing multi-entity F&B portfolio.
* Present strategic business plans, expansion proposals, and performance reviews to senior leadership.

2. End-to-End Operations Management

* Oversee the complete operational lifecycle of all F&B entities, covering front-of-house, back-of-house, kitchen operations, service delivery, and guest relations.
* Ensure consistent food quality, service standards, brand positioning, and operational excellence across all outlets.
* Develop and implement SOPs, operational manuals, policies, and performance management frameworks.
* Monitor outlet performance through regular operational reviews, site visits, and management reporting.
* Ensure compliance with UAE food safety regulations, municipality requirements, hygiene standards, and applicable legislation.
* Drive continuous improvement in operational efficiency, productivity, and customer experience.

3. Financial & Commercial Management

* Take full accountability for the financial performance and profitability of the F&B portfolio.
* Develop and manage annual budgets, business plans, financial forecasts, and revenue targets.
* Monitor and optimise key financial indicators, including food cost, labour cost, operating expenses, wastage, average transaction value, and outlet profitability.
* Identify opportunities to improve margins, optimise resources, and maximise commercial returns without compromising quality.
* Oversee pricing strategies, menu engineering, inventory management, and procurement efficiency.
* Work closely with Finance to ensure effective financial controls, accurate reporting, and budgetary discipline.

4. Brand Management & Guest Experience

* Protect and strengthen the identity and market positioning of each restaurant concept.
* Drive menu innovation, product development, pricing strategies, and seasonal offerings in collaboration with culinary teams.
* Establish a strong guest-centric culture focused on service excellence and customer retention.
* Monitor customer feedback, market trends, and competitor activities to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Collaborate with Marketing to develop brand campaigns, promotional activities, partnerships, and revenue-generating initiatives.
* Ensure a consistent and differentiated dining experience across all concepts.

5. Business Expansion & New Outlet Development

* Lead the planning and execution of new restaurant openings, from concept development through to launch and operational stabilisation.
* Evaluate potential expansion opportunities, new locations, and business models.
* Provide operational input into feasibility studies, financial projections, kitchen layouts, equipment requirements, and outlet design.
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders, including Projects, Procurement, Finance, HR, Marketing, and Facilities Management.
* Oversee pre-opening activities, including manpower planning, recruitment, procurement, training, SOP development, and operational readiness.
* Ensure new outlets achieve agreed launch timelines, operational standards, and commercial targets.

6. People Leadership & Organisational Development

* Lead, mentor, and develop senior operational leaders, restaurant managers, executive chefs, and other key personnel.
* Build a high-performing leadership structure across all F&B entities, ensuring clear roles, responsibilities, and accountability.
* Drive succession planning, talent development, and workforce planning.
* Establish performance management frameworks and training programmes to strengthen operational capabilities.
* Promote a culture of ownership, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Ensure appropriate manpower structures and productivity levels across all outlets.

7. Stakeholder & Group Collaboration

* Work closely with Group leadership and senior management to align F&B objectives with wider business priorities.
* Provide regular performance updates, business insights, and recommendations to senior management.
* Develop and maintain relationships with suppliers, landlords, business partners, and regulatory authorities.
* Ensure effective coordination between F&B operations and centralised Group support functions.
* Support Group-level initiatives and contribute to broader business planning and strategic decision-making.

Qualifications & Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Hospitality Management, Hotel Management, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 12–15 years of experience within the hospitality and F&B industry, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership role.
* Demonstrated experience managing multi-unit, multi-brand, or multi-entity F&B operations.
* Strong background in casual fine dining, premium casual dining, and full-service restaurant concepts.
* Proven track record of successfully scaling restaurant businesses, expanding outlet portfolios, and launching new concepts.
* Strong commercial acumen with demonstrated ownership of P&L, budgeting, forecasting, and financial performance.
* Extensive experience in end-to-end restaurant operations, including kitchen management, front-of-house, service delivery, procurement, and supply chain coordination.
* Proven ability to develop operational structures, implement SOPs, and establish scalable business processes.
* Experience in building, leading, and developing high-performing management teams.
* Strong understanding of UAE hospitality regulations, food safety standards, and local market dynamics.
* Previous experience within the UAE or GCC hospitality market is highly desirable.

Key Skills & Competencies

* Strategic business planning and execution.
* Multi-unit and multi-brand operational leadership.
* Business expansion and scalability.
* Financial management and commercial acumen.
* P&L ownership and profitability management.
* Restaurant concept development and pre-opening management.
* Guest experience and service excellence.
* Operational transformation and process optimisation.
* Leadership development and talent management.
* Stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration.
* Strong analytical, negotiation, and decision-making capabilities.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The role will be measured against key business and operational performance indicators, including:

* Achievement of revenue, profitability, and annual budget targets.
* Improvement in outlet-level P&L performance and operating margins.
* Optimisation of food costs, labour costs, and operating expenses.
* Guest satisfaction, customer retention, and brand reputation.
* Successful execution and timely opening of new outlets.
* Operational consistency, food quality, and regulatory compliance.
* Employee retention, leadership development, and succession planning.
* Successful implementation of scalable operational systems and processes.
* Achievement of agreed business expansion and growth objectives.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a strategic yet hands-on F&B leader who has successfully managed and grown restaurant businesses within a multi-brand or multi-entity environment.

They should bring a strong understanding of casual fine dining, a commercially focused approach to business management, and the ability to balance operational excellence with sustainable growth.

Most importantly, they should have the vision and execution capabilities to build, structure, and scale an F&B portfolio while maintaining strong brand identities, exceptional guest experiences, and financial discipline.

* Identify opportunities to connect risk and resilience work with cyber, technology, intelligence, security and other Control Risks capabilities.

* Model sound commercial judgement, professional integrity and disciplined management of sensitive client information.

* Demonstrated experience leading multiple complex client engagements and being accountable for delivery quality and commercial outcomes.
* Proven ability to originate work, grow accounts and convert opportunities through trusted senior relationships and compelling proposals.
* Credibility with executive and senior management stakeholders, including the confidence to challenge constructively and influence decisions.
* GCC experience and a strong understanding of how to deliver consulting work in Saudi Arabia; prior experience working with Saudi clients is essential.
* Experience managing, coaching and developing consultants in a high-performance, collaborative environment.
* Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to produce concise, high-quality executive materials.
* Willingness and ability to be based permanently in Riyadh and travel within the Kingdom and wider region as required.

**Preferred experience**

* Saudi nationals are strongly encouraged to apply. Preference may be given to suitably qualified Saudi nationals in line with applicable localisation requirements and hiring laws.
* Fluent Arabic speaking and writing.
* Experience in one or more priority sectors such as government, sovereign and Vision 2030 entities, technology, entertainment, financial services, energy, critical infrastructure, industrials or logistics.
* Experience delivering multidisciplinary programmes that integrate risk, resilience, technology, intelligence or security expertise.
* Experience building a consulting capability, proposition or team in a growth market.
* Familiarity with technology-enabled risk and resilience solutions, analytics and responsible uses of AI.

**Qualifications and professional standing**

* Relevant bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.
* Recognised professional qualifications in risk, security management, business continuity, crisis management or a related field, such as IRM, MBCI/CBCI, CBCP or equivalent.

* Commercial and business intellect
* Client-centric judgement

* Ownership and accountability
* Inclusive people leadership
